number and payee_name (the opening bank comes from the card BIN; a bank_name in the body is
ignored). payee_name and the real name are both normalised before comparing; different →
30307 (BR-WDR-02 ①). A bank card must be a debit card of the user: 12–19 digits with Luhn,
and a card BIN recognised as a debit card, else 20001 data.fields=[card_no];
three-element verification mismatch → 30307 (⑥); no card BIN source or verification vendor
available → 50301 without reserving the quota. An Alipay logon id
in phone form that does not normalise is 20001 with data.reason=phone_invalid (BR-WDR-02
细则). Account held by another user → 30308; blacklisted → 44001. Changes per natural
month over the limit → 30303 data.reason=payout_account_change_limit (④); the paid
verification reserves the day's quota before calling the vendor and a full quota is 30303
data.reason=payout_account_verify_limit without a vendor call (⑦). A verification of the
same account still in flight or under recheck → 40901; vendor timeout → 50401 (the same
account is first rechecked by the original request id on the next submit); a matching result
within its validity is reused. Resubmitting with the same Idempotency-Key reuses that key's
verification record (in flight or recheck 40901, match saves, mismatch the original 30307,
still unknown at the deadline 50401) without a new verification or charge (BR-WDR-02 细则
「核验次数上限」); that record is reused only for the card it verified, so the same key with
another card number is 20901 even when the key has no stored result yet. Needs X-Step-Up-Token for action payout_account_change (BR-WDR-02 ③; also
on the first binding). An abandoned Idempotency-Key is 20903 at the idempotency check,
without comparing the body or running the business; a business write that finds it
abandoned is rolled back with 20903 (04 §5「幂等」). Not realname → 30304; after a blocking
precondition the request is not replayed, the user saves again on the payout-account page
(BR-WDR-07 细则「前置步骤的回流」). An account flagged for re-verification (旧号加验) on
a device not yet re-verified → 10010 with data.method, checked after the step-up token
(BR-WDR-01 细则「位置与返回码」); 10010 writes no idempotency result and does not consume
the token; after re-verifying the user saves again with a new Idempotency-Key (BR-WDR-07).
The step-up token of this action is bound to the account being saved (its `summary`, see
POST /v1/auth/step-up); a different account → 10003. Version gate: applied.

200.description: The saved account (masked).

post.summary: Real-name verification (name and ID number)
post.description:
Two-element verification of name plus an 18-digit resident ID number, no face check
(BR-ID-25). The client only offers it when the user first enters a withdrawal or binds a
payout account while realname_status≠verified; no other entry may ask for the ID number.
Preconditions: no phone bound → 10005, checked before the consent (a member without phone
never gets 10004 or 30406, BR-ID-01 细则); no id_verification consent → 10004 with
data.consent_type=id_verification. Then, first hit wins (BR-ID-25): 20001 format (18
digits and check digit; the format is judged by the server, not by the request schema,
so that 10005 / 10004 come first) → 30407 age (computed locally from the ID number,
BR-ID-26) → 30410 today's attempts used up → 30405 (the ID number is already verified on
another account of this app; that account is never revealed) → vendor call. At most 3
attempts per user per natural day (+08:00): a vendor call with a definite result (match or
mismatch) counts 1, 30405 counts 1 (no vendor call); 20001, 30407 and vendor timeout or
error (50401 / 50301) do not count. The verification service being unavailable, including
not yet connected, is 50301 and does not count. A mismatch is 30406. A failed attempt
keeps neither the name nor the ID number. After verified the user cannot change it
themselves (corrections only by customer service in the admin console); a resubmission
after verified passes 10005 / 10004 and then answers 200 with the stored masked name,
ignoring the submitted values, without a vendor call or an attempt. A mismatch leaves the
user's realname_status failed. The name and the ID number never go into logs. The client
fetches GET /v1/me again after success. An account flagged for re-verification (旧号加验)
on a device not yet re-verified → 10010 with data.method on the first real-name
verification (BR-WDR-01 细则「位置与返回码」); no idempotency result is written (BR-WDR-07).
Version gate: applied.

200.description: Verified.

get.summary: Current labor agreement and whether I must sign it
get.description:
The currently effective labor agreement version, the address of its full text, its sha256
and whether the user must sign (BR-WDR-31; 04 §6.1). need_sign is true when the user has
never signed, or when the latest signature's version is below the re-sign threshold
(resign_from_version, the first version that requires a new signature); a higher current
version that has not reached the threshold leaves a signed user with need_sign=false
(08 BR-WDR-31: one signature stays valid until a version marked as requiring a new
signature is published). signed_version / signed_at are the latest signature, null when
never signed. The version comes from server configuration; the
contract does not promise how it is managed in the admin console. Native App only, the
same as signing (04 §6.1): an h5_token gets 10403 even though this is a read. Not
realname → 30304.

200.description: The current labor agreement and the signing state.

post.summary: Sign the labor agreement
post.description:
Signs the currently effective labor agreement version (BR-WDR-31). Native App only: an
h5_token gets 10403, and neither JSBridge nor the Agent may sign on the user's behalf. The
signer is the verified real-name person; not realname → 30304. version not the currently
effective version → 10004 data.consent_type=labor_agreement (the client fetches
GET /v1/me/labor-agreement and shows the current version; checked first, also when other
fields mismatch too; nothing recorded, not replayed). With the current version:
text_sha256 not the digest of that version and / or agreed not true → 20001 data.fields
listing each mismatching field (text_sha256, agreed). Every signature inserts one record
and never changes an earlier one (version, text digest, server time, signer snapshot,
channel, device_id). The client fetches GET /v1/me/labor-agreement again after success.
Version gate: applied.

200.description: Signed.

get.summary: Read states of the one-time tips
get.description:
jump_tip is read per platform (a platform without a record is absent or null);
inviter_before_buy is not per platform (BR-INV-03 细则). Fetched with /v1/config after
login; after a login on another device a tip already read on the same platform is not
shown again (BR-ATTR-21, AC-S1-17). inviter_before_buy is deprecated since 2026-10-19
(the first-purchase inviter tip is cancelled, BR-INV-03 细则, 04 §6.1): clients no longer
read it; kept in the contract and returned as before until removed, never reused.

200.description: The read states.

post.summary: Mark a tip as read
post.description:
tip_key=jump_tip needs a body {platform}; without it → 20001 with data.fields=[platform].
tip_key=inviter_before_buy sends no body (deprecated since 2026-10-19, BR-INV-03 细则:
clients no longer call it; still accepted as before until removed). Repeating the call is
harmless: an existing record keeps its read_at. Version gate: applied.

200.description: Recorded (or already recorded).

delete.description:
Settings「重新显示下单须知」: clears the read records of jump_tip on every platform. Only
tip_key=jump_tip is accepted (the path parameter allows only that value; another value is
20001). Version gate: applied.

parameters.name: tip_key
parameters.description: Only jump_tip can be reset.

200.description: The read records are cleared.

get.summary: My push settings
get.description:
Push switches per message category (BR-WATCH-19 ③, 拍板第二批 OPS-16): `service_push`
(trade and withdrawal messages are both service), `subscription_push` and
`marketing_push`. MVP opens only the service switch; subscription and marketing are
reserved and not shown by the client. A switch only affects push: with it off nothing of
that category is pushed, the in-app message is still written (GET /v1/messages). A user
who never saved settings gets all three true. PRD v2.1's /v1/notification-prefs is this
operation (04 §6.1). Not signed and no Idempotency-Key: 04 §6 marks neither S nor I.

200.description: My push settings (defaults when never saved).

put.description:
Full replacement, like the repository's other PUT operations that save a whole resource:
the body carries all three switches (`service_push`, `subscription_push`,
`marketing_push`); a missing or extra field is 20001 with data.fields. The MVP client only
shows service_push and sends the other two back as read from GET
/v1/me/notification-settings. Meanings as in GET (BR-WATCH-19 ③, 拍板第二批 OPS-16):
turning a switch off stops push for that category only, in-app messages are still written.
The response is the settings as saved. Saving the same values again changes nothing, so no
Idempotency-Key is required; not signed, as 04 §6 marks neither S nor I. Version gate:
applied.

200.description: The settings as saved.

get.summary: Progress of my account deletion
get.description:
The latest deletion request of the account (deletion_requests; flow in BR-ID-27); data is
null when there has never been one. can_cancel follows BR-ID-27: cooling and now before
cooling_until. Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

200.description: The latest request, or null.

post.summary: Apply for account deletion
post.description:
Needs X-Step-Up-Token for action account_deletion (BR-ID-08). The client shows balance and
estimated earnings first and the user ticks the waiver (BR-ID-27, wording BR-TEXT-01). A
withdrawal in PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED or PAYING is 30412 (not for a withdrawal frozen by
a ban, BR-ID-31); a negative balance is 30416 with data.amount_fen (拍板第二批 §8 ADD-07).
Success starts the 7-day cooling period and returns the request. An abandoned
Idempotency-Key is 20903 at the idempotency check, without comparing the body or running
the business; a business write that finds it abandoned is rolled back with 20903
(04 §5「幂等」). An account flagged for re-verification (旧号加验) on a device not yet
re-verified → 10010, checked after the step-up token (BR-WDR-01 细则「位置与返回码」;
BR-ID-27: the balance waived must be the owner's); 10010 writes no idempotency result and
does not consume the token. In a deletion_only session and in the deletion inside the ban
whitelist (BR-ID-31) no self-service re-verification is offered: 10010 always carries
data.method=manual, and neither whitelist gains an operation. Version gate: not applied
(申请注销, BR-ID-01 细则). Session scopes: accepts deletion_only.

200.description: The request, now in cooling.

post.summary: Withdraw my account deletion
post.description:
Allowed while now < apply_at + 7×24 hours, judged by time and not by whether the scheduled
job has run; later → 10007 (BR-ID-27). Repeating a successful cancel returns the cancelled
request. Version gate: not applied (撤销注销, BR-ID-01 细则). Session scopes: accepts
deletion_only.

200.description: The cancelled request.

get.summary: My personal information copies that can be downloaded
get.description:
The personal information copies (个人信息副本, BR-ID-40) of the current account that the
App page `DataCopy` can download (BR-ID-40 细则「在 App 内下载」; 04 §6.1): only requests
of the caller's own account with delivery `in_app_sms`, status `ready` or `delivered` and
`expires_at` not yet passed, newest generated first. A request delivered through the WeCom
(企业微信) conversation (`wecom_session`) is never listed here. Items carry no download
link and no extraction code (提取码): the link is signed only when the user taps download
(GET /v1/me/data-copies/{id}/download) and the extraction code only goes by SMS to the
bound phone number. An account without such a copy gets `items=[]`. At most a few items
(one unfinished request per user, files expire 24 hours after generation, BR-ID-30 ⑨),
so there is no paging.
In the 10006 whitelist (BR-ID-31): a banned user, or one appealing a ban, can call it;
the ban notice page (`RiskNotice`) shows its copy entry only when this list is not empty.
Usable during the deletion cooling period (BR-ID-27); once the account's deletion is
processing or done, the unfinished requests are cancelled and the files deleted
(BR-ID-40 细则「副本请求与注销状态」), so the list is empty. Session scopes: accepts
deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」, personal information rights do not depend on the
client version). Version gate: none (GET). Reading writes no audit record.

200.description: My downloadable copies, newest generated first.

get.summary: Get a short-lived signed link to one of my personal information copies
get.description:
Signs a new short-lived link to the encrypted file of one copy that GET
/v1/me/data-copies lists (BR-ID-40 细则「在 App 内下载」; the same download rule as the
console's exports: every call is authorized again and signs a new link, no long-lived
link is issued). The link `url` is valid until `url_expires_at` = min(5 minutes from now,
the copy's `expires_at`). The extraction code (提取码) that opens the file is never
returned: it only goes by SMS to the bound phone number.
An unknown id, a copy of another account or another app, a copy delivered through the
WeCom conversation (`wecom_session`), one not in status `ready` or `delivered`, and one
whose `expires_at` has passed are all 30701, without telling which (04 §6.1). Once the
account's deletion is processing or done the files are deleted and every id is 30701.
In the 10006 whitelist (BR-ID-31) and usable during the deletion cooling period, as the
list. Not subject to 10405: session scopes accept deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」)
and there is no version gate (GET). The response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: copy_id from GET /v1/me/data-copies.

200.description: A freshly signed link to the encrypted copy.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store; the signed link is not cached by any proxy or the client.

get.summary: My appeals
get.description:
Appeals of the current account only (the caller's own, account and order appeals alike),
newest first; the Appeal page shows progress and results from here (BR-ID-36). In the
10006 whitelist: a banned user, or one appealing a ban, can call it (BR-ID-31). The
internal deadline (appeals.deadline_at) and the handler are never returned: the
processing time limit is internal only and not shown to users (BR-ID-36 细则, BR-TEXT-23
细则). Only account and order appeals are listed: a blocked_request appeal is registered
by customer service in the admin console and its result is told in the WeCom (企业微信)
conversation, not here (04 §6.1; BR-ID-36 细则「被拦截请求申诉」). Each item carries
`attempt_no` and `can_resubmit`, both computed by the server (BR-ID-36 细则).

200.description: My appeals, newest first.

items.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。
另一笔订单返利被作废，请核查。

post.summary: Submit an appeal
post.description:
Appeal on the account (target_type=account) or on one order (target_type=order, target_id
= the order_id); who may appeal is BR-ID-36 (① account: risk_state banned or frozen;
② order: an order whose rebate risk control voided, BR-ATTR-26). At most one processing
appeal per target (the account, or one order): while one is processing, submitting again
returns that original appeal and creates no new one (BR-ID-36). An account appeal sets
risk_state to appealing and records prev_risk_state (BR-ID-36); target_type=order does not
change the account's risk state and only marks that order as under appeal (appeal_pending
on GET /v1/orders/{order_id}, 拍板第二批 OPS-07). For target_type=order an order_id that
is unknown or not the user's → 30701. How target_id is filled for target_type=account is
not set by 04 or BR-ID-36; the account appealed is always the caller's own. In the 10006
whitelist: a banned user, or one appealing a ban, can call it (BR-ID-31). The internal
deadline (appeals.deadline_at) and the handler are never returned: the processing time
limit is internal only and not shown to users (BR-ID-36 细则, BR-TEXT-23 细则). The result
reaches the user as the inbox message APPEAL_RESULT (BR-TEXT-23). Version gate: applied.
Order of checks: 20001 / 30701 (target checks) → a processing appeal on the same target
returns that original appeal (never 30418) → appeal count for the target used up → 30418
(BR-ID-36) → create the appeal.

example.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。

200.description: The appeal, new or the processing one already on this target.

data.content: 订单返利被作废，请核查。

post.summary: Abandon the idempotency key of a sensitive operation whose result is unknown
post.description:
Only for the pending state of the four x-step-up operations (04 §5 step-up row) after a
send whose result is unknown; the user chose to give up instead of confirming (BR-ID-10
细则「敏感操作的幂等键」). The server locates the idempotency record from the token's app_id
and user, the method and path that `action` maps to (the x-step-up table in
info.description) and `idempotency_key`:
- no record for the key → writes an abandoned record, `outcome=abandoned`, `original=null`;
- already abandoned → `outcome=abandoned` again (repeated calls give the same result);
- a completed record → `outcome=completed` and `original` = the stored response envelope
  `{code, msg, data}` unchanged (success or a 3xxxx business error); nothing is abandoned;
- the original request is still processing → 40901 (the client stays pending).
Afterwards a request with that key returns 20903. `action` or a key outside the formats →
20001 (`data.fields`). Takes no Idempotency-Key header and needs no step-up. Allowed for
frozen and deleting accounts (inside the 10006 and 10007 whitelists, BR-ID-31,
BR-ID-27); passing them checks login, signature and subject only and grants no right to
run the original operation. Single writer: platform. x-min-version-gate and
x-session-scopes are added by CT-17a.
Version gate (conditional): not applied when action=account_deletion (abandoning an unknown
deletion request); applied otherwise. Session scopes: a deletion_only session is accepted
only for action=account_deletion. Both per BR-ID-01 细则, which wins on any difference.

200.description: The key is abandoned, or its completed result is returned.

abandoned.summary: No record for the key; it is abandoned now

completed.summary: The original request had completed with a 3xxxx business error

original.msg: 有进行中的提现，暂不能申请注销

get.summary: Client configuration
get.description:
Configuration, client switches, texts and the derived per-platform purchase status
(04 §10.1, excerpt). Clients keep the last good response (LKG) and fall back to it and
then to the bundled default when the request fails (03 §4.3). Keys whose inner shape is
not fixed by 04 yet are free-form objects and get typed by the task that consumes them.
x-auth is optional (04 §6.2): h5_release buckets by user_id when logged in (拍板第二批
TECH-28) and agent availability depends on the whitelist user (BR-AI-12).
Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).
Conditional request (02 §10, 03 §4.3): the 200 response carries a strong ETag whose value
without quotes equals data.config_version (04 §10.1); a request whose If-None-Match
matches the current ETag under weak comparison gets 304 with no body, and the client
keeps its LKG.

200.description: The current configuration.

ETag.description:
Strong ETag of the configuration on 200; without quotes it equals data.config_version
(04 §10.1). A server that delivers it always sends it; a client that finds it missing
treats the configuration as having no config_version and sends no If-None-Match.

texts.withdraw.sla_text: 人工审核，工作日 24 小时内处理，节假日顺延

examples: 帮我找 500 元以内的降噪耳机

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched); no body, the client keeps its LKG.

get.summary: Enum text dictionary
get.description:
The text dictionary of BR-TEXT-12 (02 §10, 04 §6.2 `GET /v1/dict`): clients read a text as
config.texts first, then this dictionary at `items[<dict>][<code>]`, then the bundled
default (contracts/texts.default.json), and cache the dictionary by `version`, which
equals data.dict_version of GET /v1/config. `version` in the query is only a cache hint:
the response is always the whole current dictionary, also when it equals the current
version (no 304; the client compares versions itself, 编排者默认). A dictionary key
`<dict>.<code>` is split at its first dot: `dict` is the first segment and `code` the
rest (a key without a dot has the empty string as code). Keys whose current text is null
(set back to the bundled default) are left out. Before the first publish `version` is
"0" and `items` is empty. Console dictionary keys (`admin_dict.*`, BR-TEXT-25) are never
returned here; the console reads them through GET /admin/v1/dict. Readable anonymously,
without a device id. Session scopes: accepts deletion_only (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」: the
forced-update and deletion pages read it).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The dictionary version the client has cached; a hint only, the whole dictionary is returned either way.

200.description: The current dictionary.

order_status.CREDITED.summary: 这笔返利已到账，可以去钱包提现，详情见卡片。

get.summary: Search one platform
get.description:
Keyword search on one platform (04 §6.3). Coupon-price and rebate sorting reorder only
the current page (拍板第二批 TRADE-20). The cursor is opaque and carries only the search
session and page (BR-PROD-08); no_rebate items are filtered out (BR-PRICE-08). With no
result the response carries `fallback_items` (the platform's first 10 feed items). Union
failure without a usable cache returns 50304 with `data.platform` (BR-PROD-07); the
product pool is never served as search results. Cards only register a link_id with its
quote snapshot and are not converted (BR-PRICE-12): buying goes through
`POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open`. `x-auth` is optional although 04 §6.3 lists none:
rebate amounts are computed for the current user and links are registered per user
(BR-PRICE-11, BR-PRICE-12; 08 wins over 04).
When the search switch search.enabled.<platform> is off the answer is 50304 with
data.reason=search_disabled (BR-PROD-10 细则「按平台的搜索开关」).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to search (enum platform).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (enum sort); default relevance.

parameters.name: has_coupon
parameters.description: Only items with a coupon.

parameters.name: price_min_fen
parameters.description: Lower bound of final_price_fen, inclusive.

parameters.name: price_max_fen
parameters.description: Upper bound of final_price_fen, inclusive.

200.description: One page of results.

get.summary: Product detail
get.description:
Coupon, final price, estimated rebate and quote time of one product (BR-PRICE-05,
BR-PRICE-11), with a freshly registered `link_id` (BR-PRICE-12). On union failure the
server may answer with the product-pool price and `stale=true` (拍板第二批 TRADE-12).
A response whose derived key differs from the requested one, or cannot be derived, is
30143 ref_expired (BR-PROD-03, BR-PROD-05). `item_ref` of the card the user tapped is
passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11). x-auth optional for the same reason as search.
A union timeout, throttle or open breaker answers from the stale cache, then the product
pool; 50401 when neither the stale cache nor the product-pool fallback is available
(BR-PROD-05 结果分类 ③, BR-PRICE-11).

parameters.name: item_ref
parameters.description: Opaque `item_ref` of the card that was tapped (BR-PROD-11); never parsed.

200.description: The product card of the detail page.

get.summary: Price trend of one product
get.description:
Final price of the last 30 days for the folded price-trend module of the product detail
page (规划/01 F-PROD-14; BR-WATCH-05, BR-WATCH-19, BR-PROD-03). Read only from
price_snapshot; never reads the watch observation tables or any third-party service, so
nothing about the product's current state (off shelf, ref expired) is reported here.
One point per natural day in +08:00, the last record of that day; records of one day
from several sources rank detail, then search, then quote. `start_date` is the date of the
first record in the window (plain date, BR-TEXT-11), `window_days` is 30. Fewer than
`price_trend.min_distinct_days` distinct dates, or the platform's key_stability not yet
stable_7d, gives status=no_data with empty points and null start_date (the client shows
price_trend.empty); an unknown product key is the same no_data. `source_key` is
price_trend.source, or price_trend.source.general for a product whose detail quote
carries no coupon (BR-PRICE-04); the title key follows the same choice. A `platform`
that is not a platform code, or a product key that does not belong to it, is 20001 with
data.fields.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform of the product (enum platform).

200.description: The price trend, or no_data.

post.summary: Report a wrong price, rebate or product info on the detail page
post.description:
Product feedback from the detail page (01 F-PROD-15, 04 §6.3). Guests who accepted the
privacy policy and logged-in users may submit; the record is counted by device and also
keeps user_id when logged in (BR-ID-02 细则「商品反馈与进店」). Basic mode shows no entry and
sends no request (BR-ID-11). The body carries only what BR-ID-30 细则「商品反馈记录」 lists:
no contact fields, and any undefined field is 20001. link_id is the detail card's link,
from which the server reads the quote snapshot; a link_id that does not exist or does not
belong to the app is 30144. A device submitting more than feedback.daily_limit_per_device
(default 20) in one natural day (+08:00) gets 42901 and nothing is written. With
feedback.enabled off (features.flags.product_feedback=false) the client shows no entry and
the server answers 30145. Version gate: applied.

example.reason: price

200.description: The feedback is recorded.

post.summary: Enter the product's shop — convert the shop link at tap time
post.description:
【进店】 on the product detail (BR-PRICE-21 细则「进店」, 04 §6.3). Identity requirements are
those of a purchase tap: not logged in → 10001; platform not authorized → 30101 / 30102 /
30111 with the same data as open (BR-ID-02, BR-ID-17, BR-ID-22); convert.enabled.<platform>
off → 50301 as on open. The server takes this shop's promotion link from
shop.entry.source.<platform> with the identity injected as in BR-ATTR-05 (self_buy slot and
the current user's attribution parameters) and returns `jump` (same shape as open, 04 §8.4).
There is no scene (exception to BR-ATTR-08), no link is registered and no quote snapshot is
written. shop.entry.enabled.<platform> off, or no shop entry source configured for the
platform → 30146 with data.reason=shop_entry_disabled. A conversion that does not produce
a promotion link carrying the user's attribution fails like a purchase conversion (50303
and the other purchase-link codes, not 30146); the server never answers with a shop address
without promotion parameters. A request stopped by 30101, 30102 or 30111 and sent again
after the user authorized is a new request with a new Idempotency-Key (BR-ID-10 细则).
Version gate: applied.

200.description: Jump plan into the shop.

get.summary: Hot-sales list of one platform
get.description:
Hot-sales list of the `HotRankList` page (04 §6.3 `GET /v1/rank/hot`; 规划/01 F-PROD-13;
BR-TEXT-13, BR-TEXT-17). The server reads one sales-list channel of the platform, which
must be a selectable channel of the whitelist specs/material-channels.yaml (BR-TEXT-17
细则「联盟物料频道」); `channel` names it. `categories` lists the categories that channel
offers; `category` in the query takes only a `category_id` from that list (anything else
is 20001 with data.fields=[category]). `items` keep the order the channel returned and are
never reordered (`rank` counts from 1 across pages); `sales_text` is the union's sales
field passed through unchanged, null when the union gives none (the client then hides the
sales line, texts rank.sales.tb / rank.sales.neutral); `notice_key` is rank.notice. Cards
have the shape of a search card (ProductCard) and only register a link with its quote
snapshot, never convert (BR-PRICE-12). Answers are cached by the server for
rank.cache_ttl_seconds. A platform with no compliant channel answers 50304 with
data.reason=rank_unavailable and is left out of /v1/config features.rank_platforms; a
union failure without a usable cache answers 50304 without reason (retry later). The
product pool is never served as the hot list. Page size 20 (no limit parameter); a
malformed or foreign cursor is 20001 with data.fields=[cursor]. `x-auth` is optional
although 04 listed none earlier: rebate amounts are computed for the current user
(BR-PRICE-11, D10-462; 08 wins over 04). A request without a token is a guest.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform of the list (enum platform).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A `category_id` from `categories` of this operation; absent for the whole list.

200.description: One page of the hot-sales list, in channel order.

get.summary: Search hot words and keyword shortcuts
get.description:
Hot words and keyword shortcuts of the search page (04 §6.3 `GET /v1/search/hot-words`;
规划/01 F-PROD-03). Both lists are configured in the admin console and returned in their
configured order; this operation serves no search statistics (F-PROD-10 is P1).
`hot_words` are shown as chips that start a normal search. `keyword_routes` map a keyword
to an in-app target: the client trims the typed input and compares it with each keyword
as a whole word, ignoring case; on a match it opens `target` instead of searching,
otherwise it searches as usual. A target is only a route of contracts/routes.json, checked
when saved; an external link goes only through ExternalPage, and saving one on a union
domain is refused (BR-ATTR-29); shortcuts stay subject to F-HOME-09 / F-LINK-11. The
client checks route and params against its own routes table before opening (RouteTarget).
Readable anonymously in basic mode, without a device id. Empty lists when nothing is
configured.

200.description: The configured hot words and keyword shortcuts.

get.summary: My favorites
get.description:
Favorites of the current user, newest favorited first (规划/01 F-PROD-12). Each item has
`platform`, `product_key`, `favorited_at`, `invalid` and `product_card`. The list card has
the same shape as a search card (ProductCard) and only registers a link and a quote
snapshot, never converts (TRADE-03). `invalid=true` when fetching the card the union
answered that the product does not exist, is off shelf or cannot be promoted; such an
item's card has only the title and the image, no price and no rebate_*. Only product
references and times are stored, never prices, links or tokens. `next_cursor` fetches the
next (older) page; null means no more. A malformed or foreign cursor is 20001 with
data.fields=[cursor].

200.description: One page of my favorites, newest first.

put.description:
Favorites one product (规划/01 F-PROD-12). Unique per (app, user, platform, product_key):
when the product is already a favorite the original record is returned and no row is
added. Adding a new one when the user already has `favorites.max_per_user` favorites is
20001 with data.reason=favorites_full (client shows error.20001.favorites_full as a light
hint, no dialog); an existing favorite is returned even at the limit. Only the product
reference and the time are stored. A product key that does not belong to `platform` is
20001 with data.fields=[product_key]. Version gate: applied.

200.description: The favorite, new or the one already recorded.

delete.description:
Removes one favorite; the row is physically deleted (规划/01 F-PROD-12). A product that is
not a favorite is success as well. A product key that does not belong to `platform` is
20001 with data.fields=[product_key]. Version gate: applied.

200.description: Not a favorite any more.

post.summary: Remove several favorites
post.description:
Removes the listed favorites, at most 100 items (规划/01 F-PROD-12); rows are physically
deleted, items that are not favorites are skipped, and the call succeeds. More than 100
items, or an item whose product key does not belong to its platform, is 20001 with
data.fields. Version gate: applied.

200.description: None of the listed products is a favorite any more.

post.summary: Recognise pasted links, tokens or share text
post.description:
Shared by clipboard, search box, share extension and Agent (04 §8.5). At most 3 links or
tokens of one text are handled, one card each; the same product key yields one card
(BR-PROD-08 ⑤). Cards only register a link_id with the quote snapshot and are never
converted here (拍板第二批 TRADE-03); a pasted link without rebate still yields a card
with `rebate_basis=no_rebate` (BR-PRICE-08). Nothing recognisable as a concrete product
returns 30132 without candidate cards (拍板第二批 TRADE-07); a recognised product
whose key cannot be derived returns 30131 (BR-PROD-03). How a platform turns a link or
token into a product is the union adapter's business and is not visible here. x-auth is
optional although 04 §6.3 lists none, for the same reason as search.

200.description: One result per recognised link or token, in input order.

post.summary: Buy — re-check the price and convert
post.description:
The only entry for a purchase tap (拍板第二批 TRADE-03): converts in real time with the
identity fixed in the link snapshot and re-checks the price before the jump
(BR-PRICE-13; ownership rules BR-ATTR-05). `price_changed=true` means the client asks
the user before jumping; whenever the new price differs, `new_link_id` replaces the card
(BR-PRICE-12). Re-check failure with a cached link of this user ≤ 900 s jumps with
`requote_failed=true`; without cache, 50303. A `no_rebate=true` open does not need the
re-check to succeed: on re-check failure it still jumps with `requote_failed=true`, no
rebate and no quote snapshot, converted on the self_buy slot without user parameters, or
to the unpromoted product page when that conversion fails too (BR-PRICE-13, BR-ID-18,
BR-PRICE-08); a share link opened by anyone but the sharer ignores `no_rebate`. Share
links open anonymously; other links need login (10001). amount_unknown cards are converted without price re-check
(BR-PRICE-08). The client waits at most 8 s and retries with the same Idempotency-Key
(拍板第二批 TRADE-22). Every call writes a link_log `open` row (BR-ATTR-14). When the
rebate drops from > 0 to 0 (new_rebate_max_fen = 0) the client also asks before jumping,
even with price_changed=false (BR-PRICE-13).
A request stopped by 30101, 30102 or 30111 and sent again after the user authorized is a
new request with a new Idempotency-Key; the original key is only for retrying the same
request (BR-ID-10 细则). 30101 / 30102 carry auth_url, state and auth_methods; 30111
carries auth_jump.
A share link opened by anyone but the sharer while the sharer's own authorization is no
longer valid (Taobao binding not active, or Pinduoduo filing invalid) gets 30102 (Taobao)
or 30111 (Pinduoduo) with data.reason=sharer_auth_invalid and no auth_url, state or
auth_jump; this holds during a site-owner authorization outage too (never
auth_unavailable here). The opener is not the one to authorize: the client shows no
AuthSheet, does not replay the link, offers no no-rebate purchase and shows
link_landing.invalid (BR-ATTR-05 细则「别人的分享 link 不可用」).

200.description: Jump plan and price re-check result.

post.summary: Register and convert in one call (entries without a link_id)
post.description:
Only for entries that have no link_id, such as the H5 bridge method
`trade.convertAndOpen` (scene=h5): registers the link and then
re-checks and converts exactly like open, returning `link_id` plus the open result
(拍板第二批 TRADE-03). Pass `product_key` with the tapped card's `item_ref` (a missing
item_ref is not an error, BR-PROD-11), or `url`. A url whose product key cannot be
derived is 30131 and nothing is registered (BR-PROD-03). A missing or invalid `scene`
is 20001 (BR-ATTR-08). Writes a link_log `convert` row (BR-ATTR-14).
A request stopped by 30101, 30102 or 30111 and sent again after the user authorized is a
new request with a new Idempotency-Key; the original key is only for retrying the same
request (BR-ID-10 细则). 30101 / 30102 carry auth_url, state and auth_methods; 30111
carries auth_jump.

200.description: The registered link and its jump plan.

get.summary: Card of a link for the in-app link landing page
get.description:
Card data for the in-app link landing page (route LinkLanding, 01 §4.2; BR-ATTR-05 细则
「App 内打开链接的入口」). Read-only: registers no link, writes no link_log and converts
nothing. Returns link_kind (share | other), the shared product card subset (the same as
the share page: no rebate_* and no est_net_price_fen, BR-PRICE-06, BR-ATTR-10),
quoted_at, and viewer_is_sharer (true only with a token whose user is the sharer of this
share link; used only to show a hint, BR-ATTR-11). Unknown link or one of another app →
30144; the page has no card to re-convert from, shows the empty state and does not retry.
Buying still goes only through POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open.

200.description: The link kind and its card.

get.summary: Card data of the share page
get.description:
Card data of the share page outside the app (F-SHARE-01, 01 §4.2): the shared product card
subset (no rebate_* and no est_net_price_fen, BR-PRICE-06), quoted_at, jump_url (the
sharer's converted short link used for the jump; never contains a token, in any
environment), tpwd_ticket and open_in_app_url. tpwd_ticket is the short-lived ticket for
POST /v1/share-pages/{link_id}/tpwd: returned only when the server judges the request's
User-Agent to be outside WeChat and the link has a token, otherwise null (a request
without User-Agent counts as WeChat). The User-Agent is the client's claim, only used to
adapt the page, not a guarantee of content isolation (BR-ATTR-10 细则). open_in_app_url
is the LinkLanding deep link, null while share.open_in_app.enabled is off (BR-ATTR-05
细则「App 内打开链接的入口」). Only links with pid_scene=share are answered; any other,
unknown or of another app → 30144. When the sharer's own authorization is no longer
valid (Taobao binding not active, or Pinduoduo filing invalid; JD is not checked) →
30102 (Taobao) or 30111 (Pinduoduo) with data.reason=sharer_auth_invalid and no
auth_url, state or auth_jump; this holds during a site-owner authorization outage too
(never auth_unavailable here). The share page shows 「分享链接已失效，请联系分享者重新分享」
and offers no authorization, replay or no-rebate purchase (BR-ATTR-05 细则「别人的分享
link 不可用」). The response carries Cache-Control: no-store (not cached by the CDN). Not
signed; no X-Device-Id required.

200.description: The share page card.

post.summary: Token of the share page for the copy-token button
post.description:
Called when the user taps the copy-token button on the share page: the body carries the
tpwd_ticket of GET /v1/share-pages/{link_id}; returns the token (BR-ATTR-10 细则). The
ticket is bound to the link_id, valid 600 s, at most 3 exchanges. An invalid, expired or
used-up ticket, or a request whose User-Agent is the WeChat in-app browser or missing →
20001 with data.fields=[ticket], no token. Rate limited per IP × link_id
(share.tpwd_rate_per_min) → 42901 with Retry-After. The response carries Cache-Control:
no-store. Not signed. Version gate: 不判定：非三端请求 (written false, BR-ID-01 细则).

200.description: The token.

post.summary: Generate the share materials of a product (share page)
post.description:
Called when the share page ProductShare opens (F-SHARE-10; BR-ATTR-10 细则「分享页与分享赚入口页」).
With the caller (the sharer) as the identity, the server registers a new link with
pid_scene=share and converts it in real time, returning in one response the share link
(share_url) and, for Taobao, the token (tpwd), the poster, the image addresses, the default
copy with its parts, and the share quote. Copy, save and system share on that page all use
this one link; opening the share page again calls this operation again with a new
Idempotency-Key and gets a new link, never the old one (the old link stays valid,
BR-ATTR-05 / 13). A retry of the same request reuses the key and gets the same link_id.
The share page does not go through POST /v1/links/convert, and the link registered by
POST /v1/inputs/parse for the card is neither turned into a share link nor used for
sharing; it may only be passed as source_link_id, which is recorded as the source and never
changed. A missing item_ref is not an error (BR-PROD-11).
Open only to users with a bound phone (10005 otherwise), aged 18 or over (an identified
minor gets 30413 with data.reason=self_minor, BR-INV-19) and authorized on that platform
(Taobao needs an active binding → otherwise 30101; Pinduoduo needs the filing → otherwise
30111; BR-ATTR-10). A request stopped by 30101 or 30111 and sent again after the user
authorized is a new request with a new Idempotency-Key (BR-ID-10 细则). 30101 carries
auth_url, state and auth_methods; 30111 carries auth_jump. The sharer's binding on that
platform blocked (union_bindings status=blocked) → 30153 (as links/convert and open), not
the 30101 / 30111 of a missing authorization. An unsupported platform (body.platform not
taobao / jd / pdd, or a product_key whose prefix belongs to an unsupported platform) → 30131
(as convertLink). Product off shelf → 30141; product information no longer valid → 30143.
Taobao: when the promotion link or the token cannot be obtained, nothing is generated and
the whole call fails, never a half result and never the original link instead (BR-ATTR-10
细则「淘宝分享实现」): while the token generation permission is not granted → 50301 with
data.reason=not_launched and data.platform=taobao; a temporary failure (upstream timeout,
rate limit, circuit open, or the conversion failed) → 50303. The platform refusing the
conversion (such as JD without conversion permission) → 30121, not retryable; a temporary conversion failure → 50303, retry later (as convertLink); a
platform in maintenance → 50301 (maintenance).
poster_url is always null until the poster worker ships (orchestrator decision D10-426;
the poster is drawn by the server from a unified template, TECH-13). images are the
addresses returned by the union product API, passed on unchanged and kept in no business
table; the only exception is the whole response the platform idempotency module keeps for
its retention period, replayed unchanged on the same key (BR-ATTR-10 细则, D10-439).
est_promo is the buy_type=share quote of the caller's own share
(BR-PRICE-06) and is only for the sharer on this page: it never appears in the copy, the
poster, the images, the share page or LinkLanding.
Version gate: applied.

200.description: The newly registered share link and its materials.

copy.default_text:
伊利纯牛奶 250ml×24 盒
券后 ¥49.9 · 10-05 取价
券前价 ¥59.9
券面额 ¥10
复制 ₤AbCd1234₤ 打开淘宝
券后价按单件计算，不含运费及会员价等优惠，以下单页为准

jdWithoutCoupon.summary: JD product without a coupon (no token, no coupon lines)

copy.default_text:
伊利纯牛奶 250ml×24 盒
售价 ¥59.9 · 10-05 取价
下单链接 https://u.example.test/share91
价格按单件计算，不含运费及会员价等优惠，以下单页为准

post.summary: Admin login, first step (account and password)
post.description:
First step of the admin login (BR-ID-34; 04 §6.6 auth). The source IP must be on the admin
whitelist (10403 `data.reason=admin_ip_not_allowed`, checked before the password). A wrong
account or password is 10008 without data (an unknown account is not told apart) and
counts towards the consecutive-failure lock; a locked account gets 10009 with
`data.locked_until` even with the right password.
Success never issues an admin_token: it returns a `login_ticket` for exactly the step in
`next` — `totp` (bound authenticator: POST /admin/v1/auth/totp), `change_password` (still on
the initial password: POST /admin/v1/auth/password, then the binding) or `bind_totp` (no
authenticator bound: POST /admin/v1/auth/totp/secret, then POST
/admin/v1/auth/totp/bind). The ticket can call nothing but that step; its lifetime is set
by the server and given in `ticket_expires_at`.
Not decided by BR-ID-43 and not fixed here: how the initial password is handed out beyond
the rule itself. The initial password comes from POST /admin/v1/admins; a lost
authenticator is reset by a super admin with POST /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/totp/reset.

200.description: Account and password accepted; the next step and its ticket.

totp.summary: Authenticator bound, enter the current code

changePassword.summary: First login on the initial password, change it first

bindTotp.summary: No authenticator bound yet, bind one

post.summary: Replace the initial password during the first login
post.description:
Takes a `login_ticket` whose `next` was `change_password` (BR-ID-43「首次登录强制改密码」).
The new password must differ from the initial one, which stops working once replaced; a
new password that is rejected is 20001 with `data.fields=[new_password]` and the ticket
stays usable. Password composition rules are not fixed by BR-ID-43 and are left to the
admin module task. Success consumes the ticket and returns the next step (`bind_totp` for a
new account) with a new ticket; no admin_token is issued before the binding is done.
A ticket that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired` (back to the first step). A locked account is 10009.

200.description: Password replaced; the next step and its ticket.

post.summary: Authenticator secret for the first binding
post.description:
Takes a `login_ticket` whose `next` was `bind_totp` and returns the TOTP secret and its
otpauth URI (the page draws the QR code from the URI) for the account holder to add to an
authenticator app (BR-ID-34 细则「首次绑定身份验证器」). It does not consume the ticket:
calling it again with the same ticket returns the same secret; a new login after leaving or
timing out generates a new one. Nothing is bound until POST /admin/v1/auth/totp/bind
accepts a code. POST so that neither ticket nor secret appears in a URL.
A ticket that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`. A locked account is 10009.

200.description: The secret to bind.

post.summary: Confirm the first binding with a code and sign in
post.description:
Takes the `bind_totp` ticket and the current 6-digit code of the secret from POST
/admin/v1/auth/totp/secret. A correct code stores the binding and issues the admin_token
(login complete). A wrong code binds nothing and signs nothing in: 20002 with
`data.reason=totp_bind_invalid`, the ticket stays usable for another try, and every such
failure counts towards the same consecutive-failure lock as a wrong password (BR-ID-34
细则「首次绑定身份验证器」); requests during the lock get 10009. A ticket that is expired,
already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`.

200.description: Bound and signed in.

post.summary: Admin login, second step (authenticator code)
post.description:
Takes the `totp` ticket from POST /admin/v1/auth/login and the current 6-digit code. A
correct code issues the admin_token (BR-ID-34). A wrong code is 20002 with
`data.reason=totp_invalid`, the ticket stays usable for another try, and every such failure
counts towards the consecutive-failure lock; requests during the lock get 10009. A ticket
that is expired, already used, invalid or issued for another step is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`.

200.description: Signed in.

post.summary: Sign out of the admin console
post.description:
Revokes the session of the admin_token. The console also drops the token from memory and
sessionStorage. An expired or idle-timed-out token is answered 10001 like on any admin
operation; nothing is written.

200.description: The admin session is revoked.

post.summary: Send the SMS code of the sms step-up tier
post.description:
Sends a verification code to the verify phone registered on the signed-in admin account
(BR-ID-34 短信档; template ADMIN_STEP_UP). An account without a registered verify phone is
10003 with `data.tier=sms` and `data.reason=verify_phone_missing` and nothing is sent (the
console greys out sms-tier buttons beforehand from `verify_phone_masked` of GET
/admin/v1/me/permissions; the phone is registered or changed with POST
/admin/v1/me/verify-phone/sms-codes and PUT /admin/v1/me/verify-phone, and until such a
change succeeds codes keep going to the current phone). Sending too often is 42901 with
Retry-After. The send limits and the code validity are not fixed by BR-ID-34; the response
states the values in force.

200.description: The provider accepted the SMS, or its outcome is unknown (counted as sent).

post.summary: Admin second verification (totp or sms tier)
post.description:
Returns a step_up_token that records its tier (BR-ID-34): `tier=totp` with the current
authenticator code, `tier=sms` with the code sent by POST /admin/v1/auth/step-up/sms-codes.
The console sends the token as the `X-Step-Up-Token` request header of the admin
operation that answered 10003 and replays that request; the header is never put in the
body. An operation that needs the sms tier rejects a totp-tier token with 10003
`data.tier=sms`. Which tier each operation needs is annotated per permission in GET
/admin/v1/me/permissions (04 §11 step-up column).
`tier=sms` on an account without a registered verify phone is 10003 with `data.tier=sms`
and `data.reason=verify_phone_missing`. A wrong code is 20002 without a reason; an expired
or voided SMS code is 20003. Not fixed by BR-ID-34 and left open here: whether wrong
step-up codes count towards the login-failure lock, and the token lifetime and number of
uses (the response carries `expire_at`; the server decides).

sms.summary: SMS code sent to the verify phone

200.description: A step-up token of the requested tier.

get.summary: The signed-in admin account and its permission points
get.description:
Read after login to build the menu and the CASL rules (03 §9.1–§9.2). A super admin
(`is_super=true`) gets every permission point; another account gets the points a super
admin ticked for it; an account with none gets an empty list and the console shows the
「暂无权限」 page (BR-ID-34 细则「首次绑定身份验证器」). Permission keys are values of
contracts/enums/admin.yaml `admin_permission`; clients ignore a key they do not know.
Each entry carries its step-up annotation (04 §11 step-up column): `step_up_tier` is the
tier every step-up operation of that point needs (null = none needs one), and
`step_up_operations` lists the operations whose tier differs from it (e.g. only raising the
minimum supported version under `content.app_version` needs totp; only the balance cache
recalculation under `fund.recon` needs sms). Operation keys come from specs/permissions.yaml
(B1-18). `verify_phone_masked` is null when no verify phone is registered: sms-tier
buttons are greyed out with a prompt to register one (03 §9.2).

200.description: The account and its permission points.

finance.summary: Account with ticked points, verify phone registered

noPermission.summary: Account without any permission point (「暂无权限」 page)

post.summary: Send a code to the new verify phone of the signed-in account (step-up)
post.description:
First step of registering or changing the signed-in account's own verify phone on its
「我的账号」 page (BR-ID-45 ① ⑤). Any signed-in admin account,
super admins included (no permission point). Step-up: totp tier, checked here when the
change is started (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with
`data.tier=totp`).
`phone` is normalised (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」; not a mainland mobile number → 20001
with `data.fields=[phone]` and `data.reason=phone_invalid`); the account's current verify
phone is 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]`. The phone is not checked for uniqueness among
admin accounts (BR-ID-45 sets no such rule). A verification code is sent to that new
phone and submitted with PUT /admin/v1/me/verify-phone. Only the new phone and the
authenticator are verified: no code goes to the old phone, so losing it does not block
the change (②). Sending again replaces the earlier pending code. Until the change
succeeds the current verify phone stays valid and sms-tier step-up codes (POST
/admin/v1/auth/step-up/sms-codes) keep going to it. Sending too often is 42901 with
Retry-After; the send limits and the code validity are those of POST
/admin/v1/auth/step-up/sms-codes (not fixed by BR-ID-45), the response states the values
in force.

200.description: The provider accepted the SMS, or its outcome is unknown (counted as sent).

put.summary: Register or change the signed-in account's verify phone with the new phone's code
put.description:
Second step of the change started by POST /admin/v1/me/verify-phone/sms-codes (BR-ID-45
①). Any signed-in admin account; the step-up was made when the
code was sent, so no step-up token is checked here. `phone` is normalised as for sending.
`code` must be the pending code sent to this `phone` for this account: a wrong code is
20002 without a reason; no pending code for this account and phone, an expired code or
one voided (by too many wrong tries, a newer send or a change that succeeded meanwhile,
including one made by a super admin) is 20003 and nothing changes. Only a verified new
phone takes effect: the verify phone is replaced (stored encrypted with its blind index,
BR-ID-33; `verify_phone_set_at` = now), the pending code is used up and every other
pending verify-phone code of the account is voided; sms-tier step-up codes go to the new
phone from then on and the sms-tier buttons become available (`verify_phone_masked` of
GET /admin/v1/me/permissions). Sessions are not revoked. Audit: action
admin_verify_phone_change with the masked phones before and after. The response carries
the masked phone only. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The new verify phone, masked.

get.summary: The console workbench — to-do counts, yesterday's overview and system status
get.description:
Permission point `dashboard.view` (04 §11.1; read only, no step-up); without it the
operation is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied` and the console lands on the
first menu the account may open (01 F-ADM-26, 04 §6.6 dashboard). A super admin holds every
point. Read-only aggregate: nothing is written here, every card links to its own page.

The server trims the response to the account's permission points; the console renders only
what comes back (no greyed-out cards):
- `todo[]`: one entry per to-do card (`key`, enum admin_dashboard_todo_key) the account
  holds the card's point for — withdraw_review_pending `withdraw.review`,
  claim_review_pending `order.claim`, settle_bill_pending `settle.bill`, recon_diff_open
  `fund.recon`, appeal_pending `risk.appeal`, agent_report_overdue `agent.report`,
  beneficiary_held_overdue `risk.freeze`, union_auth_expiring `union.account_auth` (counting
  rules in the BR each enum value names). A card the account may see is returned with
  `count=0` when nothing is waiting (the card still shows). A card whose module has not
  shipped yet is left out exactly like a card without the point: the three fund cards
  (withdraw_review_pending, settle_bill_pending, recon_diff_open) appear once the fund
  line's console tasks ship. `route` is the console route the card opens, with its
  filter; `oldest_at` (optional, nullable) is the earliest waiting item's time;
  `breakdown` (optional) splits the count by a card-specific sub-key (for
  claim_review_pending `auto_matched` and `manual_review`); clients ignore keys they do
  not know.
- `yesterday`: always returned with `dashboard.view`. Yesterday's whole accounting day
  (`date`), aggregated daily with the report rules, not live (01 F-ADM-26 ②): `links`
  (link_logs created that day), `orders` (sub-orders with paid_at that day, not reduced by
  later invalidation), `est_rebate_fen` (users' share of those sub-orders still
  rebate_status=ESTIMATED and platform_status≠DEPOSIT_PAID at aggregation time, BR-TEXT-21),
  `new_users` (users registered that day); `as_of` is the aggregation time.
- `status`: only with `fund.view`, otherwise the whole object is absent: payout queue
  paused (`payout.queue_paused`), the payout channels paused one by one
  (`payout.channel_paused.<channel>`), monthly auto settlement (`settle.auto.enabled`) and
  whether the enterprise Alipay balance W is expired (BR-WDR-18; null until W entry ships
  with the fund line).
No open-alerts count is returned (alert records and closing rules are not defined yet;
负责人 2026-10-18 后台第 1 批定稿 ①).

200.description: The workbench, trimmed to the account's permission points.

superAdmin.summary: Super admin with the cards whose modules have shipped

noFundView.summary: Account with dashboard.view and order.claim only (no status)

get.summary: List admin accounts (super admin only, read-only)
get.description:
Admin accounts and their permission points, page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200, 04
§5). Super admin only — 「后台账号与权限」 is not a permission point and cannot be granted
(04 §11, 拍板第二批 §8 ADD-04); any other account gets 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Never returns the password, its hash, the TOTP secret
or the full verify phone. Creating, disabling and enabling, ticking permission points,
resetting the authenticator, renaming and the verify phone are the operations under
/admin/v1/admins (super admin; step-up and audit as each one states).

200.description: One page of admin accounts.

post.summary: Create an ordinary admin account with a one-time initial password (super admin, step-up)
post.description:
Super admin only (04 §11 引言: creating and disabling accounts and ticking points are limited
to super admins, need step-up and write an audit record; any other account is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`). Step-up: totp tier (without a valid totp-tier
`X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`).
Creates an ordinary account only (`is_super=false`; super admins are not created here):
no permission point is ticked (they are ticked afterwards with PUT
/admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/permissions), no verify phone is registered (registered
afterwards by the holder through PUT /admin/v1/me/verify-phone, or by a super admin
through PUT /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/verify-phone), the authenticator is not bound and
the account is on its initial password, so its first login goes through
`change_password` and then `bind_totp` (POST /admin/v1/auth/login).
`username` (the login name, cannot be changed later) must differ from every existing
account's, disabled accounts included (BR-ID-43「停用后台账号」: a name is never
given out again); a taken name is 20001 with `data.fields=[username]`. `display_name` is
required here (1–32 characters after trimming, else 20001 with
`data.fields=[display_name]`). Composition rules of the login name beyond its length are
not fixed by 规划/08 and are left to the admin module task.
Initial password (BR-ID-43「初始密码」): generated by the server and returned in
`initial_password` of this response only, once; it is never readable again, never written
to logs or to the audit record, and the response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`. The
super admin tells it to the holder face to face or in a WeChat Work private chat only. It
is valid for the first login only and stops working once replaced (POST
/admin/v1/auth/password).
No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6): when the outcome is unknown the console looks the account
up in GET /admin/v1/admins instead of resending; if the account exists but its initial
password never reached the holder, POST /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/initial-password
issues a new one (BR-ID-43「重新生成初始密码」).
Audit (BR-ID-34): action admin_account_create with the new account's id, username and
display_name (never the password).

200.description: The account was created; the initial password is shown this once.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store; the one-time initial password is not cached by any proxy or the browser.

get.summary: One admin account (super admin only, read-only)
get.description:
Same fields as a list item. Super admin only (10403 `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`
otherwise). An unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`. Never returns the
password, its hash, the TOTP secret or the full verify phone.

200.description: The admin account.

post.summary: Regenerate the one-time initial password of an account not yet signed in (super admin, step-up)
post.description:
For an initial password that never reached the holder, e.g. when the outcome of POST
/admin/v1/admins was unknown (BR-ID-43「重新生成初始密码」). Super admin only (otherwise
10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`). Step-up: totp tier (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). No request body. An unknown
`admin_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`; a target with `is_super=true`, the
caller's own account included, is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`
(super admin rows are 「不可修改」).
Only an account still on its initial password (password_must_change) and without a bound
authenticator (`totp_bound=false`) qualifies; any other account is 20902 with
`data.resource=admin_account` (refresh: the holder has already replaced the password or
bound the authenticator).
Effects, in one transaction: a new initial password is generated and returned in
`initial_password` of this response only, once, with `Cache-Control: no-store`; the
previous initial password stops working, and so does every login ticket of the account
that has not finished its steps (the next step with such a ticket is 10001 with
`data.reason=login_ticket_expired`). The holder is told the new password face to face or
in a WeChat Work private chat only (BR-ID-43「初始密码」). Status, display name, permission
points and verify phone are unchanged. Audit: action admin_initial_password_regenerate
with the target; no password appears in the audit record or the logs. No
Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6): when the outcome is unknown the super admin regenerates
again, which voids the earlier one.

200.description: A new initial password, shown this once.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store; the one-time initial password is not cached by any proxy or the browser.

4XX.description: No new initial password (codes in contracts/error-codes.yaml).

post.summary: Disable an ordinary admin account (super admin, step-up, reason)
post.description:
Super admin only (04 §11 引言; otherwise 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`).
Step-up: totp tier (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with
`data.tier=totp`). `reason` is required (1–200 characters, else 20001 with
`data.fields=[reason]`). An unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`.
A super admin account cannot be disabled here (the console shows super admin rows as
「不可修改」), which also keeps the caller from disabling itself: a target with
`is_super=true` is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`.
Only an active account is disabled; an account already disabled is 20902 with
`data.resource=admin_account` (refresh and look again).
Effects (BR-ID-43「停用后台账号」), in one transaction with the status change: every
admin_token, login ticket and step-up token of the account stops working at once (its
next request is 10001) and it cannot log in (10008 like a wrong password); its ticked
permission points are kept for a later enable; its past actions and audit records are
untouched; its username stays taken. Its export tasks in status pending or running are
cancelled (status cancelled, BR-ID-42; each cancellation writes its own audit record) and
can be neither downloaded nor retried. The response is the account as it is now
(`status=disabled`). Audit: action admin_account_disable with the reason and the
before / after status. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

example.reason: 该账号使用人已调岗，不再需要查询权限

200.description: The account, now disabled.

post.summary: Enable a disabled admin account again (super admin, step-up)
post.description:
Super admin only (04 §11 引言; otherwise 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`).
Step-up: totp tier (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with
`data.tier=totp`). No request body. An unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with
`data.fields=[admin_id]`; a target with `is_super=true` is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied` (super admin rows are 「不可修改」).
Only a disabled account is enabled; an active one is 20902 with
`data.resource=admin_account`. The account gets back the permission points it had when
disabled; no new initial password is issued and the authenticator binding is kept as it
was (an account still on its initial password or without a bound authenticator goes
through those login steps as before). Export tasks cancelled by the disable stay
cancelled. The response is the account as it is now (`status=active`). Audit: action
admin_account_enable with the before / after status. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The account, active again.

put.summary: Replace the ticked permission points of an ordinary admin account (super admin, step-up)
put.description:
Super admin only (04 §11 引言: ticking and unticking points is limited to super admins,
needs step-up and writes an audit record; otherwise 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`). Step-up: totp tier (without a valid totp-tier
`X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). An unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with
`data.fields=[admin_id]`; a target with `is_super=true` is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied` (a super admin holds every point and is not written
to admin_permissions, 04 §3.2). A disabled account can be edited; its points apply when
it is enabled again.
`permissions` is the whole set the account holds afterwards (an empty array unticks
everything): every key must be a value of contracts/enums/admin.yaml `admin_permission`
(04 §11.1, §11.2) and appear once, otherwise 20001 with `data.fields=[permissions]` and
nothing is written. There are no role templates (04 §11 引言).
CAS: `expected_row_version` is the account's `row_version` from GET
/admin/v1/admins/{admin_id} (or the list); any other value is 20902 with
`data.resource=admin_account` (another super admin changed the account meanwhile;
refresh and tick again).
The server checks the points on every request, so the change applies to the account's
next request; its console rebuilds the menu from GET /admin/v1/me/permissions. Audit:
action admin_permissions_save with the points before and after and the added and removed
keys. The response is the account as it is now (`row_version` + 1). No Idempotency-Key
(04 §6.6).

200.description: The account with its new permission points.

post.summary: Reset another admin account's authenticator (super admin, step-up, reason)
post.description:
Super admin only (otherwise 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`). Step-up:
totp tier (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`).
`reason` is required and says how the holder was confirmed to be who they claim (1–200
characters, else 20001 with `data.fields=[reason]`; BR-ID-43「重置身份验证器」). An
unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`.
Target: any other account, another super admin included (a super admin who lost the
authenticator is reset by another super admin; with a single super admin the owner uses
the operations command on the server, which is not an HTTP operation). The caller's own
account is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. A disabled account or one
without a bound authenticator is accepted as well.
Effects, in one transaction: the TOTP secret is discarded and the account is back to
not bound (`totp_bound=false`); every admin_token, login ticket and step-up token of the
account stops working at once; its next login binds a newly generated secret (`next`
bind_totp after the password, POST /admin/v1/auth/login). Permission points, status,
password and verify phone are unchanged. Audit: action admin_totp_reset with the reason.
The response is the account as it is now. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

example.reason: 本人换手机、旧验证器已不可用；已在企业微信视频通话里核对本人身份并确认

200.description: The account, with the authenticator no longer bound.

put.summary: Change the display name of an ordinary admin account (super admin)
put.description:
Super admin only (otherwise 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`); no
step-up. `display_name` is 1–32 characters after trimming (else 20001 with
`data.fields=[display_name]`; 04 §3.2 admin_users.display_name). An unknown `admin_id` is
20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`; a target with `is_super=true` is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied` (super admin rows are 「不可修改」). A disabled
account can be renamed. The login name (`username`) never changes. The new name shows
wherever the account is named (list, audit log `actor_name`, export `created_by_name`).
Audit: action admin_display_name_update with the name before and after. The response is
the account as it is now. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The account with its new display name.

post.summary: Send a code to the new verify phone of another admin account (super admin, step-up)
post.description:
First step of a super admin registering or changing another account's verify phone on
its holder's behalf (BR-ID-45 ③). Super admin only
(otherwise 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`). Step-up: totp tier, checked
here when the change is started (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003
with `data.tier=totp`). An unknown `admin_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[admin_id]`.
Target: an ordinary account only. The caller's own account and every other super admin
are 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`: a super admin changes its own phone
through POST /admin/v1/me/verify-phone/sms-codes (③), and super admin rows are
「不可修改」 on the accounts page.
`phone` is normalised (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」; not a mainland mobile number → 20001
with `data.fields=[phone]` and `data.reason=phone_invalid`); the account's current verify
phone is 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]`. The phone is not checked for uniqueness among
admin accounts (BR-ID-45 sets no such rule). A verification code is sent to that new
phone; the holder reads it to the super admin, who submits it with PUT
/admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/verify-phone. A change without the new phone's code is not
possible. Sending again for the same account replaces the earlier pending code. Until the
change succeeds the current verify phone stays valid and sms-tier step-up codes keep
going to it. Sending too often is 42901 with Retry-After; the send limits and the code
validity are those of POST /admin/v1/auth/step-up/sms-codes (not fixed by BR-ID-45), the
response states the values in force. Audit: action admin_verify_phone_code_send with the
target and the masked new phone.

200.description: The provider accepted the SMS, or its outcome is unknown (counted as sent).

put.summary: Register or change another admin account's verify phone with the new phone's code (super admin)
put.description:
Second step of the change started by POST /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/verify-phone/sms-codes
(BR-ID-45 ③). Super admin only (otherwise 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`); the step-up was made when the code was sent, so
no step-up token is checked here. Targets as for sending: an unknown `admin_id` is 20001
with `data.fields=[admin_id]`, the caller's own account and other super admins are 10403
with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. `reason` is required (1–200 characters, else
20001 with `data.fields=[reason]`). `phone` is normalised as for sending.
`code` must be the pending code sent to this `phone` for this account: a wrong code is
20002 without a reason; no pending code for this account and phone, an expired code or
one voided (by too many wrong tries, a newer send or a change that succeeded meanwhile)
is 20003 and nothing changes. Only a verified new phone takes effect: the verify phone is
replaced (stored encrypted with its blind index, BR-ID-33; `verify_phone_set_at` = now),
the pending code is used up and every other pending verify-phone code of the account is
voided; the old phone stops receiving sms-tier codes from then on. Sessions are not
revoked. Audit: action admin_verify_phone_change with the reason, the masked phones before
and after and that a super admin made it. The response is the account as it is now
(masked phone only). No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

example.reason: 本人委托超管代改（自助更换也不需要旧号短信）；已在企业微信视频通话里核对本人身份

200.description: The account with its new verify phone (masked).

get.summary: Search the audit log (own records, or everyone's with audit.view_all)
get.description:
Any signed-in admin account (no permission point needed, no step-up; 01 F-ADM-03, 04 §6.6
audit-logs). Records of the console's app, newest first (`at` descending, then the
server's internal order for the same time), page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200, above that 20001).
Visibility (04 §11.1 `audit.view_all`, enforced by the server, not by the console): an
account holding `audit.view_all` (a super admin holds every point) sees every account's
records and may filter by any `actor_id`; an account without it only sees its own records:
the server forces `actor_id` to the caller, so without `actor_id` it gets its own records
and with another account's `actor_id` it gets an empty page (`items=[]`, `total=0`), not an
error. An `actor_id` that names no account is an empty page as well.
A system row (below) belongs to no account: it has no `actor_id`, so it never matches an
`actor_id` filter, and an account without `audit.view_all` never sees one.
Filters combine with AND: `actor_id` (the admin who acted), `target_type` and `target_id`
(exact match), `permission` (the permission point the action was done under), `from`
(inclusive) and `to` (exclusive), ISO 8601 times with offset (04 §5); `from` later than
`to` is 20001 with `data.fields=[from, to]`. `target_type`, `target_id` and `permission`
are derived by the server from the stored record (the action and its target); a record
they cannot be derived for (older rows, actions without an object) returns them as null
and never matches a filter on that field. `target_type` is free text, not an enum.
Each row has the actor's current name (`actor_name`: admin_users.display_name, the username
when that is empty, null when the account is gone),
never the before / after values (GET /admin/v1/audit-logs/{id}). Searching does not write
an audit record itself.
System rows (D10-552; actions the system took under its own identity, such as an automatic
order hold, BR-FUND-06, audited as BR-ID-34 asks): `actor_id` is null, `actor_kind` is
`system`, `system_actor` has the value (enum audit_system_actor) and `actor_name` is that
value's Chinese name from the enum. Rows of an admin account carry neither `actor_kind` nor
`system_actor`. The list, the detail and the export read the same way.

parameters.name: actor_id
parameters.description:
admin_id of the account that acted. Without audit.view_all the server forces it to the
caller (another value → empty page). System rows have no actor_id and never match.

parameters.name: target_type
parameters.description: Object type of the record (free text, exact match), such as user.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Object id of the record (exact match), such as a user_id.

parameters.name: permission
parameters.description: Permission point the action was done under (enum admin_permission).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest record time, inclusive (ISO 8601 with offset).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest record time, exclusive (ISO 8601 with offset).

200.description: One page of audit records, newest first.

get.summary: One audit record with its before and after values
get.description:
Any signed-in admin account (no permission point needed, no step-up; 01 F-ADM-03, 04 §6.6
audit-logs). Same fields as a list row plus `before` and `after`: the stored values as
written by the action (any JSON, null when the action recorded none; sensitive fields are
stored masked, so they are shown masked). Without `audit.view_all` (04 §11.1) only the
caller's own records are found: another account's record is 20001 with `data.fields=[id]`,
the same as an unknown id or a record of another app (no probing). A system row (D10-552)
reads as on the list (`actor_id` null, `actor_kind=system`, `system_actor`, `actor_name`
from the enum) and is no account's own record, so without `audit.view_all` it is 20001 as
well. Reading a record does not write an audit record itself.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
opaque id of the audit record (as listed); unknown, of another app or not visible → 20001
with data.fields=[id].

200.description: The audit record.

post.summary: Create an export task from a list's filters (asynchronous CSV, masked by default)
post.description:
Permission point `export` (04 §11.1) and, in addition, the permission of the source list
itself (enum export_resource: `users` needs `user.list`; `audit_logs` needs no more than
being signed in; `tax_withdrawals` has its own rule, see below); lacking either is 10403
with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. The
task is generated asynchronously as one CSV file in a private object-storage bucket
(BR-ID-34 细则「后台导出任务」); the response is 202 with the new task in status pending.
Each call creates a new task (no Idempotency-Key, 04 §6.6).
`filters` has the same shape as the query parameters of the source list (paging excluded)
and is judged like them: `users` takes `risk_state` (GET /admin/v1/users); `audit_logs`
takes `actor_id`, `target_type`, `target_id`, `permission`, `from`, `to` (GET
/admin/v1/audit-logs; `from` later than `to` is 20001 with `data.fields=[from, to]`, as on
the list). The file holds the rows the source list would
show for these filters to the creator, with the list's columns. An `audit_logs` export
applies the same own-records rule as the list (04 §11.1 `audit.view_all`): without
`audit.view_all` the server forces `actor_id` to the creator, and another account's
`actor_id` gives an empty file (status done, `row_count=0`), not an error. System rows
(D10-552) follow the list as well: they match no `actor_id` filter, an export without
`audit.view_all` holds none. The file's columns stay the same: a system row has `actor_id`
empty and `actor_name` holding the system's Chinese name.
Masking: by default every export is masked like its source list (the phone number 3 + 4,
BR-ID-33) and the task has `masked=true`. Apart from `tax_withdrawals` (see below), only a
`users` export may ask for the full values
with `unmasked: true`; then the creator must hold `pii.reveal_phone` (the users list's only
sensitive column; otherwise 10403), send a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` (the tier of
`pii.reveal_phone`; missing, expired or lower → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`) and give
`reason` (1–200 characters; missing → 20001 with `data.fields=[reason]`). `reason` without
`unmasked: true` is 20001 with `data.fields=[reason]`; an `audit_logs` request takes
neither field (audit values are stored masked) and either one is 20001. Without
`unmasked: true` no step-up token is needed and none is checked.
Audit (BR-ID-34): creating writes an audit record (action export_create: task id, resource,
