get.summary: Station-owner union accounts with their authorization status (not paged)
get.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (04 §11.2; read only, no step-up, 01 F-ADM-16);
lacking it is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Every union account of
the console's app, not paged, ordered by platform then account_name (04 §6.6
union-accounts). Each row: `union_account_id`, `platform`, `account_name`, `status`,
`sync_start_at`, `auth_expires_at`, `auth_expires_estimated`, `auth_status`,
`auth_renewed_at`, `auth_renewed_by`, `last_probe_at`, `last_probe_ok`,
`last_probe_error`, and the derived `alert_phones_configured` (false → the page shows
「未配置告警手机号」, BR-ID-24 ②) and `reauth_mode` (BR-ID-24 细则「后台告警手机号与重新授权会话」:
`oauth` → POST …/{union_account_id}/reauthorize, `manual` → PUT
…/{union_account_id}/credential, `none` → no renewal entry). `auth_expires_estimated` is
true when the expiry is estimated (the page marks it 「估算」): for `oauth`, the union
returned no expiry and the server took the authorization time + 90 days; for `manual`,
the entry time + that platform's Key validity from the platform registry (BR-ID-24 细则
「none 与 manual 平台的到期、探测与提醒」, ruling D10-196). For `none`, `auth_expires_at` is null. `auth_renewed_by` is null for an
automatic refresh (BR-ID-24 细则「后台联盟账号列表」). The reminder stage
(union_accounts.alert_stage) and every credential (tokens, keys) are never returned.
`status` is union_accounts.status as stored; its values are registered with B1-22 and
are not an enum here yet.

200.description: All union accounts of the app.

post.summary: Start an OAuth re-authorization of a station-owner union account
post.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`; 01 F-ADM-16). The body holds
only an optional `reason` (1–200 characters, else 20001 with `data.fields=[reason]`;
BR-ID-24 细则「后台联盟账号列表」).
Only for an account whose `reauth_mode` is `oauth` (any platform whose station-owner
authorization is OAuth, BR-ID-24 细则「后台告警手机号与重新授权会话」, orchestrator ruling
D10-159). `reauth_mode=none` (no station-owner credential to renew, registered from
规划/09 CAP-*-12) is 20001 with `data.fields=[union_account_id]`, a fact of the platform
and not a policy refusal. A `reauth_mode=manual` account (such as the JD 推客授权 Key,
CAP-JD-12) is renewed through PUT /admin/v1/union-accounts/{union_account_id}/credential
instead; the console never offers this operation for it, and a call here is 20001 with
`data.fields=[union_account_id]` and `data.reason=manual_mode`, so it is told apart from
`reauth_mode=none` (no reason; orchestrator ruling D10-176). An
unknown `union_account_id`, or one of another app, is 20001 with
`data.fields=[union_account_id]`.
Each call creates one admin_union_auth_sessions row (union_account_id, created_by = the
signed-in admin, status pending, state stored as a hash only) and answers its
`session_id`, the union's authorization address `auth_url` and `expires_at`: the state is
single use and valid 10 minutes, the address as long (BR-ID-24 细则; the user-side
union_auth_sessions are not reused). Earlier pending sessions of the account are left to
expire. The console opens `auth_url`; the union sends the browser back to the console
page `<console origin>/unions/oauth-callback`, which posts what it received to POST
/admin/v1/union-accounts/oauth/callback and gets the result; a console window that did not
receive the callback polls GET
/admin/v1/union-accounts/{union_account_id}/reauthorize/{session_id} instead.
Writes an audit record (action union_account_reauthorize_start, reason). No
Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The new session and the address to open.

get.summary: Result of one re-authorization session (polled by the console)
get.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (read only, no step-up); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. The console polls this while the authorization
window is open, or after the callback page reported back (04 §6.6 union-accounts, BR-ID-24
细则). `status`: `pending` (not finished; turns `expired` once `expires_at` has passed
without a callback), `succeeded` (the credential, auth_expires_at, auth_renewed_at and
auth_renewed_by were updated and audited, BR-ID-24 ③), `failed` (the callback came back
without a usable grant; `error` holds the recorded cause) or `expired`. `error` is a
short cause recorded by the server, never a token, code or credential; its values are
registered with B1-22 and are not an enum here yet. `finished_at` is set with the final
status. An unknown `union_account_id` is 20001 with `data.fields=[union_account_id]`; an
unknown `session_id`, or one of another union account, is 20001 with
`data.fields=[session_id]`.

200.description: The session as it is now.

post.summary: Hand the union's OAuth callback to the server and finish the session
post.description:
Finishes a station-owner authorization started by POST
/admin/v1/union-accounts/{union_account_id}/reauthorize (12 §9 T-08). The union's
redirect address is the console page `<console origin>/unions/oauth-callback` (a console
route, not an API path); that page posts the `state` and `code` (or the union's `error`)
it received here, with the signed-in admin_token, then shows the result. Permission point
`union.account_auth`; lacking it is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. No
step-up: the start already required one, and the state is single use.
The session is found by the hash of `state` only (BR-ID-24 细则「后台告警手机号与重新授权会话」).
`state` missing, unknown, or of a session started by another admin account is 20001
with `data.fields=[state]`; neither or both of `code` and `error` is 20001 with
`data.fields=[code]`. A pending session within `expires_at` is marked used, the grant
(`code`) is exchanged with the union, and on success the credential is stored encrypted
in union_credentials and auth_expires_at (from the union, else authorization time + 90
days with auth_expires_estimated = true), auth_renewed_at, auth_renewed_by (the
session's created_by) and auth_status are updated and an audit record is written (action
union_account_reauthorize, BR-ID-24 ③); the session becomes succeeded. A missing
`code`, an `error` from the union or a failed exchange makes it failed with the cause in
`error`. A pending session past `expires_at` becomes expired. A session that is no
longer pending is answered as it is, nothing is exchanged again. The answer is always the
session as GET …/{union_account_id}/reauthorize/{session_id} returns it, so the page
needs no second call. `code` and the tokens are never logged or returned. Whether the
granted account is the same station-owner account as the session's union account is
checked where the union's grant names the account (B1-22, per platform registry in
specs/union). No Idempotency-Key.

declined.summary: The union sent an error instead of a code

200.description: The session as it is now.

put.summary: Enter a new station-owner credential by hand (reauth_mode manual)
put.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). For an account whose
`reauth_mode` is `manual` only: a station-owner credential that is not OAuth but that
the owner takes again from the union's own console, such as the JD 推客授权 Key
(CAP-JD-12; BR-ID-24 细则「后台告警手机号与重新授权会话」, orchestrator ruling D10-159 and
its supplement). Any other `reauth_mode`, an unknown `union_account_id` or one of
another app is 20001 with `data.fields=[union_account_id]`.
Body checks (20001 with `data.fields` naming the field): `credential` 1–512 characters
without surrounding whitespace; `expires_at`, when given, later than now; `reason`
optional, 1–200 characters. The plaintext `credential` only goes into encryption: it is
stored encrypted in union_credentials and is never logged, audited, echoed or returned.
Effects, in one transaction (BR-ID-24 ③): the credential replaces the current one;
auth_expires_at = `expires_at` with auth_expires_estimated = false, or, without
`expires_at`, now + that platform's Key validity with auth_expires_estimated = true —
the validity is read from the platform registry configuration, not fixed (documented
365 days for the JD 推客授权 Key, pending CAP-JD-12; BR-ID-24 细则「none 与 manual
平台的到期、探测与提醒」, ruling D10-196);
auth_renewed_at = now, auth_renewed_by = the signed-in admin; auth_status and the
reminder stage are recomputed from the new expiry (an account expired by a probe or
call recovers, BR-ID-24 ④). The union is not called here; the next daily probe checks
the new credential (BR-ID-24 ①). Writes an audit record (action
union_account_credential, reason; never the credential). The response is the account as
GET /admin/v1/union-accounts lists it now. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

get.summary: Station-owner alert phone numbers (masked)
get.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (read only, no step-up); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. The numbers that get the station-owner
authorization SMS (BR-ID-24 ②). They are kept encrypted as one group in the
configuration key `union.auth_alert_phones` (04 §10.1; the general config-items
operations neither return nor accept that key), and are changed only through this
resource (orchestrator ruling D10-152). Each item has `phone_masked` (3 + 4, BR-ID-33)
and `phone_id`, the HMAC of the normalized number (BR-ID-05 细则), used to remove it;
the full number is never returned by any operation of this resource. `version` is the
version of the whole item, the `expected_version` of the writes (0 = never written).
At most 10 numbers (BR-ID-24 细则).

post.summary: Add an alert phone number
post.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`; 01 F-ADM-16). Order of
checks, the first hit is returned: permission, step-up → body (20001 with `data.fields`
naming the field; `reason` optional, 1–200 characters) → `phone` normalized by BR-ID-05
细则「手机号规范化」, not a mainland 11-digit number → 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]` and
`data.reason=phone_invalid` (as users/{user_id}/profile) → CAS: `expected_version` is
the `version` of GET /admin/v1/union-accounts/alert-phones; a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=config_item`, refresh and retry → the same number already present →
success, nothing added and `version` unchanged → already 10 numbers → 20001 with
`data.fields=[phone]` without a reason (the console tells it apart by the count;
BR-ID-24 细则). Otherwise the number is added to the encrypted group and `version` goes
up by 1. Writes an audit record (action union_alert_phone_add, the masked number,
reason) for every accepted call. The response is the list as GET returns it now. No
Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

delete.description:
Permission point `union.account_auth` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). No body and no reason: the
query holds only the identifiers `phone_id` and `expected_version`, so no free text
reaches the URL or the access log (04 §6.6, orchestrator 2026-10-22). `phone_id` is a
query parameter here, not the path segment of 04 §6.6
(`/admin/v1/union-accounts/alert-phones/{phone_id}`): that path is ambiguous with
`/admin/v1/union-accounts/{union_account_id}/reauthorize` under the contract lint
(no-ambiguous-paths). `phone_id` or `expected_version` missing or malformed → 20001
with `data.fields` naming it; a mismatch with the group's current
`version` → 20902 with `data.resource=config_item`, refresh and retry; then a `phone_id`
not in the group → 20001 with `data.fields=[phone_id]`. Otherwise the number is removed
and `version` goes up by 1; removing the last one leaves the group empty (only console
alerts then, BR-ID-24 ②). Writes an audit record (action union_alert_phone_remove, the
masked number). The response is the list as GET returns it now. No Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Union account choices for the PID registration form (not paged)
get.description:
Permission point `union.pid` or `union.account_auth` (either is enough; 04 §11.2; read
only, no step-up); lacking both is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. The
least-privilege read behind the union account dropdown of the PID (推广位) registration
form (POST /admin/v1/union-pids, 04 §6.6 union-pids; BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台登记与启停」):
an account holding only `union.pid` reads the choices here, while GET
/admin/v1/union-accounts keeps `union.account_auth` alone (orchestrator ruling D10-243;
04 §6.6 union-accounts). Every union account of the console's app, or with `platform`
only those of that platform (a value outside enum platform is 20001 with
`data.fields=[platform]`); not paged, the same as GET /admin/v1/union-accounts; ordered by
platform, then account_name, then union_account_id. Each row carries only
`union_account_id`, `platform` and `account_name`, the same values as the row of GET
/admin/v1/union-accounts: no status, authorization or expiry fields, no probe results,
no alert or re-authorization fields, and never the reminder stage or any credential. An
account is listed whatever its status or authorization state; whether a PID may be
registered under it is decided by POST /admin/v1/union-pids alone. Reading does not
write an audit record.

get.summary: Registered PIDs (推广位) of the app (not paged)
get.description:
Permission point `union.pid` (04 §11.2; read only, no step-up); lacking it is 10403
with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Every union_pids row of the console's app in
all three statuses, not paged, ordered by platform, pid_scene, then created_at. Rows are
never deleted (BR-ATTR-02): pending, active and retired all stay on the whitelist, and
the status only decides whether the PID is used for new links (pending → active →
retired, BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台登记与启停」). `hjy_ignore_evidence_path` is the private OSS
object path of the 花卷云 ignore screenshot (BR-ATTR-28), null until activation; viewing
the screenshot is not part of this contract.

post.summary: Register a PID (always pending)
post.description:
Permission point `union.pid` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Body checks, each 20001
with `data.fields` naming the field (04 §6.6 union-pids): `platform` not in enum
platform; `union_account_id` unknown, of another app or of another platform;
`site_id` missing for taobao, or given (not null) for any other platform; `pid` or
`site_id` not 1–64 of [0-9A-Za-z_-]; `pid_scene` not in enum pid_scene; `reason`
optional, 1–200 characters; the same (app, platform, pid) already registered, in any
status → `data.fields=[pid]`. A new row is always pending (BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台登记与启停」);
registering the first PID of a union account writes that account's sync_start_at in the
same transaction, later registrations do not change it (BR-ATTR-02). Writes an audit
record (action union_pid_create, the new row, reason). The response is the new row. No
Idempotency-Key and no DELETE (BR-ATTR-02).

patch.description:
Permission point `union.pid` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Only a pending row can be
changed (orchestrator ruling D10-159, BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台修改与启用的裁定」): any of
`platform`, `union_account_id`, `site_id`, `pid`, `pid_scene` (at least one, else
20001 with `data.fields=[body]`), with `expected_row_version` and an optional `reason`. An unknown `pid_id`, or one of another
app, is 20001 with `data.fields=[pid_id]`. The row after the change is checked as POST
/admin/v1/union-pids checks a new one (20001 with `data.fields` naming the field; the
same (app, platform, pid) on another row → `[pid]`). The row is not pending (active or
retired), or `expected_row_version` differs from its row_version → 20902 with
`data.resource=union_pid`, refresh. To replace an active PID, register a new one, finish
its 花卷云 ignore registration, then retire the old one and activate the new one at once
(BR-ATTR-02 细则). Changing a pending row never changes a sync_start_at already written;
moving it to a union account without one writes that account's sync_start_at at the time
of the change (BR-ATTR-02 细则). row_version goes up by 1. Writes an audit record (action
union_pid_update, before and after values, reason). The response is the row as it is
now. No Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Activate a pending PID, with the 花卷云 ignore confirmation and screenshot
post.description:
Permission point `union.pid` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). `multipart/form-data` with
the parts `expected_row_version`, `hjy_ignore_confirmed_at` (when the 花卷云 ignore was
confirmed, not later than now), the screenshot file `hjy_ignore_evidence` (PNG or JPEG,
at most 5 MB) and an optional `reason` (1–200 characters) (BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台修改与启用的裁定」,
BR-ATTR-28, orchestrator ruling D10-152). Order of checks, the first hit is returned:
permission, step-up → an unknown `pid_id`, or one of another app, 20001 with
`data.fields=[pid_id]` → parts: the 花卷云 items missing → 20001 with `data.fields`
listing the missing ones (`[hjy_ignore_confirmed_at, hjy_ignore_evidence]` when both
are), the screenshot not PNG / JPEG or above 5 MB → 20001 with
`data.fields=[hjy_ignore_evidence]`, another part invalid → 20001 naming it → the row is
not pending, or `expected_row_version` differs → 20902 with `data.resource=union_pid` →
another PID of the same app × platform × union account (union_account_id) × pid_scene
is active → 30155 (only one active per union account and scene; PIDs of other union
accounts of the same platform and scene may be active at the same time; retire it
first, BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台修改与启用的裁定」, orchestrator ruling D10-231). A request body
above the global limit stays 413 with `data.fields=[body]`. Effects, in one
transaction: the screenshot is stored in the private OSS bucket and its path written
to hjy_ignore_evidence_path, with hjy_ignore_confirmed_at, status becomes active and
row_version goes up by 1; which union account's active PID a new link of the scene
uses follows BR-ATTR-05 细则 ⑦ (Taobao / Pinduoduo: the bound account's; JD: the
earliest-activated active PID of the scene), so activating this PID does not by itself
switch other accounts' links.
The partial unique index on (app, platform, union_account_id, pid_scene) for active
rows is the last line against a concurrent second activation, which also answers
30155. Writes an audit record (action union_pid_activate, reason). The response is
the row as it is now. No Idempotency-Key.

200.description: The row as it is now (active).

413.description: Request body above the global limit (20001 with data.fields=[body]).

post.summary: Retire an active PID (stays on the whitelist)
post.description:
Permission point `union.pid` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Body `expected_row_version`
and an optional `reason` (1–200 characters; 20001 with `data.fields` naming a bad
field). An unknown `pid_id`, or one of another app, is 20001 with `data.fields=[pid_id]`.
Only active → retired (BR-ATTR-02 细则「后台登记与启停」): a pending or retired row, or an
`expected_row_version` that differs, is 20902 with `data.resource=union_pid`. There is no
pending → retired and no retired → active. A retired PID stays on the whitelist, so
orders from links already sent keep coming in (BR-ATTR-02 「为什么保留 retired」); retiring
leaves that union account without an active PID in the scene until one is activated,
and which account's active PID new links of the scene use follows BR-ATTR-05 细则 ⑦
(Taobao / Pinduoduo: the bound account's; JD: the earliest-activated active PID).
row_version goes up by 1. Writes an audit record (action union_pid_retire, reason). The
response is the row as it is now. No Idempotency-Key.

200.description: The row as it is now (retired).

get.summary: Platform marks and their published replacement images
get.description: Permission point `content.platform_icon` (04 §11.2; step-up 「–」). One row per platform mark key (enum platform_icon_key, the same keys as /v1/config `platform_icons`), always all of them in enum order, no paging: the published version (`current_version` null = the client shows the image bundled in the package), its details, the newest saved version and who changed the mark last and when (BR-TEXT-24 细则「发布与回滚」), and the mark's `revision`, the CAS value of publish and restore-builtin. The console previews `current.url` and every version url only as an image (``), never inlined into the page.

200.description: Every platform mark with its published version.

get.summary: Version history of one platform mark
get.description:
Permission point `content.platform_icon`. Every saved version of the mark, newest first,
page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200), drafts included; a version is `publishable` only
with both the source page address and the download date registered (BR-TEXT-24 细则
「必填登记」). Any version can be published again, which rolls the mark back to it (POST
/admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/publish). A key outside enum platform_icon_key is 20001 with
`data.fields=[key]`.

200.description: One page of versions, newest first.

post.summary: Save an upload as a new version of one platform mark
post.description:
Permission point `content.platform_icon`. Saves the cleaned file of an upload (POST
/admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/uploads) as the next version of the mark (versions are
counted per mark from 1). Nothing is published: the version takes effect only through
POST /admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/publish. When the upload has `sanitized=true` the
operator must have looked at the cleaned preview and `sanitized_confirmed` must be true,
otherwise 20001 with `data.fields=[sanitized_confirmed]` (BR-TEXT-24 细则「已清除不安全内容」).
`source_url` (the official brand or asset download page) and `downloaded_on` may be left
out: such a version is a draft (`publishable=false`) until both are registered with PATCH
/admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/versions/{version} (BR-TEXT-24 细则「必填登记」). Saving
is naturally idempotent: an upload_id this mark has already saved as a version (a retry
after a lost response) returns 200 with that existing version as it is now, creates no
second version and applies nothing else from the retried body. An upload_id that does not
exist, has expired or belongs to another key is 20001 with `data.fields=[upload_id]`. No
Idempotency-Key: admin writes rely on these checks and on CAS where state is replaced
(04 §6.6).

draft.summary: Cleaned SVG confirmed, no source registered yet (saved as a draft)

complete.summary: PNG with source page and download date (publishable)

200.description: The new version, or the version this upload_id was already saved as.

draft.summary: Saved as a draft (source not registered)

post.summary: Upload a platform mark image and get its cleaned preview
post.description: Permission point `content.platform_icon`. `multipart/form-data` with one part `file`: an SVG, or a PNG with a transparent background and sides of at least 512 px, at most `content.platform_icon.max_bytes` bytes (default 204800; BR-TEXT-24 细则「上传与发布」). The server first converts an SVG faithfully (in-document `use` expanded, simple style declarations rewritten as presentation attributes), then cleans it against the whitelist; the result is stored in the OSS media bucket under its content SHA-256 and returned as `url` for an `` preview on light and dark backgrounds at 16, 24 and 32 px. Nothing is saved as a version yet (POST /admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/versions takes the `upload_id` until `expires_at`). `sanitized=true` means the cleaned file differs from the original: the console shows 「已清除不安全内容」 and the operator confirms the preview before saving. Rejections are 20001 with `data.fields=[file]` and an admin-only `data.reason` (shown next to the field with admin text, not in the user dictionary): `icon_format_invalid` (not SVG or PNG, cannot be parsed, PNG side below 512 px or above 4096 px, or not transparent), `icon_too_large` (above the configured limit) and `icon_svg_unconvertible` (style sheet with complex selectors, `@` rules or declarations outside the list, a `url(...)` outside the document, a reference cycle or external reference, or a conversion limit hit: more than 5000 elements, nesting deeper than 8, output above four times the limit, longer than 2 seconds; the console says 「请换一份不含样式表或外部引用的官方 SVG， 或改传 PNG」). A request body above the global limit stays 413 with `data.fields=[body]`.

200.description: The cleaned file, ready to be previewed and saved.

sanitized.summary: SVG whose cleaned file differs from the original (operator must confirm)

413.description: Request body above the global limit (20001 with data.fields=[body]).

patch.summary: Register the source of a platform mark version
patch.description:
Permission point `content.platform_icon`. Fills in or corrects `source_url` and
`downloaded_on` of a version that has never been published (BR-TEXT-24 细则「必填登记」);
a field left out is unchanged, at least one is required. With both registered the version
becomes `publishable`. CAS: `expected_revision` is the version's `revision` the console
showed; every registration change adds 1 to it, and a mismatch (someone else registered in
between) → 20902 with `data.resource=platform_icon`, refresh and retry (04 §6.6). A
version that has ever been published keeps its registration as published and is 20001
with `data.fields=[version]`, like an unknown version.

200.description: The version with its registration.

post.summary: Publish a version of a platform mark (publish or roll back)
post.description:
Permission point `content.platform_icon`. Makes `version` the published image of the mark
at once, with no gradual rollout (BR-TEXT-24 细则「发布与回滚」); the next GET /v1/config
lists it in `platform_icons` with the version's cleaned file url, its SHA-256 and the
version number (ConfigPlatformIcon). Publishing a version older than the current one is a
rollback; both are written to the audit log (action publish or rollback). CAS:
`expected_revision` is the mark's `revision` the console showed. The revision only ever
grows (every publish, rollback and restore-builtin adds 1), so a stale request, including
a retry of one that already took effect, never matches again: a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=platform_icon`, refresh and retry (04 §6.6). Publishing the version that is
already current with a matching revision succeeds without change, revision bump or audit.
A version missing source registrations is 20001 with `data.fields` listing every missing
one (`[source_url]`, `[downloaded_on]`, or `[source_url, downloaded_on]` when both are
missing); an unknown version is 20001 with `data.fields=[version]`.

publish.summary: First replacement image over the built-in one

200.description: The mark with its new published version.

post.summary: Restore the built-in image of a platform mark
post.description:
Permission point `content.platform_icon`. 「恢复内置」 (BR-TEXT-24 细则「发布与回滚」): the
mark has no published version any more, the next GET /v1/config leaves its key out of
`platform_icons` and clients show the bundled image; saved versions are kept and can be
published again. Written to the audit log (action restore_builtin). CAS as in publish:
`expected_revision` is the mark's `revision` the console showed, the restore adds 1 to it,
and a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=platform_icon`. Restoring a mark that already
shows the built-in image (with a matching revision) succeeds without change, revision
bump or audit.

200.description: The mark, now on its built-in image.

get.summary: Configured pages with their released and gray versions
get.description:
Permission point `content.page` (04 §11.2; step-up 「–」). One row per page that has at
least one saved version (`home`, `custom:*`), ordered by page_key, page by page (`page`,
`page_size` ≤ 200): the fully released version, the gray version and its percentage, the
newest saved version, who changed the page last and when, and the page's `revision`, the
CAS value of every page write (04 §6.6 `pages`; 编排者默认).

200.description: One page of configured pages.

post.summary: Upload a home popup animation or picture
post.description:
Permission point `content.page`, no step-up (04 §6.6 `pages`「弹窗素材上传」).
`multipart/form-data` with two parts: `kind` (`lottie` | `image`) and `file`. The server
checks the file against BR-TEXT-26 细则「素材与校验」 and stores it in the OSS media bucket
under its content SHA-256: the same content uploaded again returns the same `url`. The
upload changes no page version; the console writes `url` and `sha256` into the popup
props (`lottie` = {url, sha256}, `image` = url; contracts/home-schema.json) only when the
draft is saved (POST /admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/versions). `kind=lottie`: one Lottie JSON
of at most 300 KB that parses as a JSON object with `v`, `fr`, `ip`, `op`, `w`, `h` and
`layers`; duration (`op` − `ip`) ÷ `fr` above 0 and at most 3 seconds; images in `assets`
only inlined as data URIs; dotLottie is not accepted. The response adds `width`, `height`
(from `w`, `h`) and `duration_ms`. `kind=image`: the popup picture, also the static
fallback when an animation is set, with the same requirements as a popup picture without
animation. An aspect ratio that differs from the fallback picture by more than 2 % is
only flagged by the console, never rejected here. Rejections are 20001 with
`data.fields=[file]` (`[kind]` when `kind` is missing or not one of the two) and an
admin-only `data.reason` (shown next to the field with admin text, not in the user
dictionary): `format` (not a Lottie JSON object, a required key missing, dotLottie, or a
picture of the wrong format), `too_large` (above the size limit), `too_long` (duration not
above 0 or above 3 seconds) and `external_ref` (an `assets` entry pointing to a web
address or a relative path). A request body above the global limit stays 413 with
`data.fields=[body]`.

200.description: The stored file (the same url for the same content).

lottie.summary: Lottie animation (with its size and duration)

image.summary: Popup picture or static fallback picture

413.description: Request body above the global limit (20001 with data.fields=[body]).

get.summary: One configured page
get.description:
Permission point `content.page`. The page's released and gray versions, newest saved
version, last change and `revision` (the CAS value of every page write). A page_key of the
right shape with no saved version → 30701.

200.description: The page.

get.summary: Version history of one page
get.description:
Permission point `content.page`. Every saved version of the page, newest first, page by
page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200), drafts and rolled-back versions included, without their
sections (read one version for those). render_count and error_count stay 0 until the
render report of TECH-29 exists (编排者默认). A page_key of the right shape with no saved
version → 30701.

200.description: One page of versions, newest first.

post.summary: Save a draft as a new version of one page
post.description:
Permission point `content.page`. Saves `sections` as a new draft version (number = newest
version + 1, counted per page from 1); a saved version's content never changes again, so a
preview token stays pinned to what it shows (编排者默认). The first save creates the page.
Nothing is published: the draft takes effect only through POST
/admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/publish. Saving runs the same checks as publishing (04 §6.6):
jump targets (an ExternalPage url whose host is in the `union_host` category of the
platform link-pattern table while switch `external_page.union_host_block` is on, BR-ATTR-29
①; personal-data placeholders in an external url, BR-ID-33 细则「外链不带个人数据」;
Withdraw, PayoutAccount, LaborAgreement or RealName with params, BR-WDR-01 细则), the
notice_bar api data source (only the notice CMS, 03 §6.3) and union_material channels (only
selectable channels of specs/material-channels.yaml, BR-TEXT-17 细则「联盟物料频道」) and
a popup's `props.lottie` (only the reference: `url` on the media domain and its file name
equal to `sha256`; the file itself was checked by POST /admin/v1/pages/popup-assets, 04
§6.2, BR-TEXT-26 细则「素材与校验」); a failure is 20001 with `data.fields` naming the
offending field as a dotted path with array indexes (e.g. `sections.0.data_source`,
`sections.3.props.lottie`), no `data.reason` (编排者默认). CAS:
`expected_revision` is the page's `revision` the console showed, 0 for a page not saved
yet; saving adds 1, and a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=page` (编排者默认: drafts
are whole pages, so two editors must not save over each other unseen).

200.description: The new draft version.

get.summary: One version of a page with its sections
get.description:
Permission point `content.page`. One saved version with its sections as stored. A
page_key of the right shape with no saved version, or a version the page does not have →
30701.

200.description: The version.

post.summary: Publish a draft version of a page (full or gray)
post.description:
Permission point `content.page`. Publishes the draft `version` after the same checks as
saving a draft (20001 with `data.fields` as a dotted path, see POST
/admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/versions). `gray_percent` 100 makes it the fully released
version (the previous one stays published but is no longer current); 1..99 makes it the
gray version, served to devices whose bucket is below gray_percent×100 (OPS-05); 0 is not
accepted, a gray version is stopped by rolling it back (编排者默认). Edges (编排者默认): a
page without a fully released version accepts only 100, otherwise 20001 with
`data.fields=[gray_percent]`; while a gray version exists no other version can be
published, 20001 with `data.fields=[version]` (release it fully or roll it back first); a
version that does not exist or is not a draft is 20001 with `data.fields=[version]`. CAS:
`expected_revision` is the page's `revision` the console showed; publishing adds 1, so a
stale request, including a retry of one that already took effect, never matches again: a
mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=page`. A page with no saved version → 30701. Written
to the audit log.

Scheduled publish (编排者默认): with `publish_at` the request is checked exactly as an
immediate publish (version, gray_percent and sections, in the same order and with the same
`data.fields`), and also: `publish_at` not later than now, or more than 30 days after now,
→ 20001 with `data.fields=[publish_at]`; while the page already has a pending schedule any
publish, immediate or scheduled, → 20001 with `data.fields=[publish_at]` (cancel it first
with DELETE /admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/schedule; it is never overwritten). On success the
version stays draft and the page keeps one pending schedule (version, gray_percent,
publish_at, the admin who scheduled it) shown as `scheduled`; revision adds 1 and the
request is written to the audit log. At `publish_at` the schedule takes effect as an
immediate publish would have then (100 = fully released, 1..99 = gray; the version's
`publish_at` is the scheduled time and its `publisher` the admin who scheduled it; revision
adds 1 again), judged by time and not by whether the scheduled job has run. While a
schedule is pending, gray changes, rollbacks and draft saves work as usual. Without
`publish_at` the request is an immediate publish and behaves as above.

scheduled.summary: Publish version 8 to everyone at 08:00 the next morning

200.description: The page with its new released or gray version.

delete.summary: Cancel the pending scheduled publish of a page
delete.description:
Permission point `content.page`. Cancels the page's pending scheduled publish (see POST
/admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/publish with `publish_at`); the version stays draft. A page
without a pending schedule, because none was made, it was cancelled, or its `publish_at`
has passed so it already took effect (judged by time and not by whether the scheduled job
has run), → 30701 (编排者默认). CAS as in publish: `expected_revision` (query) is the
page's `revision` the console showed, the cancel adds 1, and a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=page`. A page with no saved version → 30701. Written to the audit log.

parameters.name: expected_revision
parameters.description: The page's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

200.description: The page without a pending schedule.

post.summary: Change the gray percentage of a page, or release the gray version fully
post.description:
Permission point `content.page`. Sets the gray percentage of the page's gray version
(1..99), or with 100 releases it fully: the gray version becomes the fully released
version and the page has no gray version any more (编排者默认). A page without a gray
version is 20001 with `data.fields=[gray_percent]`. CAS as in publish: `expected_revision`
is the page's `revision` the console showed, the change adds 1, and a mismatch → 20902
with `data.resource=page`. A page with no saved version → 30701. Written to the audit
log.

widen.summary: Widen the gray version to half of the devices

release.summary: Release the gray version to everyone

200.description: The page with its new gray percentage or released version.

post.summary: Roll back the gray or the fully released version of a page
post.description:
Permission point `content.page`. `version` must be the page's current gray version or
current fully released version, otherwise 20001 with `data.fields=[version]` (编排者默认).
Rolling back the gray version marks it rolled_back and leaves the page without a gray
version. Rolling back the fully released version (only while there is no gray version,
otherwise 20001 with `data.fields=[version]`) marks it rolled_back and makes the published
version with the latest publish_at among the page's other published versions the fully
released one (ties: higher version); without one → 20001 with `data.fields=[version]`
(version numbers are save order, not publish order). Nothing is republished under a new
number: the version numbers clients saw stay as they were. CAS as in publish: `expected_revision` is the page's
`revision` the console showed, the rollback adds 1, and a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=page`. A page with no saved version → 30701. Written to the audit log.

200.description: The page after the rollback.

post.summary: Issue a preview token for one version of a page
post.description:
Permission point `content.page` (「草稿预览二维码」, TECH-11). Issues a read-only preview
token for `version`, in any status (编排者默认), valid 10 minutes and only in the
environment that issued it; the test build's HomePreview route reads the version with it
through GET /v1/pages/{page_key}/preview. The console draws the QR code from `token` and
`page_key` only, with no host name (03 §3.6); no deep link is returned (编排者默认). A
version the page does not have is 20001 with `data.fields=[version]`; a page with no saved
version → 30701. Written to the audit log.

200.description: The preview token.

get.summary: Published versions of the agreements and public notices
get.description:
Permission point `content.agreement` (04 §11.2; read only, no step-up). Every published
version, newest first (by published_at), page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200),
optionally of one `type`; without the text (read one version for its title and body).
Published versions never change and are never deleted (04 §6.2).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only versions of this type; absent = all five types (including sdk_list and collect_list).

200.description: One page of published versions, newest first.

items.legal_confirm_note: 劳务协议第 2 版需重签

post.summary: Publish a new version of an agreement
post.description:
Permission point `content.agreement` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier for every publish (without a
valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`; 04 §11.2 动态码, OPS-14).
The version number is the type's current newest version + 1 (1 for the first), set by the
server. `title` and `body` (tiptap JSON as a string, nodes and marks within the agreement
body whitelist) are the text; `min_version` is where re-consent (privacy, agreement,
BR-ID-12) or re-signing (labor_agreement, BR-WDR-31) starts; sdk_list and collect_list
take no part in consent (D10-465), so their min_version must equal the new version and
requires_resign must be false; `legal_confirmed_by`,
`legal_confirm_note` and `legal_confirmed_on` record the legal confirmation (OPS-14,
BR-ID-12). A failed check is 20001 with `data.fields` naming the field: min_version below
the current version's min_version or above the new version, requires_resign not as the
publish rules require for the type and min_version, a legal confirmation field missing or
blank, or a body outside the whitelist. CAS: `expected_version` is the type's newest
version as the console showed it (0 when none is published yet); a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=agreement`, refresh and retry (04 §6.6). In one transaction the server
inserts the agreement article (category agreement) and the agreements row, and for
privacy and agreement also writes legal.<type>.version (privacy also
legal.privacy.min_version, 04 §10.1). Writes an audit record with the legal confirmer,
the confirmation date and min_version and requires_resign before and after (BR-ID-12).
Published versions are never changed or deleted. The response is the new version. No
Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6; the CAS keeps a retry from publishing twice).

example.title: 劳务协议
example.legal_confirm_note: 劳务协议第 3 版需重签

200.description: The new version.

data.legal_confirm_note: 劳务协议第 3 版需重签

get.summary: One published version of an agreement with its text
get.description:
Permission point `content.agreement` (04 §11.2; read only, no step-up). One published
version with the title and body of its article. A version the type does not have → 30701.

200.description: The version with its text.

data.legal_confirm_note: 隐私政策第 3 版，第 2 版起需重新同意
data.title: 隐私政策

get.summary: Product pools of the console
get.description:
Permission point `content.pool` (04 §11.2; step-up 「–」); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. One row per pool, newest created_at first, page by page
(`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200). `status` filters by pool status.

200.description: One page of pools, newest created_at first.

post.summary: Create a product pool
post.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. Creates a pool with the client-generated `pool_id` (a UUIDv7 the
console generates once per new pool and reuses on every retry of that create; lowercase canonical
form). Admin writes carry no Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6), so the id is what makes a retry safe, as
adminCreateArticle: when a pool with that id already exists → 20902 with
`data.resource=product_pool` and nothing is written; the console reads it back with
GET /admin/v1/product-pools/{pool_id} (编排者默认). A `pool_id` that is not a lowercase canonical
UUIDv7 → 20001 `data.fields=[pool_id]`; `name` empty after trimming → 20001
`data.fields=[name]`. `status` defaults to active; `revision` starts at 0. Written to the audit
log in the same transaction (action product_pool_create, the new row).

200.description: The new pool.

get.summary: Search one platform's union for products to add to a pool
get.description:
Permission point `content.pool`; lacking it is 10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`.
The console's source of `item_ref` for adminAddPoolItem (01 F-ADM-10 联盟接口选品入库; 编排者默认).
`platform` and `q` are required, `q` is 1–100 characters. The search runs as searchProducts runs
for that platform and keyword (BR-PROD-07 cache, BR-PROD-08 ①② dedupe with the admin as the
requester; a row whose key cannot be derived is dropped, BR-PROD-03), at the server page size 20
with no sort or filter. Union failure without a usable cache, or the switch
search.enabled.<platform> off, is 50304 as searchProducts (BR-PROD-07, BR-PROD-10); the product
pool is never served as candidates. No result answers 200 with `items: []`, `next_cursor: null`
and no fall-back items.

A row carries the server-signed `item_ref` (BR-PROD-11), the quoted prices and `quoted_at`.
No rebate is returned and no link is registered, so a no_rebate product can appear here;
listPageSectionItems filters it when reading the pool (BR-PRICE-08). A tie in BR-PROD-08 ①
(same key, same final price) is broken by a rebate computed only for that comparison, as
searchProducts breaks it, and never returned, so the row keeps the better plan's item_ref. Nothing is added to a
pool until adminAddPoolItem. The `item_ref` ages as on any card; adminAddPoolItem then falls
back as BR-PROD-05 says. `cursor` is opaque and carries only the search
session and page; the console sends `next_cursor` back unchanged with the same `platform` and
`q`. A cursor that fails decoding → 20001 `data.fields=[cursor]`; an expired or other-session
cursor starts a new session without an error and returns the requested page (BR-PROD-08). A platform
without search capability → 30131 (BR-PROD-10). Read-only, no audit record.

Paging differs from the other /admin/v1 lists (04 §5, page + page_size + total) by design:
union search gives no total and a deduped one would not be exact, so this is the one cursor-paged console operation and the
console calls it directly, not through its shared list provider (registered exception,
D10-485; 04 §5).

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform to search (enum platform).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword.

200.description: One page of candidates, in the union's order.

get.summary: One product pool
get.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. The pool with its `revision`, the CAS value of
adminUpdateProductPool. A `pool_id` that is not a lowercase canonical UUID, or that does not
exist → 30701.

200.description: The pool.

patch.summary: Rename a product pool or switch it on or off
patch.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. CAS: `expected_revision` is the pool's `revision` the console
showed; every write adds 1 to it, and a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=product_pool`. At
least one of `name` and `status` is required, a body with neither → 20001 `data.fields=[body]`;
`name` empty after trimming → 20001 `data.fields=[name]`. A disabled pool keeps its items and is
read as empty by listPageSectionItems. An unknown `pool_id` → 30701. Written to the audit log in
the same transaction (action product_pool_update, before and after).

200.description: The pool as it is now.

get.summary: Items of a product pool
get.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. One row per item, `sort` ascending then `product_key`, page by
page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200), including items that are offline or outside their window. The
price fields are the pool's last successful refresh and `quoted_at` is that refresh time
(BR-PRICE-11); they are never edited by hand (BR-PRICE-16). `invalid_reason` is the reason shown to
the operator when the system took the item offline or a re-check failed (BR-PROD-05 结果分类 ①,
BR-PROD-08 ③), null otherwise. `status` filters by item status. An unknown `pool_id` → 30701.

200.description: One page of items, sort ascending.

post.summary: Add a product to a pool from a link, a token or a union pick
post.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. The body carries exactly one of `link_text` (a link or token,
resolved as parseInput resolves it) and `item_ref` (a union pick, the `item_ref` of a row of
adminSearchPoolCandidates, passed through unchanged). The route schema checks this: both →
20001 `data.fields=[body]`; neither → 20001 `data.fields=[link_text, item_ref, body]`. A
`link_text` holding more than one product → 20001 `data.fields=[link_text]` (编排者默认). The
server derives product_key (BR-PROD-03); the console never sends it. Refused, nothing written,
the reason shown to the operator (BR-PROD-03 细则「派生失败的处理」, BR-PROD-08), only for a key
not yet in the pool, input that names no key counting as such: nothing recognisable → 30132; a
recognised product whose key cannot be derived → 30131; an `item_ref` that has aged out falls
back through product_refs and re-resolution (BR-PROD-05), and only when that finds no matching
key or derives another key → 30143; a union answer with `price_status=anomaly` → 50401. For a
key already in the pool, a union answer that does not pass (a dead reference or
`price_status=anomaly` included) is not refused: it takes the overwrite path below, "the
overwrite stands, offline, 200 with `invalid_reason`", touches this row only and takes no
pool-wide action. Whatever the key, the union cannot answer now → 50401, retry.

The pool item key is (app_id, pool_id, product_key) (BR-PROD-08 ③). `sort`, `start_at` and
`end_at` are required, null for no bound, so a repeat overwrites with exactly what was submitted;
`end_at` not later than `start_at` → 20001 `data.fields=[end_at]`.

A new key inserts an online item whose price fields and `quoted_at` come from the union answer of
this call. A new key the union explicitly reports as off shelf → 30141 and no item is inserted,
since an off-shelf answer has no price to store (编排者默认); pool items elsewhere that already
hold this key still go offline (BR-PROD-05 结果分类 ①). Adding a key already in the pool overwrites its `sort`, `start_at` and `end_at` with
this submission, leaves `created_at` and `created_by` unchanged, and runs one union re-check at
once (BR-PROD-05 结果分类 ①, BR-PROD-08 ③): passed → online, `invalid_reason` cleared and the price
fields refreshed; not passed → the overwrite stands, the item stays or goes offline and 200 carries
`invalid_reason`, the reason shown to the operator. The re-check not answering now → 50401, nothing
changed, retry (编排者默认). A repeat is therefore safe to retry, and the unique key decides between
two concurrent adds of the same product.

Items may be added to a disabled pool. An unknown `pool_id` → 30701. Written to the audit log in
the same transaction (action pool_item_add: the new row, or before and after on an overwrite).

200.description: The item as it is now; on a failed re-check it is offline with `invalid_reason`.

patch.summary: Change the order, window or shelf status of a pool item
patch.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. At least one field is required, an empty body → 20001
`data.fields=[body]`. `start_at` and `end_at` take null for no bound; after the change `end_at`
not later than `start_at` → 20001 `data.fields=[end_at]`. `status=offline` takes the item off the
shelf at once. `status=online` on an offline item first runs one union re-check (BR-PROD-05 结果
分类 ①, BR-PROD-08 ③): passed → online, `invalid_reason` cleared and the price fields refreshed;
not passed → 200 with the item still offline and `invalid_reason` set, and a dead reference or
`price_status=anomaly` touches this row only and takes no pool-wide action; the union cannot answer
now → 50401, nothing changed, retry. An unknown `pool_id` or a `product_key` not in the pool → 30701.
Written to the audit log in the same transaction (action pool_item_update, before and after).

200.description: The item as it is now.

delete.summary: Remove a product from a pool
delete.description:
Permission point `content.pool`. Deletes the pool item; the shared product_refs row stays. No body.
An unknown `pool_id` or a `product_key` not in the pool → 30701, so a retry after a lost response
answers 30701 and changes nothing. Written to the audit log in the same transaction (action
pool_item_remove, the removed row). The response is the removed row.

200.description: The removed item.

get.summary: Articles of the CMS (help, rules, notices, agreements)
get.description:
Permission point `content.article` (04 §11.2; step-up 「–」). One row per article, newest
`updated_at` first, page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200): category, the title, number
and status of the newest version row, the current version (the largest version whose status
is exactly published and whose published_at is not later than now, 04 §6.2; null when
there is none) with its published_at, and the article's `row_version`, the CAS value of
every article write. `category` filters by category; `status` filters by the status of
the newest version row (编排者默认). Articles of category agreement are listed read-only;
they are written through /admin/v1/agreements.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the newest version row.

200.description: One page of articles, newest updated_at first.

post.summary: Create an article as a first draft
post.description:
Permission point `content.article`. Creates an article with the client-generated
`article_id` (a UUIDv7 the console generates once per new article and reuses on every retry
of that create; lowercase canonical form) and version 1 in status draft; nothing is
published. Admin writes carry no Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6), so the id is what makes a retry
safe: retrying the same article_id never creates a second article — when an article with
that id already exists → 20902 with `data.resource=article` and nothing is written; the
console then reads it back with GET /admin/v1/articles/{article_id} (编排者默认). An
article_id that is not a lowercase canonical UUIDv7 → 20001 `data.fields=[article_id]`,
checked before the save checks. Category
agreement is refused with 20001 `data.fields=[category]` (agreements are written through
/admin/v1/agreements). Save checks (04 §6.6 articles, shared by create, draft and
publish): an empty title or a title hitting the forbidden-word list (BR-TEXT-12 细则); a
body that is not a tiptap JSON document within the allowed node and mark list; a link
href that is not an https external link (App-internal links are not supported in this
batch, 编排者默认), whose host is in the `union_host` category of the platform
link-pattern table while switch `external_page.union_host_block` is on (BR-ATTR-29 ①), or
that carries a personal-data placeholder (BR-ID-33 细则「外链不带个人数据」); a notice
that cannot be closed without notice_end_at (BR-TEXT-13 细则「生效区间」); help_section sent
with a category other than help (变更记录 20261020-内容线默认回写 §1.6); faq_rank sent with
a category other than help (W-25, 编排者默认) → 20001.
`data.fields` lists, in this order, the offending field names (title, body,
notice_end_at, help_section, faq_rank), the forbidden words hit and the JSON paths inside the body
written as `body.content[i]…` (编排者默认); no other data key. For categories other than notice the
notice fields are ignored and stored as notice_closable=true, notice_end_at=null
(编排者默认). notice_content_version is maintained by the server on save, never sent by
the console (BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的关闭与内容版本」). Written to the audit log in the
same transaction.

200.description: The new article with its first draft version.

get.summary: One article with all its versions
get.description:
Permission point `content.article`. The article with every version row, newest first,
drafts and offline versions included, each with its body, and the article's `row_version`
(the CAS value of every article write). current_version is the largest version whose
status is exactly published and whose published_at is not later than now (a scheduled
version not yet due does not count), null when there is none (04 §6.2). An article_id
that is not a lowercase canonical UUID, or that does not exist → 30701.

200.description: The article.

put.summary: Save a new draft version of an article
put.description:
Permission point `content.article`. Inserts a new version row (newest version + 1) in
status draft with the given title, body, notice fields, help_section and faq_rank (omitted =
none); a saved version's body is never changed in place (编排者默认). Same save checks and
`data.fields` as POST /admin/v1/articles (help_section, then faq_rank, with a category
other than help → 20001, listed after notice_end_at and before the forbidden words). An article of category agreement → 20001 `data.fields=[category]`.
CAS: `expected_row_version` is the article's `row_version` the console showed; the new
row takes the previous newest row's row_version + 1, and a mismatch → 20902 with
`data.resource=article` (编排者默认). An article_id that is not a lowercase canonical UUID,
or that does not exist → 30701. Written to the audit log in the same transaction.

200.description: The article with its new draft version.

post.summary: Publish the newest draft version of an article, now or at a set time
post.description:
Permission point `content.article`. Publishes `version`, which must be the article's
newest version and in status draft, otherwise 20001 `data.fields=[version]` (older drafts
stay draft, 编排者默认). `published_at` defaults to the server's current time; a time
earlier than now → 20001 `data.fields=[published_at]` (编排者默认); a later time schedules
the version, which counts as unpublished until then (04 §6.2). The save checks of POST
/admin/v1/articles run again with the same `data.fields`. Older published versions stay
published; the current version is the largest published version already due. An article
of category agreement → 20001 `data.fields=[category]`. CAS: `expected_row_version` is the
article's `row_version` the console showed; publishing adds 1 to the newest row's
row_version in the same transaction, so a stale request, including a retry of one that
already took effect, never matches again: a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=article`.
An article_id that is not a lowercase canonical UUID, or that does not exist → 30701.
Written to the audit log in the same transaction.

scheduled.summary: Publish version 3 at a set time

200.description: The article after publishing.

post.summary: Take a whole article offline
post.description:
Permission point `content.article`. Sets every published version of the article,
scheduled ones not yet due included, to offline; drafts are not touched (04 §6.2「整篇下线」;
编排者默认 for drafts). An article with no published version → 20001
`data.fields=[article_id]`. For a notice, the time it was taken offline is recorded as
notice_end_at (BR-TEXT-13). An article of category agreement → 20001
`data.fields=[category]`. CAS: `expected_row_version` is the article's `row_version` the
console showed; going offline adds 1 to the newest row's row_version in the same
transaction; a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=article`. An article_id that is not a
lowercase canonical UUID, or that does not exist → 30701. Written to the audit log in the
same transaction.

200.description: The article after going offline.

get.summary: Dictionary keys with their bundled default and current text
get.description:
Permission point: any of `config.general`, `content.fund_terms` or `content.agreement`
(04 §11.2; read only, no step-up). One row per key of contracts/texts.default.json or
contracts/texts.admin.default.json (the keys the dictionary may override: the app texts
and the console's `admin_dict.*` names of BR-TEXT-25, 编排者默认), in key order, page by
page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200), optionally narrowed by `class` and `key_prefix`: the
key's class (which permission point writes it, BR-TEXT-12 细则: `fund_terms` = a fund term
key, `agreement` = privacy and permission texts of table D (`privacy.`, `perm.`) and
the real-name consent sheet of table C (`real_name.consent.`, D10-204), `general` =
every other key; fund term keys as classified in specs/fund-term-keys.yaml,
`admin_dict.*` keys included), the bundled default (from whichever of the two files holds
the key), the current override (null = the bundled default applies) and
the version of the key's current row (null = never written). `dict_version` is the
dictionary's current version ("0" before the first publish), the `expected_version` of
the writes.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Only keys of this class.

parameters.name: key_prefix
parameters.description: Only keys starting with this text.

200.description: One page of dictionary keys.

put.description:
Saving publishes (no separate draft step, 编排者默认): the changed keys take effect as a new
dictionary version (BR-TEXT-12 细则). One request changes keys of one class only, and the
class picks the permission point and step-up (04 §11.2, BR-ID-34): `general` →
`config.general`, no step-up; `fund_terms` → `content.fund_terms`, totp tier every time;
`agreement` → `content.agreement`, totp tier, and `legal_confirmed_by` is required. Keys
of more than one class → 20001 with `data.fields=[changes]`; lacking the class's point →
10403 with `data.reason=admin_permission_denied`; without a valid totp-tier
`X-Step-Up-Token` where needed → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`. A key the server cannot
classify counts as a fund term key (BR-TEXT-12 细则). `admin_dict.*` keys (BR-TEXT-25) are
classed the same way, by specs/fund-term-keys.yaml (fund term keys → `fund_terms`, the
others → `general`); no permission point of their own. Every change is checked first, and
any failure is 20001 with nothing saved: a key in neither contracts/texts.default.json nor
contracts/texts.admin.default.json, a key listed twice, or a text equal to the current one → `data.fields` names
`changes[<i>].key`; a text whose variables (`{name}` placeholders) differ from the
bundled default's, or that contains a forbidden word → `data.fields` names
`changes[<i>].text` followed by the forbidden words found; an `agreement` change without
`legal_confirmed_by` → `data.fields=[legal_confirmed_by]`. Only then is
`expected_version` compared with the current dictionary version, and a mismatch is 20902
with `data.resource=dict_item` and nothing saved (04 §6.6). On success every changed key
gets a new row (text null = back to the bundled default) at the new version (current
plus 1), dict_version moves to it in the same transaction, and the audit log records
the keys with before and after texts, whether they are fund terms and the legal
confirmer. Clients see the change when their GET /v1/dict cache refreshes (`admin_dict.*`
keys: through GET /admin/v1/dict only). No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The new dictionary version and the keys written.

get.summary: Version history of dictionary keys
get.description:
Permission point: any of `config.general`, `content.fund_terms` or `content.agreement`
(04 §11.2; read only, no step-up). Every stored dictionary row, newest first (by version,
then key), page by page (`page`, `page_size` ≤ 200), optionally for one `key`: the key, the
dictionary version it was written at, its text (null = back to the bundled default), who
wrote it and when. Rows are never changed; a rollback adds new rows (POST
/admin/v1/dict-items/rollback).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only the rows of this key.

200.description: One page of dictionary rows, newest first.

post.summary: Roll dictionary keys back to an older dictionary version
post.description:
Writes, for every key in `keys`, the text the key had at dictionary version `to_version`
(its newest row at or below that version; none, or `to_version` 0 → null, back to the
bundled default) as a new row at a new dictionary version (current plus 1); history is
never rewritten (BR-TEXT-12 细则). Classes, permission point, step-up and
`legal_confirmed_by` as for PUT /admin/v1/dict-items (one class per request: `general` →
`config.general`, no step-up; `fund_terms` → `content.fund_terms`, totp tier;
`agreement` → `content.agreement`, totp tier and `legal_confirmed_by`; mixed classes →
20001 with `data.fields=[keys]`; lacking the point → 10403; without a valid totp-tier
`X-Step-Up-Token` where needed → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Checked first, with nothing
written on failure (20001): `to_version` not lower than the current dictionary version →
`data.fields=[to_version]`; a key in neither contracts/texts.default.json nor
contracts/texts.admin.default.json, or listed twice →
`data.fields` names `keys[<i>]`; a restored text that no longer passes the variable or
forbidden-word check → `data.fields` names `keys[<i>]` followed by the forbidden words
found. Then CAS: `expected_version` is the current dictionary version, and a mismatch is
20902 with `data.resource=dict_item`. Audited like a save. No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

200.description: The new dictionary version and the keys written.

get.summary: Console status and reason names (admin_dict)
get.description:
Permission: any permission point (04 §6.6 `dict`; any signed-in console account holding at
least one permission point; read only, no step-up; no new permission point). The console
dictionary of BR-TEXT-25: the Chinese names the console shows for statuses and reasons,
every `admin_dict.*` key, whose bundled defaults are contracts/texts.admin.default.json
(console only, not bundled in the App or H5). Unlike GET /v1/dict, every key is returned:
its current override, or its bundled default when not overridden. A key
`admin_dict.<enum>.<code>` is items[enum][code]: the `admin_dict.` prefix is dropped and
the rest split at its last dot (`enum` is the 04 enum name or `table.column` and may hold
dots, e.g. `admin_adjustments.status`; `code` is the 04 value with its case). The console
shows the code itself when a key is missing (BR-TEXT-25). `version` is the dictionary's
current version, as GET /v1/dict ("0" before the first publish). Not paged. Read only;
texts are changed on the dictionary page through PUT /admin/v1/dict-items, by key class
(fund term keys → `content.fund_terms`, other keys → `config.general`, as classified in
specs/fund-term-keys.yaml).

200.description: Every console dictionary key, by enum and code.

get.summary: Notification channels, SMS readiness and SMS registrations of every template code (not paged)
get.description:
Permission point `content.article` or `notify.channels` (either is enough; read only, no
step-up; 08 BR-TEXT-20 细则, orchestrator ruling D10-337 ④); lacking both is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. One item per template code of `notify_templates`
(04 §3), ordered by code; not paged. Rules: 08 BR-TEXT-20 细则「短信渠道登记与后台渠道开关」
and BR-TEXT-09 细则 (the channel column of its template table is each code's default).
Each item carries:
- `category`, `default_channels` (BR-TEXT-09 细则 template table, or the code's definition
  in 08 for codes outside it) and `channels`, the switch values in force (`inbox` is never
  added or removed from the console: a code with the inbox channel always writes it, a code
  without it can never get it).
- What may be changed: `push_switchable` (push may be turned on or off), `sms_switchable`
  (SMS may be turned on or off) and `sms_fixed` (SMS is always on and only its registration
  may be replaced: `SMS_CODE`, `UNION_AUTH_EXPIRING`, `UNION_AUTH_EXPIRED`,
  `DATA_COPY_CODE`). Codes 08 sends as inbox messages only (the three codes of BR-TEXT-23
  and `BALANCE_ADJUSTED`) have both switches false; codes outside the service category
  never get SMS (subscription codes, BR-WATCH-15; marketing SMS is P1); codes without inbox
  (`SMS_CODE`, the station-owner alerts) cannot get push either. `sms_billing_confirm` is
  true for a service code whose default channels have no SMS: turning its SMS on needs
  `confirm_sms_billing` (SMS is billed per message).
- SMS readiness (D10-337 ②, D10-339 ⑥): `sms_ready` is true when every variant of the code
  has an active registration (`sms_registrations[].active` not null); it is false for a
  code without SMS rows. SMS can be turned on only when `sms_ready` is true.
  `sms_deploy_fallback` is true only for `SMS_CODE` while it has no active registration:
  it is then sent with the signature and template CODE of the deployment configuration
  (BR-TEXT-20 细则「过渡」; the console shows 「部署配置兜底」, the configured values are never
  returned), and readiness does not apply to it. `sms_state` is what SMS does now:
  `disabled` (SMS is not among `channels`); `enabled` (on, and ready or on the deployment
  fallback: SMS is sent); `enabled_not_ready` (on but not ready, which only happens to a
  code whose default channels include SMS before every variant is registered and enabled:
  the server sends no SMS for it and only records that it was not sent, while push and
  inbox go as usual; once ready it sends SMS by default without another switch).
- `sms_code_ttl_sec`: for `SMS_CODE` only, the code validity of BR-ID-05 in seconds (what
  a validity written in its preview text must equal); null for every other code.
- `fund_terms`: true for a fund code (BR-TEXT-12 细则「资金术语键」, the `fund_terms`
  template codes of specs/fund-term-keys.yaml; a code in neither list counts as a fund
  code, except `DATA_COPY_READY` and `DATA_COPY_CODE`, which are ordinary (orchestrator
  ruling D10-341: personal data copy delivery, no money) until the list registers them).
  Saving its SMS registration and enabling a new one also need
  `content.fund_terms`; switching its channels, retesting and discarding do not.
- `sms_registrations`: one row per variant of the code (code × variant, 04 §3) when the
  code may send SMS (`sms_fixed` or `sms_switchable`), otherwise empty. Each row has the
  variable names the code defines for that variant (`variables`, fixed in code), the
  registration in use (`active`, null = none) and the new registration waiting to be
  enabled (`pending`, null = none; D10-337 ①): its signature, template CODE, template type
  and preview text with the latest test result (`test.status`: `accepted` = the provider
  accepted the test SMS and it may be enabled, also after the operator chose 「稍后再启用」;
  `failed` = the provider rejected it, errored or timed out, the active registration stays
  in force; `not_sent_no_verify_phone` = saved while the operator had no verify phone,
  nothing sent) and when it was tested. AccessKeys are never stored or returned.
- `row_version`: one version for the whole code (its channels and every variant's active
  and pending registration); every accepted write to the code raises it by 1, including a
  saved test result. It is the `row_version` of the writes.
Reading does not write an audit record.

patch.summary: Turn the push or SMS channel of a template code on or off
patch.description:
Permission point `notify.channels` (04 §11.2); lacking it is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Only switching: no
`content.fund_terms` is needed, also for a fund code (BR-TEXT-20 细则). The switch applies
to the code as a whole (every variant). Order of checks, the first hit is returned:
permission, step-up → `code` not a template code of the app → 20001 with
`data.fields=[code]` → body (20001 with `data.fields` naming the field; neither `push`
nor `sms` given → `data.fields=[push, sms]`) → what the item of GET
/admin/v1/notify-channels allows: `push` given on a code whose `push_switchable` is false
→ 20001 with `data.fields=[push]` and `data.reason=notify_channel_locked`; `sms` given on
a code whose `sms_switchable` is false (inbox-only codes, codes outside the service
category, and `sms_fixed` codes, whose SMS cannot be turned off) → 20001 with
`data.fields=[sms]` and `data.reason=notify_channel_locked` → `sms=true` while SMS is off
and `sms_ready` is false (some variant has no active registration; D10-337 ②) → 20001
with `data.fields=[sms]` and no reason (the console greys the switch out from
`sms_ready`) → `sms=true` on a code whose `sms_billing_confirm` is true while SMS is off,
without `confirm_sms_billing=true` → 20001 with `data.fields=[confirm_sms_billing]` (the
console's second confirmation that SMS is billed per message) → `row_version` differs
from the code's current one → 20902 without data (refresh and retry). A switch already at
the requested value is left as it is; when nothing changes the call succeeds without
writing, `row_version` unchanged. A code in `sms_state=enabled_not_ready` may have its SMS
turned off when `sms_switchable` is true; turning it on again then needs `sms_ready`.
Effects (BR-TEXT-20 细则): a channel turned off is no longer sent; the user's service switch
governs push only, never SMS; SMS of a code turned on here is sent at the time the code's
push would be (quiet hours as BR-TEXT-09 细则「频控与免打扰」). Writes an audit record
(action notify_channel_switch: the code, channels before and after, and whether the billing
confirmation was given) for every change. The response is the item as GET returns it now.
No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

put.summary: Save an SMS registration of a template code as pending and test-send it
put.description:
Permission point `notify.channels` (04 §11.2), and for a fund code (`fund_terms` true in
GET /admin/v1/notify-channels) also `content.fund_terms`; lacking either is 10403 with
`data.reason=admin_permission_denied`. Step-up: totp tier on every call, one code for the
save and its test send (without a valid totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with
`data.tier=totp`). One registration per code × variant (`variant` query parameter,
`default` when absent). The signature and template are applied for and approved in the
provider's console (Aliyun SMS); here they are only registered, and `preview_text` is the
approved text as the operator copies it (not checked against the provider in MVP, 规划/09
CAP-X-09). Rules: 08 BR-TEXT-20 细则「短信渠道登记与后台渠道开关」 (「待测试」登记与启用,
D10-337 ①, D10-339 ⑤).
Order of checks, the first hit is returned, nothing is saved on any of them: permission,
step-up → `code` not a template code of the app → 20001 with `data.fields=[code]` → a
fund code without `content.fund_terms` → 10403 → the code may not send SMS (neither
`sms_fixed` nor `sms_switchable`) → 20001 with `data.fields=[code]` and
`data.reason=notify_channel_locked` → `variant` not a variant of the code → 20001 with
`data.fields=[variant]` → body (20001 with `data.fields` naming the field; a `sample` key
that is not one of the variant's variables → `data.fields=[sample]`) → `preview_text`:
its placeholders (`${name}`, as in the provider's template) are not exactly the variables
the code defines for the variant → 20001 with `data.fields=[preview_text]` and
`data.reason=notify_preview_vars_mismatch`; for `SMS_CODE`, a validity written in the text
as N minutes (N分钟) where N × 60 is not `sms_code_ttl_sec` (BR-ID-05) → 20001 with
`data.fields=[preview_text]` and `data.reason=notify_code_ttl_mismatch` (a text that
states no validity may be saved); the checks of BR-TEXT-12, BR-TEXT-13 and BR-TEXT-20 (no
platform name at the start of the first sentence after the signature, no 「官方」,
forbidden words) → 20001 with `data.fields` naming `preview_text` followed by the
forbidden words found, as for dictionary texts → `row_version` differs from the code's
current one → 20902 without data (refresh and retry).
Then, when `sign_name` and `template_code` equal those of the active registration, only
its `template_type` and `preview_text` are replaced in place: no test send, the pending
registration (if any) is left as it is, `test_send_phone_masked` is null. Otherwise (no
active registration, or a new signature or template CODE) the body becomes the pending
registration of the code × variant, replacing an earlier pending one; the active
registration is never replaced here and stays in force. In the same call a test SMS goes
synchronously to the operator's own verify phone (BR-ID-45) with the new signature and
template CODE, filled with `sample` (variables not given take the server's built-in
sample value), and its result is saved on the pending registration:
- the provider accepts it (accepted is not delivered) → 200, `pending.test.status=accepted`;
  the console offers 「启用新配置」 (POST …/sms/pending/enable) or 「稍后再启用」, which
  changes nothing. This accepted test is what satisfies BR-TEXT-20's test send to a verify
  phone: whoever enables the registration later needs no verify phone of their own
  (orchestrator ruling D10-342 ②);
- the account has no verify phone (also when it lost it after the page was loaded) → the
  pending registration is still saved, nothing is sent, 200 with
  `pending.test.status=not_sent_no_verify_phone` and `test_send_phone_masked` null (never
  10003 here, D10-339 ⑤);
- not accepted: the provider rejects it (including a wrong signature or template CODE) or
  errors → 50301; times out or the outcome is unknown → 50401 (D10-335 ③). The pending
  registration is saved anyway with `test.status=failed` and `row_version` raised, so the
  console refreshes the list after these codes; the active registration stays in force.
The test SMS counts against the provider's rate limits for that phone and may delay the
operator's own sms-tier step-up codes right after. Saving and the test result are written
under the `row_version` checked above in one transaction after the provider answers
(20902 when the code changed meanwhile; the test SMS may already have gone out). Audit:
every save writes one record (action notify_sms_register: code, variant, the pending or
active registration before and after, whether it is a fund code, the masked verify phone
and the test result, never the AccessKey). The response is the code's item as GET returns
it now and the masked phone of the test send (null when nothing was sent). No
Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6): a retry after a lost response is a new call and sends again.

pending registration → success, nothing changed and `row_version` unchanged. Otherwise
the pending registration is deleted and `row_version` goes up by 1. Writes an audit
record (action notify_sms_discard: code, variant, the discarded registration and its test
result). The response is the code's item as GET returns it now. No Idempotency-Key.
