post.summary: Roll one configuration item back to an older version
post.description:
Permission point and step-up as for PUT /admin/v1/config-items/{key}: the key's point
(`config.general`, `config.risk` or `config.business`, 04 §11.2); totp tier for
`config.risk` and `config.business`, none for `config.general` (without a valid
totp-tier `X-Step-Up-Token` → 10003 with `data.tier=totp`). Writes the value of
`to_version` as a new version (the current version plus 1); history is never rewritten.
`to_version` must be a stored version lower than the current one, otherwise 20001 with
`data.fields=[to_version]`; the restored value is checked against the key's current rule
like a new value (for example the candidate set of BR-AI-01 细则「页面引导」 for
`agent.page_guide.routes`), and a value that no longer passes is 20001 with
`data.fields=[to_version]` and nothing changes. An unregistered or not admin-editable key
is 20001 with `data.fields=[key]`. CAS: `expected_version` is the item's current
`version`; a mismatch → 20902 with `data.resource=config_item`. Written to the audit log
(action config_item_rollback) and pushes an alert; takes effect like a change (04 §10).
No Idempotency-Key (04 §6.6).

post.summary: Start a new conversation
post.description:
Owner per BR-AI-20: with an access token the user (any device); without one this device
(X-Device-Id), guest sessions only. Returns the owner's newest unexpired session while it
has no turn yet, otherwise creates one, so repeating the call never piles up empty sessions
(no Idempotency-Key, 04 §5 幂等). After BR-ID-01 ①–⑦ the checks of BR-AI-23 ①–③ apply:
30501 (agent.enabled / whitelist, BR-AI-12) → 10001 or 10005 (the switches of BR-ID-03) →
10004 with consent_type=ai_third_party (BR-AI-13; nothing is created). x-auth is optional
although 04 §6.5 lists none, for the same reason as search and consents.
Version gate: applied.

200.description: The new session, or the owner's newest empty one.

get.summary: The current conversation
get.description:
The owner's most recently active unexpired session, or session=null (BR-AI-20; owner as in
createAgentSession, a token never falls back to the device's guest sessions). The app opens
it on start; there is no session list (拍板第二批 AI-23). Checks BR-AI-23 ①–③: 30501 →
10001 / 10005 → 10004.

200.description: The current session or null.

get.summary: Conversation history
get.description:
The messages of one session (04 §6.5 会话历史响应的形状, 2026-10-14). After BR-ID-01 ①–⑦
the checks of BR-AI-23 ①–④ apply in order: 30501 (agent.enabled / whitelist, BR-AI-12) →
10001 / 10005 (BR-ID-03) → 10004 consent_type=ai_third_party (BR-AI-13) → 30504 without
data when the session does not exist or the caller is not its owner (never told apart,
BR-AI-20; owner as in createAgentSession).
An expired session (BR-AI-20) is not an error here: its owner still gets 200 with
data.expired=true and the history is read-only (sending to it is 30504 on POST); an
unexpired session has data.expired=false.
Paging: the first page holds the newest `limit` messages; items[] inside a page are in time
order, oldest first. next_cursor fetches the page of earlier (older) messages; null means
there are no earlier messages.
Each item is one agent_messages row: role user (the text as the user sent it, cards [] and
finish_reason null) or assistant (the text after OutputGuard, possibly '' while nothing
has been written yet; finish_reason as in the done frame, contracts/enums agent_finish_reason,
null while the run has not ended). cards[] are the card frames as they were sent (card_id,
type, schema_version, data, fallback_text; the frame's seq is not kept); data follows
contracts/agent-stream.schema.json card_<type>, and a client that does not know the type
shows fallback_text (03 §7.4). One exception: earnings_summary keeps no amounts (BR-AI-19,
BR-AI-01 细则「收益查询」), so its data is only the earnings_summary_history shape, as_of and
the two action buttons (actions), and the client shows the history note instead of
reloading amounts. Not replayed: tool.status, ping, suggestions and meta frames. Product
cards keep quoted_at / age_sec and are aged by BR-PRICE-11; there is no extra field.
After a duplicate client_msg_id response or a disconnect the client reloads this list
(04 §8.1, 03 §7.2).

post.summary: Send a message; the reply is an SSE stream
post.description:
After BR-ID-01 ①–⑦, BR-AI-23 decides in this order and returns the first failure as the JSON
error envelope (Content-Type application/json, HTTP status per contracts/error-codes.yaml):
① 30501 (agent.enabled / whitelist, BR-AI-12) → ② 10001 / 10005 (BR-ID-03) → ③ 10004
consent_type=ai_third_party (BR-AI-13) → ④ 30504 without data (session missing, not the
caller's, or expired; BR-AI-20) → ⑤ 20001 data.fields=[text] when text is too long
(BR-AI-23 ⑤, counted in Unicode code points; checked here, not by the schema) → ⑥ repeated
client_msg_id: the two-frame stream below; ⑦–⑩ are not checked (only finishing a leftover
run of this session can still end it with JSON 50401 or 50001, see below) → ⑦ 30506 (a run
of this session is in progress) → ⑧ 42901 with Retry-After → ⑨ 30504
data.reason=round_limit → ⑩ 30502 data.reset_at, data.next (BR-AI-15). Only a request
passing ⑩ is counted.
A malformed body (types, client_msg_id format, unknown fields) is 20001 before ①.
Before acceptance (BR-AI-23 细则 受理结果不明 / 谁来收尾, 2026-10-08), two more JSON errors:
JSON 50401 when the store is unavailable or the outcome of the acceptance transaction is
unknown (the lookup by client_msg_id is still unclear); not counting the message is not
guaranteed, so the client retries with the same client_msg_id and ⑥ gives the definite
result. JSON 50001 when a leftover run of this session is pending manual handling (its data
cannot be finished automatically); this is decided before ⑦ (before "a run is in progress")
and the client guides the user to a new session. Both ⑥ and ⑦ first finish (settle and
write the terminal state of) a leftover run of this session in their own acceptance
transaction; when that finishing hits an unavailable store or an unknown outcome the answer
is JSON 50401, and when the leftover run is pending manual handling it is JSON 50001.
Accepted: 200 text/event-stream; each event is one frame of
contracts/agent-stream.schema.json (`event:` / `id:` / `data:` lines, a `: ping` comment
every 15 s); meta first, exactly one terminal frame (done or error) last. Failures after
acceptance are error frames (30501 when the switch goes off, 10004 when the consent is
withdrawn, 50302 with fallback_q, 50001, 50401). No resume (02 §9): after a disconnect the
client reloads GET .../messages (03 §7.2). The client tells the two kinds of answer apart by
Content-Type.
Repeated client_msg_id (⑥, 04 §8.1 重复消息; the body is not compared): when it is answered
with a stream, 200 text/event-stream with two frames, ids from 1: meta (the original run's
ids, duplicate=true) and the original terminal frame replayed (an original run with no
terminal state that is not running is finished first, then replayed), or error 30506
(retryable, fallback and fallback_q null) while the original run is still running. If
finishing the original run hits an unavailable store or an unknown outcome, ⑥ returns
JSON 50401 instead (retry with the same client_msg_id); if the original run is pending
manual handling, JSON 50001, decided before the still-running check.
context comes from the entry points of 01 §4 (商品详情、剪贴板提示条、订单详情) and is
handled like tool input (an order_id that is not the caller's is not found, BR-AI-07).
Version gate: applied.

200.description: The reply stream (frames per contracts/agent-stream.schema.json).

schema.description: Server-sent events; one event is one AgentStreamFrame of contracts/agent-stream.schema.json.

post.summary: Stop generating
post.description:
Stops a running reply (BR-AI-23 细则 取消, 2026-10-08). Checks BR-AI-23 ①–③. A repeated call
for a run already cancelled by this endpoint (its cancel recorded; the run not yet ended or
ended as cancelled) returns 200 again and writes nothing. Otherwise 30505 when the run does
not exist, is not in a session of the caller (never told apart), has ended, already has an
end reason written on the run row, or is past its deadline (accepted time + the longest run
duration, BR-AI-14); the deadline is judged by the server time after the run row is locked.
Otherwise the cancel is written on the run row and the call returns 200; a 200 guarantees
that the run ends with finish_reason=cancelled, which is counted (BR-AI-15). Version gate:
applied.

post.summary: Thumbs up or down on a reply

Writes agent_messages.feedback of the message (04 §6.5); down marks the run as a badcase
(BR-AI-19). A malformed body (feedback missing or not up / down, unknown fields) is 20001.
After BR-ID-01 ①–⑦ the checks of BR-AI-23 ①–③ apply: 30501 → 10001 / 10005 → 10004; then
30504 without data when the message does not exist or its session is not the caller's
(never told apart, BR-AI-20). Version gate: applied.

post.summary: Report a reply

Writes agent_messages.reported and report_reason (04 §6.5, BR-AI-19). reason is free text
of 1–200 characters: 08 has not fixed a set of report reasons, so the contract has no enum
for it. A malformed body (reason missing, empty or too long, unknown fields) is 20001.
After BR-ID-01 ①–⑦ the checks of BR-AI-23 ①–③ apply: 30501 → 10001 / 10005 → 10004; then
30504 without data when the message does not exist or its session is not the caller's
(never told apart, BR-AI-20). Version gate: applied.

bearerAuth.description:
`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`; ES256 JWT with uid, app_id, sid, device_id, scp,
valid 2 hours (BR-ID-07). After login app_id is taken from the token only.

adminBearerAuth.description:
`Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>` on every /admin/v1 operation after login (CT-02f).
admin_token is a JWT signed with its own key (aud=admin, not accepted on /v1), valid
8 hours and expiring after 30 minutes without activity (BR-ID-34); expired or idle → 10001
without reason. The console keeps it only in memory and sessionStorage and sends it only in
this header; it is never a cookie, so requests carry no ambient credential and need no
CSRF token. The admin API allows CORS only from the exact admin console origin (02 §3.4).
The step-up token of an operation goes in the `X-Step-Up-Token` header (04 §5).

AppId.name: X-App-Id
AppId.description: App (brand) the request belongs to; before login it must match the app_id the device was registered with (10403, BR-ID-07).

AppVersion.name: X-App-Version
AppVersion.description: SemVer, the same number on all three apps (拍板第二批 TECH-07).

Channel.name: X-Channel
Channel.description: Install channel of the app package (enum install_channel); absent for H5.

TraceId.name: X-Trace-Id
TraceId.description: Client-generated trace id, echoed as `trace_id` when well-formed.

DeviceId.name: X-Device-Id
DeviceId.description: device_id issued by POST /v1/devices; anything else is 10402 (BR-ID-09).

PayOrderId.name: pay_order_id
PayOrderId.description: pay_orders.id of one of the caller's pay orders (UUIDv7).

OptionalDeviceId.name: X-Device-Id
OptionalDeviceId.description: device_id issued by POST /v1/devices, when the device is registered.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: The ETag of the client's last good response (LKG); a match gets 304.

Nonce.name: X-Nonce
Nonce.description: 32 lowercase hex characters; (device_id, nonce) unique within 600 s (BR-ID-09).

Sign.name: X-Sign
Sign.description:
lowercase_hex(HMAC-SHA256(install_secret, METHOD + "
" + path with raw query + "
" + ts
+ "
" + nonce + "
" + lowercase_hex(sha256(raw body)))) (BR-ID-09).

StepUpToken.name: X-Step-Up-Token
StepUpToken.description:
step_up_token from POST /v1/auth/step-up for the operation's x-step-up action (04 §5). Missing,
empty, expired or for another action → 10003 (not 20001; that is why the header is optional
and has no minimum length). A replay of a finished Idempotency-Key never looks at it
(BR-WDR-01 细则, BR-ID-08).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Required on operations marked I (04 §6); missing → 20001. Same key while processing →
40901; same key with another body → 20901; a retry after a timeout reuses the key and gets
the first result (拍板第二批 TRADE-22). On the x-step-up operations a key abandoned through
POST /v1/idempotency-keys/abandon → 20903, without comparing the body (04 §5「幂等」).

does not own the attempt_id in the body, is 20001 with data.fields=[attempt_id] (no 30144).

LinkId.description: link_id from a card; unknown or of another app → 30144.

AdminPageSize.description: Page size of an admin list, at most 200 (04 §5 后台分页); above that → 20001.

AdminOrderRebateStatusFilter.description: Only sub-orders in this rebate status (enum rebate_status); absent = all.

AppVersionChannelPath.name: channel
AppVersionChannelPath.description: Install channel of the row; another value → 20001 with data.fields=[channel].

does not exist → 30701.

AdminPoolIdPath.name: pool_id
AdminPoolIdPath.description:
Product pool id, a lowercase canonical UUID; any other spelling, or an id that does not
exist → 30701.

ConfigKeyPath.name: key
ConfigKeyPath.description:
A configuration or emergency-switch key as registered by the server (04 §10, §10.2), dotted
and concrete (`convert.enabled.taobao`, not `convert.enabled.<platform>`); an unregistered
key → 20001 with data.fields=[key].

AdminRiskRuleIdPath.name: rule_id
AdminRiskRuleIdPath.description:
rule_id of a risk rule of the console's app, as GET /admin/v1/risk-rules lists it; unknown
or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[rule_id].

AdminAppealIdPath.name: appeal_id
AdminAppealIdPath.description:
appeal_id of the appeal (also its display number); unknown or of another app → 20001 with
data.fields=[appeal_id].

AdminAppealStatusFilter.name: status
AdminAppealStatusFilter.description: Only appeals in this status (enum appeal_status); absent = all. The counts ignore it.

AdminAppealOverdueFilter.name: overdue
AdminAppealOverdueFilter.description:
true = only appeals still processing whose deadline_at has passed (BR-ID-36); false or
absent = no such filter. The counts ignore it.

AdminAppealTargetTypeFilter.name: target_type
AdminAppealTargetTypeFilter.description: Only appeals on this kind of target (enum appeal_target_type); absent = all.

AdminAppealQuery.name: q
AdminAppealQuery.description:
An appeal_id or the appellant's UID (user_id), matched exactly. Trimmed, then 1–64
characters, else 20001 with data.fields=[q]; the bound is checked after trimming, so the
schema carries none.

AdminBlockedRequestPhone.name: phone
AdminBlockedRequestPhone.description:
The full phone number, normalised as in BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」 (not a mainland mobile
number → 20001 with data.fields=[phone] and data.reason=phone_invalid); give exactly one
of phone, user_id and blocked_request_id.

AdminBlockedRequestUserFilter.name: user_id
AdminBlockedRequestUserFilter.description: The UID (user_id) whose blocked requests to list; give exactly one of phone, user_id and blocked_request_id.

AdminBlockedRequestIdFilter.name: blocked_request_id
AdminBlockedRequestIdFilter.description:
The blocked request id (拦截请求编号) shown in the 44001 dialog, matched exactly; give
exactly one of phone, user_id and blocked_request_id.

AdminStepUpToken.name: X-Step-Up-Token
AdminStepUpToken.description:
step_up_token from POST /admin/v1/auth/step-up, whose tier the operation checks (BR-ID-34;
tier per permission point in GET /admin/v1/me/permissions). Missing, expired or of a lower
tier than the operation needs → 10003 with data.tier (not 20001; that is why the header is
optional). Only on admin console operations; app operations use StepUpToken.

AdminNotifyTemplateCodePath.name: code
AdminNotifyTemplateCodePath.description: Template code (code of GET /admin/v1/notify-channels); not a template code of the app → 20001 with data.fields=[code].

AdminNotifyTemplateVariantQuery.name: variant
AdminNotifyTemplateVariantQuery.description: The variant of the code (sms_registrations[].variant of GET /admin/v1/notify-channels); default when absent; not a variant of the code → 20001 with data.fields=[variant].

AgentSessionId.description: session_id. A session that does not exist or is not the caller's is 30504 either way (BR-AI-20).

AgentRunId.name: run_id
AgentRunId.description: run_id from meta.run_id or a history turn.

AgentMessageId.name: message_id
AgentMessageId.description:
message_id from meta.message_id or a history item. A message that does not exist or whose
session is not the caller's is 30504 either way (BR-AI-20).

AdminUnionAccountIdPath.name: union_account_id
AdminUnionAccountIdPath.description: union_account_id from GET /admin/v1/union-accounts; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[union_account_id].

AdminUnionPidIdPath.name: pid_id
AdminUnionPidIdPath.description: pid_id from GET /admin/v1/union-pids; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[pid_id].

AdminUnionAccountPlatformFilter.description: Only union accounts of this platform (enum platform); absent = all.

AdminPayOrderIdPath.name: pay_order_id
AdminPayOrderIdPath.description: The pay order (pay_orders.id) as a list row carries it; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[pay_order_id].

AdminPayRefundIdPath.name: pay_refund_id
AdminPayRefundIdPath.description: The refund (pay_refunds.id); unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[pay_refund_id].

AdminPayAnomalyIdPath.name: pay_anomaly_id
AdminPayAnomalyIdPath.description: The pay anomaly (pay_anomalies.id); unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[pay_anomaly_id].

AdminPayOrderStatusFilter.description: Only pay orders in this status (enum pay_order_status); absent = all.

AdminPayChannelFilter.name: pay_channel
AdminPayChannelFilter.description: Only rows of this pay channel (enum pay_channel); absent = all.

AdminPayBizTypeFilter.name: biz_type
AdminPayBizTypeFilter.description: Only pay orders of this business type (pay_orders.biz_type, exact match); absent = all.

AdminPayUserFilter.name: user_id
AdminPayUserFilter.description: Only pay orders of this user of ours (pay_orders.user_id); a user_id that names no user is an empty page.

AdminPayOutTradeNoFilter.name: out_trade_no
AdminPayOutTradeNoFilter.description: Only the pay order with this merchant order number (exact match).

AdminPayCreatedFrom.description: Earliest created_at, inclusive (ISO 8601 with offset); later than created_to → 20001 with data.fields=[created_from, created_to].

AdminPayRefundStatusFilter.name: status
AdminPayRefundStatusFilter.description: Only refunds in this status (enum pay_refund_status); absent = all.

AdminPayRefundTargetTypeFilter.name: target_type
AdminPayRefundTargetTypeFilter.description: Only refunds of pay orders or of pay anomalies (enum pay_refund_target_type); absent = both.

AdminPayRefundReasonFilter.name: reason_code
AdminPayRefundReasonFilter.description: Only refunds with this reason code (enum pay_refund_reason); absent = all.

AdminPayReconDiffTypeFilter.name: type
AdminPayReconDiffTypeFilter.description: Only differences of this R4 type (pay_mismatch or pay_anomaly); absent = both.

AdminPayReconDiffStatusFilter.name: status
AdminPayReconDiffStatusFilter.description: Only differences in this status (enum recon_diff_status); absent = all.

AdminReconDiffTypeFilter.name: type
AdminReconDiffTypeFilter.description: Only differences of this R1–R3 type (AdminReconDiffType); absent = all.

AdminReconDiffSourceFilter.name: source
AdminReconDiffSourceFilter.description: Only differences of this source (R1, R2 or R3; R4 is not accepted here); absent = all three.

AdminReconDiffStatusFilter.name: status
AdminReconDiffStatusFilter.description: Only differences in this status (enum recon_diff_status); absent = all.

AdminReconDiffPeriodFrom.name: period_from
AdminReconDiffPeriodFrom.description: Smallest period, inclusive, compared with `period` as a string (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD); greater than period_to → 20001 with data.fields=[period_from, period_to].

AdminReconDiffPeriodTo.description: Largest period, inclusive, compared with `period` as a string (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

AdminReconDiffRefIdFilter.name: ref_id
AdminReconDiffRefIdFilter.description: Only differences referring to this ref_id (exact match); absent = all.

AdminReconDiffIdPath.name: recon_diff_id
AdminReconDiffIdPath.description: The reconciliation difference (recon_diffs.id) as a list row carries it; unknown, of another app or of source R4 → 20001 with data.fields=[recon_diff_id].

AdminAdjustmentIdPath.name: adjust_id
AdminAdjustmentIdPath.description: The adjustment form (admin_adjustments.adjust_id) as a list row carries it; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[adjust_id].

AdminAdjustmentReasonCodeFilter.description: Only forms with this reason code.

AdminBadDebtWriteoffIdPath.name: id
AdminBadDebtWriteoffIdPath.description: The write-off candidate (bad_debt_writeoffs.id, the candidate_id of the BR-FUND-12 uniq_key) as a list row carries it; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[id].

AdminBadDebtWriteoffUserFilter.description: Only candidates of this member (the user_id; UID and phone lookups go through the top-bar search).

AdminWithdrawalStatusFilter.name: status
AdminWithdrawalStatusFilter.description: Only withdrawals in this status (enum withdrawal_status); absent = all.

AdminWithdrawalDisplayStatusFilter.description: Only withdrawals whose derived display status is this one (enum admin_withdrawal_display_status, BR-WDR-08 细则); absent = all.

AdminWithdrawalReviewModeFilter.name: review_mode
AdminWithdrawalReviewModeFilter.description: Only withdrawals with this review_mode (enum withdrawal_review_mode); a withdrawal not yet decided (review_mode null) never matches; absent = all.

AdminWithdrawalChannelFilter.description: Only withdrawals of this payout channel (withdrawals.payout_channel, enum payout_method); absent = all.

AdminWithdrawalUserFilter.description: Only withdrawals of this user (the user_id; UID and phone lookups go through the top-bar search); one of no user of the app → empty page.

AdminWithdrawalOutBizNoFilter.description: Only the withdrawal with this full withdrawal number (withdrawals.out_biz_no, exact match); absent = all.

AdminWithdrawalAmountMin.description: Smallest amount_fen, inclusive; greater than amount_max_fen → 20001 with data.fields=[amount_min_fen, amount_max_fen].

AdminWithdrawalCreatedTo.description: Latest created_at (application time), exclusive (ISO 8601 with offset).

AdminWithdrawalIdPath.description: The withdrawal (withdrawals.id) as a list row carries it; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[withdrawal_id].

AdminSettleBillFrom.description: Earliest bill month (YYYY-MM), inclusive; later than bill_to → 20001 with data.fields=[bill_from, bill_to].

AdminSettleBatchItemTypeFilter.description: Only items of this type (enum settle_batch_item_type); absent = all.

AdminAssetSnapshotDateTo.name: date_to
AdminAssetSnapshotDateTo.description: Latest snapshot day (YYYY-MM-DD, the accounting day D), inclusive; not a date → 20001 with data.fields=[date_to].

AdminUnionReceiptIdPath.description: The collection record (union_receipts.receipt_id) as a list row carries it; unknown or of another app → 20001 with data.fields=[receipt_id].

AdminUnionReceiptDateFrom.description: Earliest collection day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive; not a date → 20001 with data.fields=[date_from]; later than date_to → 20001 with data.fields=[date_from, date_to].

AdminUnionReceiptDateTo.name: date_to
AdminUnionReceiptDateTo.description: Latest collection day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive; not a date → 20001 with data.fields=[date_to].

EntryName.description: Process entry that produced the response (ADR-0001 §2).

now.description: Current instant of the process clock (follows CLOCK_NOW outside prod).

HealthzResponse.description: Response envelope of 规划/04 §5 carrying the health payload.

TraceId.description: Echo of a well-formed X-Trace-Id request header, otherwise a generated UUID.

ProductKey.description: `<key_prefix>:<stable_id>`, at most 128 characters, opaque to clients (BR-PROD-02).

ItemRef.description: Server-signed opaque product reference; passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

NullableFen.description: Amount in fen, null when unknown.

NoRebateCause.description: Why a card or an open result has no rebate (enum no_rebate_cause).

RebateBasis.description:
contracts/enums/trade.yaml rebate_basis. The three 查返利 states are derived from
coupon_fen and rebate_basis only (BR-PRICE-21); amount_unknown and login_required are
outside them.

InstalledState.description:
Whether the platform app is installed, as detected by the client (BR-ATTR-27 ①); the
strings "true" / "false" / "unknown" (enum installed_state).

JumpStep.description:
One step of a jump plan. `sdk` is required on every type=sdk step and never present on any
other type; the schema keeps it optional so the already-served shape stays compatible, and
the server that builds the plan (linking) guarantees the pairing, checked against the
examples by the contracts-ts consistency test. For a type=sdk step the client acts on
`sdk` only; `value` repeats `sdk.url` (open_by=url) or `sdk.item_id` (open_by=code) for
logs and compatibility.

value.description: URL, scheme or token to execute; produced by the server only.

BaichuanOpen.description:
Taobao open instruction executed by the Baichuan SDK (docs/changes/20261003 §1; 03 §4.5).
The server builds it from the link snapshot; the client passes it to the SDK unchanged and
never rewrites, fills in or drops `taoke` (BR-ATTR-05). open_by=url opens our own promotion
link of this user and scene and carries no commission parameter at all (BR-ATTR-27 Taobao
row); open_by=code opens the item detail page and lets the SDK convert with `taoke`. A
code step carries no URL, so JumpPlan.expire_at does not limit it (04 §8.4). Whether the
SDK returns to the app afterwards is a platform capability (CAP-TB-11), not promised here.
The oneOf branches declare the properties they constrain (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2
#15).

open_by.description: url = openByUrl with our promotion link; code = openByCode with the item ID.

url.description: Required for open_by=url; only our own promotion link of this user and scene.

page.description: Required for open_by=code; the page openByCode opens.

item_id.description: Required for open_by=code; the union item ID (new string form).

BaichuanTaoke.description:
AlibcTaokeParams of an open_by=code instruction, built by linking from the snapshot
identity (BR-ATTR-05); the client must not change, fill in or drop any of it.

relation_id.description: Active binding of the snapshot user (the sharer on a share link).

JumpPlan.description:
Executed strictly in order; clients never build schemes or add fallbacks themselves
(BR-ATTR-27, 03 §4.5). The client jumps only after a user tap (BR-ATTR-21).

expire_at.description:
Until when the returned union URL can be used directly (BR-ATTR-05); it does not
limit opening the link_id again. A Taobao sdk step with open_by=code carries no URL and
is not limited by it (04 §8.4).

IdempotencyKey.description: Value of the Idempotency-Key header (04 §5「幂等」).

SessionScope.description: scp of an access token (enum session_scope; meaning in BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」).

H5TokenScope.description: Scope of an h5_token (enum h5_token_scope; BR-ID-32 细则「只读作用域」).

scope.description:
Filled by the native app from its force-update state; H5 cannot choose it. The value
used when it is absent is set in BR-ID-32 细则「只读作用域」.

StepUpAction.description: Action a step_up_token is bound to; one per x-step-up operation (04 §2.5, §5).

AbandonIdempotencyKeyData.description:
`original` is null exactly when `outcome=abandoned`. The oneOf branches declare the
properties they constrain (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

original.description:
The response envelope stored with the completed idempotency record, unchanged
(`code` 0 or a 3xxxx business code; 1xxxx and 2xxxx results are never stored,
BR-WDR-07). `data` keeps the shape of the original operation, so it is left open.

ErrorEnvelope.description:
Error response (04 §5, §7). `data` is present only for codes that define it; its fields
per code are listed in contracts/error-codes.yaml, so it is left open here.

msg.description: Fallback text only; clients show the dictionary text error.<code>.

FreeForm.description: Configuration block whose inner shape is not fixed by 规划/04 yet.

ConfigBridgeOrigins.description:
Signed whitelist of the origins whose pages the client's trusted web container serves and
lets call the bridge (04 §10.1 可信容器白名单 + 签名; 02 §12.6; 03 §5.1 / §5.2; 12 §9 B-04;
D10-608 / D10-610 / D10-612). Always present.

jws is a JWS compact serialization (RFC 7515) `header.payload.signature`, each part
base64url without padding:
- header: {"alg": "ES256", "kid": <signing key id>, "typ": "couli-bridge-origins+jws"}.
- payload: {"v": 1, "app_id": <the caller's app>, "env": "local" | "test" | "staging" |
  "prod", "version": <integer >= 0>, "origins": [<origin>, ...]}. Each origin is a
  normalized https origin: lowercase host, no path, query, fragment, credentials or
  wildcard, port 443 omitted, other ports kept (`https://host[:port]`). origins is non-empty
  and always contains the origin of h5_base_url. There is no expiry.
- signature: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the ASCII `header.payload`, as the raw 64-byte
  R‖S (IEEE P1363, RFC 7518 §3.4), not DER.

Server: origins come from the console config item bridge_origins (an unsigned {origins});
version is that item's version, so it grows with every save. Without the item, or when the
stored value is not a usable list, the server signs [origin of h5_base_url] (version 0
without the item, the item's version otherwise). The signature is cached per
(app_id, env, version, origins) and signing key (kid), so the same version answers the
same jws byte for byte and the /v1/config ETag (config_version) stays stable; a new
version changes both. The private key is the api entry's configuration signing key
(CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_FILE / CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_ID), separate from the JWT key.

Client (03 §5.1 取用顺序): verify the signature with the public key that the package
carries for the header's kid and the build's env, then check typ, v = 1, app_id and env
equal its own, and version >= the version of the last good whitelist (no rollback). Only
then use origins and store it as the last good whitelist; on any failure keep the last good
whitelist (or the packaged one) and never write the failed value as last good (AC-S1-180
②). Origins compare as in 03 §5.2: the page URL's normalized origin equals one entry
exactly.

Key rotation: the package carries two kids per env (current + next). The server switches
CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_ID / CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_FILE to the next key only after the packages that
carry it are released; the signature of the same version then changes once (new kid), and
the old key is retired after clients that only know it are gone.

jws.description: JWS compact serialization signed with ES256 (see the schema description).

ConfigClipboard.description:
Clipboard block of /v1/config (04 §10.1). consent_version is the current version (a
string) of the purpose statement for automatic clipboard recognition; the client compares
it with the user's feature consent version (BR-ID-16 门槛②). The other fields (local
filter rules and so on) are typed later by the contract / native line and pass through
as-is for now. When the stored value does not fit this shape the server sends {} for the
whole key (04 config_items 统一规则).

DeviceIdSource.description: Which device identifier was hashed (enum device_id_source, BR-ID-09).

device_hash.description:
lowercase_hex(SHA-256(UTF-8 bytes of the identifier, trimmed and lower-cased)) of IDFV
(iOS), ANDROID_ID (Android, MVP) or ODID (Harmony) (BR-ID-09 细则「设备标识的无效值」).

install_secret.description: Signing secret, stored only in Keychain / Keystore / HUKS.

Phone.description:
Phone number as typed or pasted; it may carry spaces, hyphens and +86 / 0086 / 86. The
server normalises it (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」); a result that is not a mainland mobile
number is 20001 with `data.fields=[phone]` and `data.reason=phone_invalid` (an empty
string included). No length bound in the schema: any spacing of a valid number must reach
the normaliser, and adding a bound to a request property is a breaking change (oasdiff).

action.description:
With purpose=step_up the client always sends the action the code is for; the version
gate and the session scope are decided from it (BR-ID-01 细则): only
action=account_deletion is exempt, and a step_up request without action is gated.
purpose=login is exempt regardless of action; purpose=bind is gated.

resend_after_sec.description:
Seconds until another code may be requested: at least 60, the latest release among the
per-phone limits (BR-ID-05).

expires_in_sec.description: Validity of the code in seconds (300, BR-ID-05).

LegalVersions.description: Versions of the privacy policy and user agreement the user agreed to (BR-ID-04).

consent_at.description: When the box was ticked or the confirm dialog accepted (client clock).

invite_code.description: Optional invite code; ignored for an existing account (BR-INV-06).

version.description:
The version of the text the user saw. A positive integer (legal.privacy.version and the
like) for every type except clipboard_auto_import, which takes the string
config.clipboard.consent_version (BR-ID-12 细则, BR-ID-16). A form that does not pair
with `type` → 20001 with data.fields=[version].

channel.description: consent_channel without the server-written login_merge, h5_landing and withdraw_flow.

OauthAttemptPurpose.description: What a third-party authorization attempt is for (enum oauth_attempt_purpose).

CreateOauthAttemptRequest.description:
`action` is required exactly for purpose=step_up. purpose=payout_bind is for WeChat only
and carries no `action`. purpose=reverify (re-verification of a recycled phone, BR-WDR-01
细则) carries no `action`. The oneOf branches declare the properties they constrain (strict
Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

nonce.description: At least 128 random bits, passed to the provider SDK (BR-ID-04 细则).

OauthCredential.description: An authorization credential from the provider SDK; never stored or logged.

StepUpSummary.description:
The business summary bound into a withdraw or payout_account_change step-up token
(BR-ID-08 细则「绑定业务摘要」): a withdrawal (payout_account_id of GET
/v1/me/payout-account and amount_fen), or the new payout account to be saved. Which shape
goes with which action is checked by the server (20001 data.fields=[summary]). No payee
name and no client-computed fingerprint.

alipay_logon_id.description: As it will be sent to PUT /v1/me/payout-account; normalised by the server.

card_no.description: As it will be sent to PUT /v1/me/payout-account; normalised by the server.

StepUpRequest.description:
Exactly one way of second verification: an SMS code, or a new authorization with one
provider carrying that provider's login credential fields (BR-ID-08). Each branch is a
closed object, so a body mixing two ways matches none.

ReverifyMethod.description: Re-verification method (enum reverify_method, BR-WDR-01 细则).

required.description: false when the account has no flag or this device is already re-verified.

method.description: The available method; null when not required.

providers.description: Trusted third-party identities usable when method=oauth; empty otherwise.

id_no.description: The resident ID number; its format is judged by the server (20001 data.fields=[id_no]).

ReverifyByOauthRequest.description:
One provider with that provider's login credential fields and an attempt with
purpose=reverify; no `action`. Each branch is a closed object.

BindOauthIdentityRequest.description:
One provider with that provider's login credential fields and an attempt for binding
(POST /v1/me/oauth-bindings, P1). Each branch is a closed object.

OauthBinding.description: A third-party login identity bound to the account (no union_id or open_id).

TokenPair.description:
Token pair of a login or a refresh. session_scope is the scp of the access token, decided
from this request (BR-ID-01 细则「受限会话」): deletion_only when the client is below the
minimum supported version.

InviteBind.description: Result of binding the invite code sent at registration (BR-INV-06).

code.description: Error code when result=failed (50001 = internal binding error).

MeBalance.description: Summary of the single balance (拍板第二批 §8 ADD-06); meanings per BR-FUND-18.

AuthMethod.description: Taobao authorization method (enum auth_method; BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」).

type.description: A subset of jump_type; an h5 step opens in the system browser, not in the app.

AuthJumpPlan.description:
Authorization jump of 30111 and of the Pinduoduo auth-url (04 §7 30111): primary and
fallbacks chosen by the server from the device record and installed (BR-ID-22 细则,
BR-ATTR-27); executed in order by the same executor as a purchase jump plan, but not
reported as link_jump and not a purchase jump (BR-ATTR-21).

UnionAuthUrlData.description:
Exactly one of auth_methods (Taobao, ordered) and auth_jump (Pinduoduo); the oneOf branches
declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020).

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the access token in seconds, as the SDK returned it.

BindUnionRequest.description:
Exactly one authorization method (BR-ID-17 细则「授权方式」); each branch is closed, so
undefined fields are 20001.

OrderStatusGroup.description: Status group of the order list (enum order_status_group; members in BR-TEXT-02 细则).

OrderDisplayStatus.description: User-visible order status (enum display_status; BR-FUND-17); unknown codes map to UNKNOWN.

OrderReasonCode.description: Order reason code (enum order_reason); texts and actions come from /v1/dict.

OrderTimelineNode.description:
Timeline node of the order detail (enum order_timeline_node; BR-TEXT-02 细则「时间线」):
a pre-sale order starts with deposit_paid and has final_paid instead of paid; invalid /
clawed_back / part_clawed_back only when the order reached that state.

OrderSummary.description:
One row of GET /v1/orders. Exactly one of order_no (my own purchase) and masked_order_no (a
shared order); the oneOf branches declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020). A
shared order with is_other_product=true has title and image_url null and never the full
order_no (BR-TEXT-02 细则
「订单的检索范围与分享单的投影」). OrderDetail repeats these fields (kept as two closed
objects; redocly's example check closes every allOf member, so no shared allOf base).

order_no.description: Full platform order number (self-purchase only, copyable).

masked_order_no.description: Masked by the server (BR-TEXT-02 细则「订单号的显示」); shared orders never carry the full number.

paid_at.description:
Payment time (the final payment of a pre-sale order); null for a pre-sale order still in
DEPOSIT_PAID (BR-ATTR-25 keeps paid_at for the final payment).

is_other_product.description: A shared order whose bought product is not the shared one.

is_price_compare.description:
orders.is_price_compare (04 §6.4, 2026-11-05). true: the client shows the 「比价订单」 tag
(text key order.tag.price_compare, BR-TEXT-03; not a display_status, amounts unchanged).
Set only from the union order API field (BR-CALC-16); null on a platform whose field is
not yet verified, and the server does not set it before then. null, false or absent:
no tag. Optional: added to an existing /v1 shape (contracts/README rule 8).

claim_entry_pinned.description: Whether the claim entry is pinned on the order page (J-6). Only with scope=self, absent with scope=share; computed by the server at the current time per BR-ATTR-17 (latest own jump-out at least 30 minutes and at most 72 hours ago and no new order attributed to the user since; a no-rebate purchase counts only under 拍板第二批 TRADE-09). Not the same as show_claim_entry of the pending-track card.

ClaimItemDecision.description: Decision on one child order of a claim (enum claim_item_decision).

ClaimRejectReason.description: Reject reason of a child order (enum claim_reject_reason; NOT_IN_POOL and ORDER_INVALID are set by the system).

order_no.description: Order number; spaces are removed, then it is matched exactly as a string, first against child order numbers, then against parent order numbers (BR-ATTR-17). For pdd the hyphens are removed from both the input and the stored numbers before comparing; stored and displayed numbers are unchanged. Empty after removing spaces is 20001.

paid_date.description: Payment date, YYYY-MM-DD in +08:00 (second factor); for a pre-sale order the date the deposit was paid.

order_no.description: The order number as submitted, spaces removed.

at.description: When it happened; null when it has not (shown greyed) or the platform gives no time.

period.description: Expected settlement month (YYYY-MM), only on credit_expected; null otherwise.

OrderDetail.description:
The list row fields (same as OrderSummary) plus the detail fields of 04 §6.4. product_key
is null when is_other_product=true; with is_other_product=true title and image_url are
null too.

order_no.description: Full platform order number (self-purchase only, copyable).

masked_order_no.description: Masked by the server (BR-TEXT-02 细则「订单号的显示」); shared orders never carry the full number.

paid_at.description:
Payment time (the final payment of a pre-sale order); null for a pre-sale order still in
DEPOSIT_PAID (BR-ATTR-25 keeps paid_at for the final payment).

is_other_product.description: A shared order whose bought product is not the shared one.

reason_action.description: Action codes of the reason (the order_reason dictionary's action[], BR-TEXT-05).

provider.description: Push provider; a string until the provider is chosen (D-14).

code.description: purpose=bind SMS code sent to the new number.

nickname.description:
New nickname. The server trims leading and trailing white space and checks the length
as 1–16 extended grapheme clusters (BR-ID-39); no minLength / maxLength here because
JSON Schema counts code points.

merge_ticket.description:
data.merge_ticket of the 30411 returned by POST /v1/me/phone; valid for 5 minutes and
once. Its format is not part of the contract.

invite_code.description:
Invite code as typed or pasted. The server normalises it and checks the format
(BR-INV-02); an empty or malformed code is 30401 and counts towards the daily limit, so
the schema has no pattern or minLength.

can_invite.description: false when inviter_unavailable(self) (BR-INV-02); the reason is not given.

invite_code.description: My invite code; null when can_invite=false.

landing_url.description:
`{share domain}/i/{invite_code}`, optionally with a channel code parameter; never the
UID, phone number or nickname. null when can_invite=false.

poster_url.description:
Poster image drawn by the server (04 §6.4, TECH-13); null when can_invite=false and
while poster drawing is not available.

direct_count.description: Number of my direct invitees (BR-INV-16); returned even when can_invite=false.

sms_code.description:
The purpose=login code from POST /v1/landing/sms-codes; a wrong or expired code is
20002 / 20003 (BR-ID-05).

invite_code.description:
Invite code of the landing link. Normalised and checked by the server (BR-INV-02); an
empty or malformed code is 30401 and counts towards the daily limit, so the schema has
no pattern or minLength.

agreed.description:
The user agreement and privacy policy box was ticked. false is 10004 with
data.consent_type=agreement, not a validation error; on success the agreement and
privacy consents are recorded with channel h5_landing (BR-INV-05, BR-ID-32).

channel.description:
Optional channel code of the landing link, kept as the account's registered channel
(BR-ID-04, BR-INV-05).

result.description:
registered = account created and bound to the inviter; already_registered = the phone
already has an account (in deletion included), nothing changed (BR-INV-05).

TipKey.description:
One-time tip (enum tip_key; BR-ATTR-21, BR-INV-03 细则). inviter_before_buy is deprecated
since 2026-10-19 (first-purchase inviter tip cancelled): kept and accepted as before, not
used by clients, never reused.

ResettableTipKey.description: The tip that settings can show again (subset of tip_key).

MarkTipReadRequest.description: Body of tip_key=jump_tip; tip_key=inviter_before_buy (deprecated 2026-10-19) sends no body.

TipsData.description:
Read states of the one-time tips. inviter_before_buy is deprecated since 2026-10-19
(first-purchase inviter tip cancelled, BR-INV-03 细则): clients no longer read it; still
returned as before until removed from the contract.

jump_tip.description: read_at per platform; a platform never read is absent or null.

DataCopyItem.description: One downloadable personal information copy of mine (no link, no extraction code).

status.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml personal_data_copy_status; only ready or delivered are listed.

expires_at.description: End of the download period (24 hours after generation, BR-ID-30 ⑨).

url.description: Signed link to the encrypted file; valid until url_expires_at. Opened with the extraction code from the SMS.

url_expires_at.description: min(5 minutes after signing, the copy's expires_at).

AppealTargetType.description:
Subset of contracts/enums/identity.yaml appeal_target_type (04 §6.1, BR-ID-36): the
user-side appeal endpoints take and return account and order only. blocked_request (a
write request blocked with 44001) is registered by customer service in the admin console
only and is not accepted here (04 §3.2 appeals, §6.1; BR-ID-36 细则「被拦截请求申诉」).

Appeal.description:
One of my appeals (04 §3.2 appeals). No deadline_at or handler_id: the processing time
limit is internal only (BR-ID-36 细则).

target_id.description:
The order_id when target_type=order. For target_type=account how it is filled is not
set by 04 or BR-ID-36.

closed_at.description: When the appeal was closed (upheld or revoked); null while processing.

attempt_no.description:
Which appeal this is for the same target under its current penalty, counting the first
one (starts at 1); the cap is set by BR-ID-36 and is not sent to the client.

can_resubmit.description:
Computed by the server (BR-ID-36 细则): true only when this is the latest appeal for the
target, it was upheld, the appeal count for the target's current penalty is not used up
(same rule as 30418), and the target is still restricted (account still frozen or
banned, order still voided); false otherwise.

InviteBackfill.description:
Whether the invite code can still be filled in and until when (computed by the server per
BR-INV-07, also for an account without phone; BR-INV-03 细则).

PayoutAccount.description: The current payout account, by payout_method (bank_name only for a bank card).

masked_account.description: Masked by the server (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」).
Masked by the server (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」).

data.description: The account, or an empty object when nothing is bound.

alipay_logon_id.description: Alipay logon id (phone or e-mail form), normalised by the server (BR-WDR-02 细则).

card_no.description:
Card number as typed; the server removes spaces and hyphens, then checks 12–19 digits and
Luhn (20001 data.fields=[card_no], BR-WDR-02 ⑥ and 细则).

bank_name.description:
Optional and ignored by the server: the opening bank is taken from the card BIN, the
user does not type it (BR-WDR-02 细则「只支持本人名下借记卡」). Accepted so that older
clients sending it are not refused.

name.description: Real name as typed; normalised by the server.

id_no.description:
18-digit resident ID number as typed. No pattern here: length and check digit are judged
by the server (20001 data.fields=[id_no], BR-ID-25) after the phone and consent checks.

realname_status.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml realname_status; always verified on success.

LaborAgreement.description: Currently effective labor agreement and the user's signing state (BR-WDR-31).

text_url.description: Address of the full text of that version.

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of that version's text.

need_sign.description:
True when the user has never signed, or the latest signature's version is below the
re-sign threshold (resign_from_version); a higher current version below the threshold
does not require signing again (08 BR-WDR-31).

signed_version.description:
Version of the latest signature (may be below the current version when no re-signing
is required); null when never signed.

signed_at.description: Server time of the latest signature; null when never signed.

version.description: The version shown to the user (GET /v1/me/labor-agreement); must be the current one.

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the text shown; must match that version (20001 data.fields=[text_sha256]).

agreed.description: Must be true; the server returns 20001 data.fields=[agreed] otherwise.

AgreementType.description:
Agreement type (04 §6.2 agreements.type; 01 §4.2). sdk_list (the SDK list) and collect_list
(the personal information collection list) are versioned public notices only: published
like the others (BR-ID-12) but taking no part in consent (D10-465) — min_version always
equals version, never in first-launch consent, re-consent or re-signing, and never listed
by GET /v1/agreements. Consent and signing fields keep their own types without these two.

PublicAgreement.description: The currently effective version of the privacy policy or the user agreement (04 §6.2).

min_version.description: Consent to a version below this one must be given again (BR-ID-12).

article_version.description: Version of the article holding the text (GET /v1/articles/{article_id}?version=).

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the text.

url.description: Address of the full text of this version.

privacy.description: The current privacy policy; null when never published.

agreement.description: The current user agreement; null when never published.

PublicAgreementVersion.description: One version of an agreement or public notice (04 §6.2; types in AgreementType).

version.description: Version of the agreement, counted per type from 1.

min_version.description: Consent to a version below this one must be given again (BR-ID-12), as recorded on this version; always equals version for sdk_list and collect_list (D10-465).

article_version.description: Version of the article holding the text (GET /v1/articles/{article_id}?version=).

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the text.

url.description: Address of the full text of this version.

ArticleCategory.description: Article category (04 §6.2：帮助、规则、公告、协议; codes defined here, no enums/ entry yet).

ArticleHelpSection.description:
Sub-section of a help article (04 §3.2 articles.help_section; 变更记录 20261020-内容线默认回写
§1.6). Codes are defined by the contract line (no enums/ entry, same as ArticleCategory);
the list follows the help-centre board and grows or shrinks with it under the enum
extension rules: getting_started = 新手教程, rebate_settlement = 返利与结算, orders_claims =
订单与找回, withdraw = 提现, invite = 邀请好友, account_privacy = 账号与隐私. Only an article of
category help may carry one.

RouteTarget.description:
In-app jump target {route, params} (contracts/routes.json; TECH-04). route stays a string on
purpose: a server may return a route newer than an installed client, which then opens the
upgrade page (03 §4.4), so the HTTP contract cannot pin the route list. The client checks
route and params against its own routes table (bridge RouteTarget) before opening; the
server only stores targets checked against routes.json when they are saved.

NoticeItem.description:
One notice-bar entry, shared by the static (home schema) and api (GET /v1/articles notice
category) sources; closing and content-version rules only in BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的
关闭与内容版本」 (04 §6.2).

not.description: A notice that cannot be closed must have end_at (BR-TEXT-13 细则「生效区间」).

item_id.description: For api entries the notice article id.

ArticleSummary.description: A list item; items of the notice category carry notice (04 §6.2), others do not.

help_section.description: Present only when category is help and the current version has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

faq_rank.description: Present only when category is help and the current version has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

ArticleListSummaryText.description:
List summary (W-25, 编排者默认): derived by the server from the current version's body —
the plain text of its first non-empty paragraph, cut to 80 characters; not entered in the
admin console. Absent when the body has no text paragraph (never null).

ArticleFaqRank.description:
Manual order of a help article in the help home 「常见问题」 list (W-25, 编排者默认): the
client sorts that list by faq_rank ascending (the server keeps the usual list order of
04 §6.2); GET /v1/articles?category=help&faq=true lists only articles whose current
version has it set. Help articles only.

help_section.description: Present only when category is help and the returned version has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

faq_rank.description: Present only when category is help and the returned version has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

ArticleVersionStatus.description:
Status of one article version row (04 §6.2): draft = saved, never published; published =
published (counts only once published_at is not later than now); offline = taken offline.

AdminArticleSummary.description: One article in the admin list.

title.description: Title of the newest version row.

current_version.description: Largest published version already due; null = none.

published_at.description: published_at of the current version; null when there is none.

row_version.description: The article's CAS value (row_version of the newest version row).

help_section.description: Value of the newest version row; present only when category is help and that row has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

faq_rank.description: Value of the newest version row; present only when category is help and that row has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

AdminProductPoolStatus.description: Pool status; a disabled pool is read as empty (编排者默认).

AdminPoolItemStatus.description: Shelf status of a pool item (BR-PROD-08 ③).

AdminProductPoolName.description: Name shown in the console (编排者默认 1–64 characters).

AdminProductPoolUpdateRequest.description:
Body of PATCH /admin/v1/product-pools/{pool_id}: `expected_revision` plus at least one
of `name` and `status`.

AdminPoolItem.description: One item of a product pool (04 pool_items) with its last refreshed price.

quoted_at.description: Time of the last successful refresh (BR-PRICE-11).

invalid_reason.description: Why the system took it offline or a re-check failed; shown to the operator.

AdminPoolItemAddRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/product-pools/{pool_id}/items: exactly one of `link_text` and
`item_ref`, plus `sort`, `start_at` and `end_at`. The oneOf branches declare the property
they require (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

link_text.description: A link or token, resolved as parseInput resolves it.

AdminPoolCandidate.description:
One union search row for adminAddPoolItem: prices without any rebate, and no link_id
(BR-PROD-11 item_ref is passed through unchanged).

next_cursor.description: Pass back unchanged for the next page; null means no more.

AdminArticleVersion.description: One version row of an article.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only; true for other categories.

notice_content_version.description: Maintained by the server on save (BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的关闭与内容版本」).

notice_end_at.description: End of the notice's effective window; null for other categories.

published_at.description: Publish time (a later time = scheduled); null for a version never published.

help_section.description: Value of this version row; present only when category is help and the row has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

faq_rank.description: Value of this version row; present only when category is help and the row has one set; absent otherwise (never null).

AdminArticle.description: An article with every version row.

row_version.description:
The article's CAS value (row_version of the newest version row): a draft save gives the
new row the previous newest row's value + 1, publish and offline add 1 to the newest
row, never going back.

current_version.description: Largest published version already due; null = none.

versions.description: Every version row, newest first, drafts and offline versions included.

article_id.description:
Client-generated UUIDv7 (lowercase canonical form), generated once per new article and
reused on every retry of the same create. An id that already exists → 20902
`data.resource=article` (no second article); read it back with GET
/admin/v1/articles/{article_id}.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only (default true); ignored for other categories.

notice_end_at.description: Notices only; required when notice_closable is false. Ignored for other categories.

help_section.description:
Help articles only; omitted = no sub-section. Not nullable. Sent with a category
other than help → 20001 `data.fields` containing help_section.

faq_rank.description:
Help articles only; omitted = not in the 「常见问题」 list. Not nullable. Sent with a
category other than help → 20001 `data.fields` containing faq_rank.

body.description: tiptap JSON document as a string.

notice_closable.description: Notices only (default true); ignored for other categories.

notice_end_at.description: Notices only; required when notice_closable is false. Ignored for other categories.

help_section.description:
Help articles only; omitted = no sub-section (a draft is a whole new version row, so
omitting it clears the value). Not nullable. Sent with a category other than help →
20001 `data.fields` containing help_section.

faq_rank.description:
Help articles only; omitted = not in the 「常见问题」 list (a draft is a whole new
version row, so omitting it clears the value). Not nullable. Sent with a category
other than help → 20001 `data.fields` containing faq_rank.

expected_row_version.description: The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: The newest version, in status draft.

published_at.description: When the version takes effect; default now, earlier than now is 20001.

expected_row_version.description: The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The article's `row_version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

store.description: Store key of specs/app-stores.yaml (that file comes with CT-19b).

min_supported_version.description: Null when no minimum is set for this platform and channel (no interception).

sections.description: Sections as stored in page_versions.sections (shape owned by the page schema).

ttl_sec.description:
How long the client may reuse this response, in seconds; the server constant 300 (the
example value of 03 §6.1, pending a write-back to the plan).

sections.description:
Only the sections whose condition matches and whose min_app_version this platform and
app version meet; the page shape is contracts/home-schema.json (sections:
`$defs/section`).

items.description: In server order; the client does not reorder them.

has_more.description:
`union_material`: as upstream reports it (BR-PRICE-08), never rewritten by our own
filters. `product_pool`: true while rows of the list remain.

MarkMessagesReadRequest.description: Exactly one of message_ids (1–100 ids, duplicates counted once) or all=true.

marked_count.description: Messages this call turned from unread to read.

unread_count.description: Unread messages of the account left after the call.

service_push.description: Push of service messages (trades and withdrawals); the only switch shown in the MVP.

subscription_push.description: Push of subscription messages; reserved, not shown in the MVP.

marketing_push.description: Push of marketing messages; reserved, not shown in the MVP.

WithdrawalSubTextBranch.description:
contracts/enums/fund.yaml withdrawal_sub_text_branch: the sub-text branch of the
withdrawal, computed by the server from the BR-WDR-25 细则 table (first matching row from
the top, at response time): the value is that row's sub_text_branch column, and the values
here are exactly the values of that column. Several rows may share one value (the W10
failure rows share failed_manual and are told apart by hold_days); the PAID_API /
PAID_MANUAL row gives paid_api or paid_manual by status. The branch conditions and the
wording live only in BR-WDR-25 and /v1/dict; the status title stays with status
(BR-TEXT-06). A client meeting an unknown value shows the processing sub-text.

LedgerEntry.description: An available-subaccount entry, or the WITHDRAW_PAID summary entry of a paid withdrawal (BR-FUND-15).

balance_after_fen.description: Available balance after this entry (may be negative).
Always null; the summary entry does not change the available balance.

block_code.description: The error code that blocks a withdrawal now (contracts/error-codes.yaml), null when none.

quick_amounts_fen.description: Quick amount choices; empty when there are none.

masked_account.description: Masked snapshot of the payee account (BR-ID-33 细则).

reason_code.description: reject_reason_code or fail_code of a rejected or failed withdrawal (BR-TEXT-06).

fail_action.description:
Action for account-type failures, e.g. change_payout_account (BR-TEXT-08). Null on
every other withdrawal, including a W10 failure (manual_resolution=failed,
sub_text_branch failed_manual): the needs_manual resolution (BR-WDR-15) does not offer
changing the payout account.

review_deadline.description:
withdrawals.review_deadline, the manual-review deadline (BR-WDR-26); null when the
withdrawal has none. Interpolated by the manual_review_pending sub-text (BR-WDR-25).

executed_at.description:
withdrawals.executed_at; null before execution and again after a W9 return to APPROVED
(BR-WDR-13).

paid_at.description: withdrawals.paid_at; set only in PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL, otherwise null.

channel_state.description:
withdrawals.channel_state (BR-WDR-33 ⑤); only a wechat withdrawal in PAYING has a
value, otherwise null. Not a withdrawal status.

confirm_deadline.description:
withdrawals.confirm_deadline, the latest time to confirm the transfer in WeChat
(BR-WDR-33 ⑥); only wechat withdrawals, otherwise null. Interpolated by the
wechat_wait_confirm sub-text (BR-WDR-25).

hold_days.description:
Days of the manual_failed_watch hold added with a W10 failure (BR-WDR-15; the hold
period of withdraw.manual_failed_hold_days at the time of the decision), interpolated by
the failed_manual sub-text (BR-WDR-25). Both W10 rows of the BR-WDR-25 table have
sub_text_branch failed_manual; hold_days alone tells them apart: non-null when the hold
was added (the sub-text with the hold sentence), null when it was not (a wechat
withdrawal proven cancelled, BR-WDR-33 ⑧; the sub-text without the hold sentence). Null
on every other withdrawal.

Withdrawal.description: A withdrawal with channel_order_id (detail and create response).

masked_account.description: Masked snapshot of the payee account (BR-ID-33 细则).

reason_code.description: reject_reason_code or fail_code of a rejected or failed withdrawal (BR-TEXT-06).

fail_action.description:
Action for account-type failures, e.g. change_payout_account (BR-TEXT-08). Null on
every other withdrawal, including a W10 failure (manual_resolution=failed,
sub_text_branch failed_manual): the needs_manual resolution (BR-WDR-15) does not offer
changing the payout account.

review_deadline.description:
withdrawals.review_deadline, the manual-review deadline (BR-WDR-26); null when the
withdrawal has none. Interpolated by the manual_review_pending sub-text (BR-WDR-25).

executed_at.description:
withdrawals.executed_at; null before execution and again after a W9 return to APPROVED
(BR-WDR-13).

paid_at.description: withdrawals.paid_at; set only in PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL, otherwise null.

channel_state.description:
withdrawals.channel_state (BR-WDR-33 ⑤); only a wechat withdrawal in PAYING has a
value, otherwise null. Not a withdrawal status.

confirm_deadline.description:
withdrawals.confirm_deadline, the latest time to confirm the transfer in WeChat
(BR-WDR-33 ⑥); only wechat withdrawals, otherwise null. Interpolated by the
wechat_wait_confirm sub-text (BR-WDR-25).

hold_days.description:
Days of the manual_failed_watch hold added with a W10 failure (BR-WDR-15; the hold
period of withdraw.manual_failed_hold_days at the time of the decision), interpolated by
the failed_manual sub-text (BR-WDR-25). Both W10 rows of the BR-WDR-25 table have
sub_text_branch failed_manual; hold_days alone tells them apart: non-null when the hold
was added (the sub-text with the hold sentence), null when it was not (a wechat
withdrawal proven cancelled, BR-WDR-33 ⑧; the sub-text without the hold sentence). Null
on every other withdrawal.

channel_order_id.description: Channel serial number, only in PAID_API / PAID_MANUAL when recorded (BR-WDR-25 细则).

PayChannelCode.description: Collection channel (enum pay_channel, BR-PAY-01); unrelated to payout_channel.

PayOrderStatus.description: pay_orders.status (enum pay_order_status, BR-PAY-02); PAID and CLOSED are final.

PayBizType.description:
A business type registered for payment (BR-PAY-01 ①); none is registered yet, so the
server refuses every value with 30901 reason=biz_not_sellable until one is.

PayBizRef.description: The business object of biz_type the order pays for (one purchase per object, BR-PAY-02).

PayAmountFen.description: Amount in fen set by the server from the business type's price, positive and never changed (BR-PAY-02).

CreatePayOrderRequest.description: No amount, title or identity field; the server prices the order (BR-PAY-01 ①).

PayOrder.description:
A pay order as the user sees it. No channel-side user identifier (openid, buyer id, …)
and no merchant secret is ever part of it (BR-PAY-08 ④).

PayLaunchWechatPay.description:
WeChat Pay APP payment: the fields of the SDK's PayReq (appId, partnerId, prepayId,
packageValue, nonceStr, timeStamp, sign) as in the official WeChat Pay APP payment
documentation, signed by the server; package is the fixed value Sign=WXPay and timestamp
is Unix seconds as a string. 待 CAP-X-16 实测 (field names and values not yet verified
against a real merchant account).

PayLaunchAlipay.description:
Alipay App payment: order_str is the complete signed order string the SDK's payOrder /
pay takes, as in the official Alipay App payment documentation. 待 CAP-X-17 实测 (not yet
verified against a real merchant account).

PayLaunch.description:
Launch parameters for the channel SDK, the branch of the order's pay_channel (wechat_pay
→ PayLaunchWechatPay, alipay → PayLaunchAlipay). Field names follow the official channel
documentation and are 待实测 (pending verification: WeChat Pay CAP-X-16, Alipay
CAP-X-17). They are signed on the server; no private key, API key or certificate is
sent. Sensitive: not written to logs by the server or the clients (x-no-log), only kept in
memory long enough to call the SDK.

RiskInfo.description: Risk state for the ban / freeze explanation page (BR-ID-31, 拍板第二批 OPS-12).

reason_category.description: User-visible reason category (BR-ID-31); null when state=normal.

prev_risk_state.description:
When state=appealing, the penalty in force before the appeal (frozen or banned); null
otherwise. While appealing, reason_category and frozen_until keep the values of that
original penalty (BR-ID-36 细则).

invite_code.description: Null when the user cannot invite; invite_blocked_reason then tells the two cases apart.

invite_blocked_reason.description:
Present only when invite_code is null (absent otherwise, never null; N-02, 编排者默认):
self_minor = the user is identified as under 18 (BR-INV-19: the client hides the invite
code and the whole 「推广与邀请」 group, including the 分享赚 entry); unavailable = any
other inviter_unavailable case (BR-INV-18: the invite page still opens and shows
「暂不可邀请」 without a reason). No other reason is revealed. Not returned until its
implementation is merged.

inviter_bound.description: Only whether an inviter is bound, never who.

phone_bound.description: Whether a phone number is bound (BR-ID-01).

need_reconsent.description: The user must agree to the current legal version again (BR-ID-12).

PlatformPurchaseStatus.description:
Derived from convert.enabled.<platform> and convert.off_reason.<platform> (04 §10.1); lets
cards tell "maintenance" from "coming soon" before a tap. The tap result (50301
data.reason) still wins.

flags.description:
Client switches by key: agent.entry.visible, clipboard.enabled.<platform>,
home.fallback, h5.route.<page>.enabled, ui.grayscale (03 §4.3);
external_page.product_intercept (a platform product page inside the third-party page
container goes back to the native product detail) and external_page.union_host_block
(the container does not load union platform pages; derived from the server setting of
the same name; a client that cannot read it treats it as on) (BR-ATTR-29);
earnings.dashboard.visible (earnings dashboard entry, derived from
earnings.dashboard.enabled, BR-FUND-25).
Clipboard switches (BR-ID-16 细则「服务端开关」): clipboard.enabled.<platform> filters
recognition by e-commerce platform; clipboard.auto_read.<client> (client is ios, android
or harmony) turns off automatic clipboard reading on that client. A missing key counts
as on; these keys can only turn a feature off, never turn on what the user turned off.
account.phone_change_enabled: client copy of the phone change switch, for display only
(a missing key counts as on); the server still decides on every request (BR-ID-06 细则).
product_feedback (product feedback entry on the detail page, derived from
feedback.enabled) and jd_plus_note (PLUS note on JD product details, derived from
detail.jd_plus_note.enabled) (04 §10.1, §10.2): derived values win over a key of the
same name in the base dictionary; a client that finds the key missing or false shows
nothing (no default-on in the client).

search_status.description:
Search switch by platform code, derived from search.enabled.<platform> (04 §10.1);
how a client treats a missing platform is in BR-PROD-10 细则.

rank_platforms.description:
Platforms selectable on the hot list, derived by the server from the channel whitelist
in specs/material-channels.yaml (04 §6.3, 04 §10.1). Not a switch.

PlatformSearchStatus.description: Whether search is open for a platform (enum platform_search_status).

min_version.description: Below this version the user must agree again (BR-ID-12).

legal.agreement.min_version (BR-ID-12 正文; 04 §10.1 2026-10-20 补登). Absent when the key
is not set (缺失不下发). This field triggers no blocking: whether a client below it is
refused is pending (变更记录 20261020-内容线默认回写 §3). The server does not check it
against version.

ConfigLegal.description:
legal.privacy.version, legal.privacy.min_version, legal.agreement.version and the optional
legal.agreement.min_version (04 §10.1).

required.description: Must be false in the MVP (BR-INV-06).

backfill_hours.description: Window for entering an inviter later (BR-INV-07).

bind_phone_guide.description:
Show the bind-phone guide to new third-party accounts (BR-INV-03 细则). Optional in
the schema like every key added after v0.9; the server always sends it.

before_buy_tip.description:
Deprecated 2026-10-19: the first-purchase inviter tip is cancelled (BR-INV-03 细则,
BR-INV-21); clients no longer read it. Kept in the schema and never reused; the server
may still send it until it is removed.

reward_enabled.description:
Whether the invite reward campaign is live (BR-INV-24 ① ⑨): the switch is on and the
total budget left (total − reserved − granted) covers both parties' amounts. When true
the client shows invite.reward.tip (invitee side) or invite.reward.tip_inviter (invite
page). Server-derived, never read from config_items of the same name (04 §10.1,
BR-INV-24 ⑨); a missing switch counts as off. Optional in the schema like every key
added after v0.9; the server always sends it.

reward_amount_fen.description:
Amount each party gets, in fen (BR-INV-24 ①; the {amount} of invite.reward.tip and
invite.reward.tip_inviter, formatted by BR-TEXT-10). Server-derived, never read from
config_items of the same name (04 §10.1, BR-INV-24 ⑨); a missing amount takes the
BR-INV-24 default. Optional in the schema like every key added after v0.9; the server
always sends it.

eligibility_days.description:
Days an invited friend has, counted from qualifying at binding, to place a qualifying
own order (BR-INV-24「有效期」); the N of the invite page rule summary (BR-INV-18 细则,
rendered by BR-TEXT-13). Server-derived from config growth.invite_reward.eligibility_days,
never read from a config_items key of the same name; a missing or malformed value takes
the BR-INV-24 default. Applies to friends who qualify from now on; already-qualified
friends keep their locked days. Optional in the schema like every key added after v0.9;
the server always sends it.

ConfigAgent.description: Agent availability and guest quota (04 §10.1; BR-AI-11, BR-AI-12).

ConfigH5Release.description: H5 version bucket for this caller (拍板第二批 TECH-28).

ConfigKf.description: WeCom customer-service chat link (chat entry only).

nav_host_sample_bp.description: Sampling rate of document-level navigation hosts, 1/10000 (default in BR-ATTR-29).

LinkPatternCategory.description: Category of a platform link pattern (enum link_pattern_category, BR-ATTR-29).

LinkPatternRule.description:
Hosts and path patterns of one platform and category. How hosts match (union_host by
registered domain including subdomains) and the path pattern syntax are defined with the
source table specs/link-patterns.yaml (CT-15g); concrete values come from real samples (B1-07).

ConfigLinkPatterns.description:
Client pre-filter subset of the platform link pattern table (source
specs/link-patterns.yaml). Clients decide where a document-level navigation in the
third-party page container goes (main frame, subframe, new window); product recognition
follows the server. When the fetch fails they use the last good version, then the bundled
snapshot, and never stop intercepting (BR-ATTR-29).

recheck_interval_sec.description:
On returning to the foreground, call GET /v1/app-versions/check again when the last
successful check is older than this (value and bundled default in BR-ID-01 细则
「最低支持版本的接口层拦截」).

HelpLinkTarget.description:
Jump target {route, params} of a help_links entry: always one help article, the Help
route of contracts/routes.json with its article_id (04 §10.1「原生页到帮助文章的入口表」).
conformance.ts checks that the route exists there and that params is a subset of that
route's params schema.

ConfigNickname.description:
Nickname limits for rendering settings.nickname.hint (BR-TEXT-14 表 C; values from
BR-ID-39, sent by the server from that rule, not read from config_items). When absent the
client uses the wording without numbers (to be registered with BR-TEXT-14).

min_len.description: Minimum length in characters after trimming leading and trailing blanks.

max_len.description: Maximum length in characters after trimming leading and trailing blanks.

monthly_limit.description: Successful changes allowed per calendar month (+08:00).

window_days.description:
Days within which an order claim may be filed, claim.window_hours rounded down to
days; null when below one day or not configured. Only renders the claim form's period
sentence (BR-ATTR-17 细则「找回页的填写指引」); claim.window_hours is not sent.

Config.description:
Top-level keys of /v1/config (04 §10.1, excerpt). Keys added after v0.9 (external_page,
link_patterns, external_hosts, app_update, help_links, claim, platform_icons,
lkg_max_age_sec, config_version, bridge_disabled_methods, nickname) are optional, so a client keeps reading an older last-good configuration (04 §5「兼容」); the
server always sends them, except that platform_icons lists only the marks with a published
replacement image (BR-TEXT-24). jump_tip, auth_tips, compliance and display are not
shaped by 04 yet and stay free-form; the task that consumes each one types it.
bridge_origins is the signed whitelist ConfigBridgeOrigins (CT-03c / F1-02zzzb, D10-610).
clipboard is ConfigClipboard (only consent_version is typed).

external_hosts.description:
Third-party page hosts a deep link may open in ExternalPage, matched by full host name
(values and default in BR-ID-10 细则「深链能打开的第三方页面」); push and in-app
targets are not limited by it (03 §4.4).

help_links.description:
Native entries to help articles: key → jump target; an entry whose key is not
configured is not shown. Keys are defined by the rules that use them: price_compare
(BR-TEXT-03), claim_guide.<platform> (BR-ATTR-17 细则), login_help (BR-ID-02 细则),
withdraw_rules (BR-WDR-04 细则), share_rules (the public share rules article, entered
from the share page and the 分享赚 entry; W-25), faq.invite_code_bind (the invite-code
binding FAQ; W-25, where it is shown is left to design), invite_rules (the invite
rules article, entered from 完整规则 on the H5 invite page; D10-252), invite_reward_rules
(the invite reward campaign rules article, entered from 活动规则 on the same page;
D10-252). Values are operations configuration (article ids).

lkg_max_age_sec.description: How long a last good configuration may be used, in seconds (02 §10, 03 §4.3); default 604800 (7 days).

config_version.description: Release version of this configuration, equal to the response ETag without quotes; saved together with the LKG (04 §10.1, 03 §4.7).

bridge_disabled_methods.description: Bridge methods disabled remotely; a call answers 90403 method_disabled (03 §5.3). Trial; default empty array.

ConfigPlatformIcon.description:
A replacement image published in the admin console for one platform mark (BR-TEXT-24).
Stored in the OSS media bucket under its content SHA-256 and cached long; each platform is
versioned on its own and a publish takes effect at once.

url.description:
Image address on the media domain (set by deployment, not fixed by the contract); the
file name is the content SHA-256.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the image content, the same digest as the file name.

version.description: Version of this platform's replacement image, counted per platform.

ConfigPlatformIcons.description: Platform mark replacement images (04 §10.1, BR-TEXT-24 细则): mark key → replacement image. Lists only the keys for which the admin console has published a replacement; a missing key (never replaced, or 「恢复内置」) means the client shows the image bundled in the package, and the object may be empty. Native clients download the image and check its SHA-256 before use, falling back to the bundled image on a mismatch; H5 loads it with `` and falls back to the bundled image on error. The accessible name is always the platform's Chinese name and never follows the image. The keys are enum platform_icon_key (PlatformIconKey, also the {key} of /admin/v1/platform-icons); new platforms add a key to both the same way.

Dict.description: The text dictionary (BR-TEXT-12); a key `<dict>.<code>` is items[dict][code].

version.description: Dictionary version, equal to data.dict_version of GET /v1/config; "0" before the first publish.

items.description: Texts by dict (the key's first segment), then by code (the rest of the key).

ProductCta.description:
