Buy button chosen by the server and sent as cta.text_key; the client never decides it
(BR-TEXT-12 细则「购买按钮」, 拍板第二批 TRADE-21, changed 2026-11-05): btn.buy.rebate
(rebate_basis=normal with a single amount), btn.buy.rebate_unknown (amount_unknown),
rebate_login_to_view (login_required), btn.buy (pages that show no rebate amount, i.e.
LinkLanding), btn.buy.no_rebate (the card turns no-rebate on tap); the same key with or
without a coupon. Taolijin cards follow BR-TEXT-15. Since 2026-11-05 btn.buy.coupon and
btn.buy.rebate_suffix are kept but unused, and their key names are not reused.

ProductTlj.description: Taolijin of the card, absent when there is none (BR-PRICE-08); never folded into prices.

ProductCard.description:
Product card (04 §8.3). Price semantics BR-PRICE-01 / 05; rebate_* and est_net_price_fen
are computed per request for the current caller and never cached (BR-PRICE-11). The card
carries a registered `link_id`; buying always goes through POST /v1/links/{link_id}/open
(BR-PRICE-12, BR-PRICE-21). amount_unknown cards have product_key, prices and rebate
null (BR-PRICE-08).

card_id.description: Agent card sequence id (c1, c2…), only on Agent cards (BR-AI-05).

product_key.description: Opaque product key (BR-PROD-02); null only on amount_unknown cards.

item_ref.description: Opaque signed reference passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

shop_type.description: Shop type, e.g. tmall for Tmall shops on taobao.

images.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (product detail, FU-DETAIL-GALLERY, D10-649);
absent on every other card (search, lists, sections, parse, rank, favourites). Main image
first, then the extra images of the union product API in their order; deduplicated
before the cut, at most 9, addresses unchanged (same as the share page images,
BR-ATTR-10 细则「分享页与分享赚入口页」); [] when the union gives no image. Not
downloaded, edited or kept in any business table. A single image shows as today.

no_rebate_cause.description:
May be non-null only when rebate_basis=no_rebate (BR-PRICE-08 细则「无返利原因」);
unknown values are treated as null. Not the open request's no_rebate_reason.

benefit_tags.description: Server-generated labels (有券, 预售, 标题显示为 X…); no per-card reasons.

is_presale.description: Presale; shown with the total price (BR-PRICE-22).

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

age_sec.description: Age of the price in seconds, computed by the server (BR-PRICE-11).

ad_label.description: Ad label (BR-TEXT-17); null on Agent relevance cards.

favorited.description:
Only on the product detail response (GET /v1/products/{product_key}): whether the
caller has favorited this product; false when not logged in (规划/01 F-PROD-12).

coupon_end_at.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (product detail, 04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」,
D10-664); absent on every other card (search, lists, sections, parse, rank, favourites,
Agent). End time of the selected coupon, ISO 8601 with +08:00, normalised as BR-PRICE-01
细则「时间与剩余量」 (no time zone read as +08:00; a date-only end becomes the next day
00:00:00+08:00). Non-null only when coupon_fen > 0 and the union gives the selected
coupon's end time; null while the platform's `detail.coupon_end.enabled.<platform>` is
off (default off until 规划/09 registers the field's meaning and time zone). Display:
BR-PRICE-04 细则「商品详情的券标签」; null or absent shows only the amount part of the
coupon tag, with no default end time.

sales_text.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」); absent on every
other card. The union's sales field as an unchanged string (for now only pinduoduo
sales_tip), same meaning as `sales_text` of GET /v1/rank/hot; never computed or
estimated (BR-TEXT-13 细则「虚拟数据」). Null when the platform's
`detail.sales.enabled.<platform>` is off or the union gives none; null or absent hides
the sales line.

shop_logo.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」); absent on every
other card. Shop logo address as the union gives it; for now only pinduoduo
`mall_img_url` may carry one (official docs, not yet recorded, 规划/09 §6 U-92); the
taobao and jd product APIs give none. Null or absent: the client shows the platform
mark instead (规划/03 §10.2 `StoreCard`).

shop_scores.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」); absent on every
other card. Shop scores as the union gives them, each key at most once; [] while the
platform's `detail.shop_scores.enabled.<platform>` is off. The client shows each item
as label (`shop.score.<key>`) plus the unchanged value, hides an empty item and hides
the whole line when none is left (BR-TEXT-14 表 C「商品详情·店铺评分」, BR-TEXT-13
细则「虚拟数据」).

shop_entry.description:
Only on GET /v1/products/{product_key} (04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」); absent on every
other card. Whether the shop can be entered, decided by the server per BR-PRICE-21
细则「进店」 (`shop.entry.enabled.<platform>` on, the product has a shop id and the
configured source can make a shop link carrying the user's attribution). false or
absent: no 【进店】 and the shop block is not tappable.

price_spec_hint.description:
Spec qualifier of the price, decided by the server per BR-PROD-04 (and its 细则); the
client never infers it from title, spec_text or prices. price_from: the union returned
a price range or the price is known to be the lowest spec's, so the main price reads
「¥x 起」 (amount per BR-TEXT-10, e.g. 券后 ¥29.9 起) with no further note.
spec_uncertain: the spec the product-level price belongs to cannot be determined, so
`spec_min_price_note` (规格以下单页为准) is shown beside the price (on product detail
in the coupon tag row, BR-PRICE-04 细则「商品详情的券标签」). null: neither. Carried by
every card response (BR-PROD-04: beside the price on cards and on product detail;
D10-688); list-type cards give null until the server-side judgement (S-19) covers them.
Absent is read as null.

ProductShopScore.description: One shop score of the product detail card (04 §8.3「商品详情专用字段」).

key.description:
desc (描述), serv (服务), lgst (物流), level (店铺等级); labels `shop.score.<key>`
(BR-TEXT-14 表 C). Unknown keys are skipped by the client.

value.description:
The union's value unchanged (pinduoduo 高 / 中 / 低, jd shop level digits), not a
dictionary key and never computed; the jd level scale is shown as is until 规划/09
confirms it.

has_more.description: As reported by the union, not by the filtered page size (BR-PRICE-08).

fallback_items.description: Only when items is empty on the first page; the platform's first 10 feed items.

favorited_at.description: When the product was favorited (the original time for a repeated add).

InvalidFavoriteCard.description: Card of an invalid favorite; only the title and the image, no price and no rebate.

invalid.description:
true when fetching the card the union answered that the product does not exist, is
off shelf or cannot be promoted.

product_card.description:
invalid=false: the list card, same shape as a search card (ProductCard). invalid=true:
InvalidFavoriteCard, only the title and the image.

status.description: ok = points to draw; no_data = show price_trend.empty.

points.description: One point per day in date order; empty when status=no_data.

start_date.description: Date of the first record in the window; null when status=no_data.

source_key.description: Text key of the source line (price_trend.source.general for a product without coupon).

HotRankCategory.description: One category the hot-list channel offers (04 §6.3 GET /v1/rank/hot).

name.description: Display name as the channel gives it.

rank.description: Position in the channel's own order, from 1; never reordered.

sales_text.description: The union's sales field unchanged; null when the union gives none.

channel.description: channel_id of the whitelisted channel used (specs/material-channels.yaml).

notice_key.description: Text key of the notice line at the top of the list.

keyword.description: Matched against the trimmed input as a whole word, ignoring case.

text.description:
Locally filtered clipboard or typed text (03 §4.6). Text outside links and tokens
is untrusted (BR-AI-05); prices in it are only material.claimed_price_fen.

scene.description:
Entry the text came from (subset of contracts/enums scene). Attribution-bearing
scenes (share, agent, …) cannot be chosen by the client: share links come only from
POST /v1/shares (phone level), Agent cards from the Agent service (BR-ATTR-05, 08).
share_ext is P1.

raw.description: The matched link or token as it appeared in the input.

ParseResult.description:
Result of one hit; exactly one of `card` and `error_code` is present. The oneOf branches
declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).

error_code.description: Error code for this hit (30131, 30132, 30141, 50301…), see error-codes.yaml.

ProductFeedbackRequest.description:
Body of product feedback (04 §6.3). Only the fields BR-ID-30 细则「商品反馈记录」 lists;
no contact fields, and any other field is 20001. The shown_* fields and quoted_at are
what the page displayed at the time; the server keeps them as given next to the quote
snapshot of link_id.

shown_rebate_fen.description: Rebate amount shown on the page; null when the page showed none.

quoted_at.description: Quote time shown with the price.

note.description: Optional note, at most 100 characters (BR-TEXT-14 表 C feedback.note.*).

ShopOpenRequest.description: Body of the shop entry (04 §6.3); no scene (BR-ATTR-08 exception).

installed.description: Default unknown; H5 always sends unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①).
Default unknown; H5 always sends unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①).

no_rebate_reason.description:
Only with no_rebate=true; default auth_declined. The server overrides it with
relation_conflict / binding_blocked when it decides so (BR-ID-18).

OpenLinkResult.description:
Response of open (04 §8.4). old_final_price_fen is the link's quoted_final_price_fen;
price_changed when |new − old| ≥ 100 fen or ≥ 5 % of old, both directions (BR-PRICE-13).
Prices and rebates are null on amount_unknown links, which are not re-checked. There is no
rebate_basis: no rebate is expressed by new_rebate_max_fen = 0 (BR-PRICE-08, BR-PRICE-13).

attempt_id.description:
Issued by the server for this open attempt: a new one for every open of a link, the
same one when the same Idempotency-Key is replayed. The client sends it in every
link_jump of this jump (BR-ATTR-21 细则「待跟单卡按实际外跳选」).

no_rebate_cause.description:
Non-null only when new_rebate_max_fen = 0 and the reason is known; unknown values are
treated as null. Not the request's no_rebate_reason (BR-ID-18).

new_link_id.description:
Set whenever the new price differs from the snapshot, or when a new link was
registered for the current user (BR-PRICE-12, BR-ATTR-05 ③); the client replaces the
card with it whether or not the user continues.

requote_failed.description:
Re-check failed: the user's cached link (≤ 900 s) is used, or, for a `no_rebate=true`
open, the no-rebate conversion or unpromoted product page (BR-PRICE-13).

ConvertLinkRequest.description:
Either product_key (with the tapped card's item_ref) or url; neither, or both, is 20001.
The oneOf branches declare the property they require (strict Ajv2020, ADR-0001 §4.2 #15).
A Taobao url is first resolved to an item_id and answered with a Baichuan open instruction
(JumpStep.sdk); the pasted link or token itself is never passed on (BR-PRICE-21).

scene.description:
Only the H5 entry (trade.convertAndOpen) uses convert (拍板第二批 TRADE-03); other
scenes are rejected with 20001 so that the client cannot pick an attribution scene
such as share (BR-ATTR-05, BR-ATTR-08).

installed.description: Default unknown; H5 always sends unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①).

ConvertLinkData.description: The registered link_id plus the same fields as the open result (04 §6.3).

attempt_id.description:
Issued by the server for this open attempt: a new one for every open of a link, the
same one when the same Idempotency-Key is replayed. The client sends it in every
link_jump of this jump (BR-ATTR-21 细则「待跟单卡按实际外跳选」).

no_rebate_cause.description:
Non-null only when new_rebate_max_fen = 0 and the reason is known; unknown values are
treated as null. Not the request's no_rebate_reason (BR-ID-18).

LinkKind.description: Kind of a link on the in-app landing page (contracts/enums/trade.yaml link_kind).

SharedProductCard.description:
Product card subset of the share page and the in-app link landing page (04 §6.3): the
fields of ProductCard without rebate_min_fen, rebate_max_fen, rebate_basis,
no_rebate_cause and est_net_price_fen (no rebate amount is shown to the opener,
BR-PRICE-06, BR-ATTR-10), without cta (its key is derived from the rebate state), and
without the Agent-only card_id, match_tag and spec_text. quoted_at sits next to the card.

product_key.description: Opaque product key (BR-PROD-02); null only on amount_unknown cards.

item_ref.description: Opaque signed reference passed through unchanged (BR-PROD-11).

shop_type.description: Shop type, e.g. tmall for Tmall shops on taobao.

is_presale.description: Presale; shown with the total price (BR-PRICE-22).

age_sec.description: Age of the price in seconds, computed by the server (BR-PRICE-11).

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

viewer_is_sharer.description:
True only when called with a token whose user is the sharer of this share link; only
for the hint above the card (BR-ATTR-11). False for anonymous calls and other links.

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

jump_url.description: The sharer's converted short link used for the jump; never contains a token.

tpwd_ticket.description:
Short-lived ticket for POST /v1/share-pages/{link_id}/tpwd; null inside WeChat, without
User-Agent, or when the link has no token (BR-ATTR-10 细则).

open_in_app_url.description: LinkLanding deep link; null while share.open_in_app.enabled is off.

tpwd.description: The token of the share link, to be copied by the page.

CreateShareRequest.description:
Body of POST /v1/shares (04 §6.3). The share page only carries platform and product_key
(plus the card's item_ref when it has one), whether it was opened from a card, ShareHub or
the favorites (BR-ATTR-10 细则「分享页与分享赚入口页」).

source_link_id.description:
The link of the card the share page was opened from; only recorded as the source,
never changed and never used for sharing.

url.description:
Image address as returned by the union product API; kept in no business table, the only
exception being the whole response the platform idempotency module keeps for its
retention period, replayed unchanged on the same key (D10-439).

ShareCopyPart.description:
A tickable part of the share copy (BR-TEXT-20 细则「分享页文案」); the fixed price-basis
line is not a part.

ShareCopyParts.description:
Rendered text of each part; the client joins the ticked parts line by line in this order.
A part that does not apply, or whose field the platform API did not return for this
product, is absent or null; the client treats both alike and shows neither the part nor
its tick box. price_line is the sale-price wording without a coupon; pre_coupon_line and
coupon_line are only returned with a coupon. tpwd_line is Taobao only. No part ever carries
a rebate or promotion amount (BR-TEXT-20 细则「分享页文案」, BR-PRICE-06).

ShareCopy.description:
Default copy of the share page, from the platform's full template (BR-TEXT-20 细则「分享页文案」).
default_text is every returned part in order followed by the fixed price-basis line
(price_basis with a coupon, price_basis.general without, BR-PRICE-17), which has no tick
box and does not change with the ticks.

include_default.description: Parts ticked by default; only parts returned in this response (all of them by default).

ShareEstPromo.description:
Quote of the caller's own share (buy_type=share, BR-PRICE-06; computed by
packages/domain.quoteRebate(), BR-CALC-20). Shown only to the sharer on the share page as
the estimated promotion earnings; never in the copy, poster, images or share page.

ShareMaterials.description: Share materials of a newly registered share link (04 §6.3 POST /v1/shares).

link_id.description: The share link registered by this call (pid_scene=share).

share_url.description: Short share link of the sharer's converted link.

tpwd.description:
Taobao token; always present for Taobao (otherwise the whole call fails, BR-ATTR-10
细则「淘宝分享实现」), null for JD and Pinduoduo.

poster_url.description:
Poster drawn by the server from a unified template (TECH-13); always null until the
poster worker ships (D10-426).

images.description:
Main image and the extra images returned by the union product API, unchanged, at most 9;
only the main image when no extra images are available. Not downloaded, edited or
watermarked, and kept in no business table; the only exception is the whole response
the platform idempotency module keeps for its retention period, replayed unchanged on
the same key (BR-ATTR-10 细则「分享页与分享赚入口页」, D10-439).

quoted_at.description: Receipt time of the union response the price is based on (BR-PRICE-11).

EarningsPeriod.description: One period of the self or share column (BR-FUND-25).

paid_count.description: Paid child orders attributed to the user in the period (by paid_at).

est_fen.description: Estimated share of the user, by paid_at.

credited_fen.description: Signed sum of the credit entries by accounting_date; negative when the period has only reversals.

ReferralEarningsPeriod.description: One period of the referral column (BR-FUND-25); no count.

est_fen.description: Estimated direct and indirect referral share, by paid_at.

credited_fen.description: Signed sum of the REFERRAL_CREDIT entries by accounting_date.

EarningsColumn.description: Self or share column, four periods.

ReferralEarnings.description: Referral column, only this month and last month, all platforms.

as_of.description: Time the figures were computed (BR-FUND-25 细则).

AdminLoginTicket.description:
Intermediate credential of the admin login (BR-ID-34 细则「首次绑定身份验证器」): valid only for
the step it was issued for, sent in the request body, never an admin_token.

username.description: Account name (unique; a disabled account keeps its name, BR-ID-43).

new_password.description: Must differ from the initial password; composition rules are set by the server.

AdminTotpCode.description: Current 6-digit code of the authenticator, or of the SMS for the sms tier.

totp_secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret, shown for manual entry.

otpauth_uri.description: Key URI the console renders as the QR code.

admin_token.description: Sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer token (security scheme adminBearerAuth).

idle_timeout_sec.description: Seconds without activity after which the token stops working (BR-ID-34).

step_up_token.description: Sent as the `X-Step-Up-Token` header of the admin operation; records its tier.

AdminPermissionKey.description:
A value of contracts/enums/admin.yaml `admin_permission` (04 §11). Kept a string here so the
list lives in one place; clients ignore keys they do not know.

AdminPermissionGrant.description: A permission point of the account with its step-up annotation (04 §11 step-up column).

step_up_tier.description: Tier of every step-up operation of this point; null = none needs step-up.

step_up_operations.description: Operations of this point whose tier differs from step_up_tier.

username.description: Account name (the login name); shown as the display name when display_name is empty.

display_name.description: Admin display name (admin_users.display_name); omitted when empty, then clients show username (the login name). Set by POST /admin/v1/admins and PUT /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/display-name.

verify_phone_masked.description: Masked verify phone (BR-ID-33); null = none registered, sms tier unavailable.

permissions.description: Every point for a super admin, the ticked points otherwise; empty = no permission.

AdminDashboardTodoKey.description:
A to-do card of the workbench (enum admin_dashboard_todo_key; 01 F-ADM-26 ①). Each value
is shown only to accounts holding its permission point (see the enum).

AdminDashboardTodoBreakdown.description: One sub-count of a card (e.g. claim_review_pending auto_matched / manual_review).

key.description: Card-specific sub-key; clients ignore keys they do not know.

AdminDashboardTodo.description:
One to-do card. Present only when the account holds the card's permission point and the
card's module has shipped; then present with count 0 too.

count.description: Items waiting, equal to the pending count of the card's list page.

route.description: Console route the card opens, with its filter query.

oldest_at.description: Time of the earliest waiting item; null when count is 0.

breakdown.description: Sub-counts of the card; their sum equals count.

AdminDashboardYesterday.description: Yesterday's whole day, aggregated daily with the report rules (01 F-ADM-26 ②).

orders.description: Sub-orders with paid_at that day, not reduced by later invalidation.

AdminPayoutChannelCode.description: Payout channel (enum payout_method; the <channel> of payout.channel_paused.<channel>).

AdminDashboardStatus.description: System status cards; returned only with permission point fund.view.

payout_channel_paused.description: Channels whose payout.channel_paused.<channel> is on; empty when none.

balance_w_expired.description: Whether the enterprise Alipay balance W is expired (BR-WDR-18); null until W entry ships.

todo.description: To-do cards the account may see, in enum order.

AdminAccount.description: Read-only view of an admin account; no password, hash, TOTP secret or full phone.

display_name.description: Admin display name (admin_users.display_name); omitted when empty, then clients show username (the login name). Set by POST /admin/v1/admins and PUT /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/display-name.

totp_bound.description: false = the next login goes through the first binding.

locked_until.description: End of the current login lock; null when not locked.

permissions.description: Ticked points (admin_permissions); empty for a super admin, who has every point.

row_version.description:
CAS value of the account (plus 1 on every change made through the /admin/v1/admins
operations: status, display name, permission points, authenticator reset, initial
password regeneration, verify phone); PUT /admin/v1/admins/{admin_id}/permissions sends it back as
expected_row_version. Returned by the reads (adminListAdmins, adminGetAdmin) and the
writes (B1-34h, B1-34k).

AdminDisplayName.description: Admin display name (admin_users.display_name, 04 §3.2); trimmed by the server, 1–32 characters.

username.description: Login name; unique among all accounts, disabled ones included, and never changed (BR-ID-43).

initial_password.description:
One-time initial password generated by the server (BR-ID-43「初始密码」, also when
regenerated); returned only in this response, never logged, audited or readable again.

permissions.description: The whole set of ticked points afterwards (enum admin_permission); empty unticks all.

PlatformIconKey.description:
Platform mark key (enum platform_icon_key, BR-TEXT-24 细则标识键表); the keys of /v1/config
`platform_icons` (ConfigPlatformIcons) are the same list.

AdminPlatformIconFormat.description: Format of a cleaned platform mark file.

AdminPlatformIconSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the cleaned file, the same digest as its file name.

AdminPlatformIconUrl.description: Cleaned file on the media domain (set by deployment), named by its SHA-256; shown only as an image (``), never inlined into the page.

AdminPlatformIconSourceUrl.description: Official brand or asset download page the file was taken from (BR-TEXT-24 细则「必填登记」).

AdminPlatformIconVersion.description: One saved version of a platform mark (BR-TEXT-24).

version.description: Counted per mark from 1; the same number /v1/config sends once published.

sanitized.description: true = the cleaned file differs from the uploaded original.

downloaded_on.description: Date the file was downloaded from the source page; null = not registered.

publishable.description: true = both source_url and downloaded_on are registered; false = draft.

ever_published.description: true = published at least once; its registration can no longer be changed.

revision.description:
1 when saved, plus 1 on every registration change (PATCH .../versions/{version}); the
CAS value of that PATCH.

created_by.description: Username of the admin who saved the version.

AdminPlatformIcon.description: A platform mark and its published version (null = built-in image).

current_version.description: Published version; null = the client shows the bundled image.

revision.description:
0 until the first publish; plus 1 on every publish, rollback and restore-builtin, never
going back (saving or registering a version does not change it). The CAS value of
publish and restore-builtin, so a retried old request cannot undo a later change.

latest_version.description: Newest saved version, drafts included; null = nothing saved yet.

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who last saved, published, rolled back or restored; null = never changed.

items.description: Every key of enum platform_icon_key once, in enum order.

AdminPlatformIconUploadRequest.description: multipart/form-data body of a platform mark upload; one part `file`.

file.description: The SVG or PNG file as uploaded (BR-TEXT-24 细则「上传与发布」).

AdminPlatformIconUpload.description:
The cleaned file of an upload, not yet a version. Saved with POST
/admin/v1/platform-icons/{key}/versions until `expires_at`.

sanitized.description:
true = the cleaned file differs from the original: the console shows 「已清除不安全内容」
and saving needs sanitized_confirmed=true.

sanitized_confirmed.description:
The operator confirmed the cleaned preview; absent means false. Must be true when the
upload has sanitized=true.

AdminPlatformIconSourceRequest.description: The version's revision as shown plus at least one of the two registrations.

expected_revision.description: The version's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: Version to publish; older than the current one = rollback.

expected_revision.description: The mark's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The mark's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminPageConfig.description: A configured page with its fully released and gray versions.

current_version.description: Fully released version; null = nothing released yet.

gray_version.description: Version in gray rollout; null = none.

gray_percent.description: Share of devices on the gray version (bucket < gray_percent×100); 0 when there is no gray version.

revision.description:
Plus 1 on every draft save, publish, scheduled publish, schedule cancel, gray change and
rollback, and when a scheduled publish takes effect (judged by time), never going back.
The CAS value of every page write, so a retried old request cannot undo a later change.

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who last saved, published, changed the gray share or rolled back.

scheduled.description:
The pending scheduled publish; null = none. The server always returns it (optional only
so that existing readers keep working); a schedule whose `publish_at` has passed has
taken effect and is not shown (judged by time).

AdminPageConfigSchedule.description: A pending scheduled publish of a page (one per page at most).

gray_percent.description: 100 = release fully; 1..99 = gray rollout to that share of devices.

publish_at.description: When the version will be published.

scheduled_by.description: Username of the admin who scheduled it.

AdminPageConfigVersionStatus.description: draft = saved, never published; published = released fully or in gray at some time; rolled_back = taken back (04 §3.2).

AdminPageConfigVersionSummary.description: One saved version of a page, without its sections.

render_count.description: Renders reported for this version (TECH-29); 0 until the render report exists.

error_count.description: Render errors reported for this version (TECH-29); 0 until the render report exists.

publish_at.description:
When the version was published (for a scheduled publish, the scheduled time); null =
never, including a scheduled version before its time.

publisher.description: Username of the admin who published the version; null = never published.

created_by.description: Username of the admin who saved the version.

AdminPageConfigVersion.description: One saved version of a page with its sections.

render_count.description: Renders reported for this version (TECH-29); 0 until the render report exists.

error_count.description: Render errors reported for this version (TECH-29); 0 until the render report exists.

publish_at.description:
When the version was published (for a scheduled publish, the scheduled time); null =
never, including a scheduled version before its time.

publisher.description: Username of the admin who published the version; null = never published.

created_by.description: Username of the admin who saved the version.

sections.description: Sections as stored in page_versions.sections (shape contracts/home-schema.json `$defs/section`).

AppVersionEditablePlatform.description: Client platforms whose version row the console saves (a subset of ClientPlatformCode; h5 and admin rows are read-only).

min_supported_version.description: Null when no minimum is set (no interception).

store_url.description: Default address of this platform and channel; no download address of any kind (TECH-19).

store_listings.description: In the order filled in; each store at most once.

row_version.description: CAS value of the row; a save sends it back as expected_row_version.

items.description: Every row, by platform, then channel; not paged.

min_supported_version.description: Null = no minimum. Saving a higher one than before (none before counts) needs the totp tier.

store_listings.description: In the order the console shows; a store repeated is 20001 with data.fields=[store_listings].

confirmed_stores.description: Stores whose listed_version is below min_supported_version that the operator confirmed one by one (BR-ID-01 细则); may be empty.

expected_row_version.description: The row's row_version as the console showed it, null when there is no row yet; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminAgreementVersion.description: One published agreement version (04 §6.2 agreements); never changed after publishing.

min_version.description: Where re-consent (privacy, agreement, BR-ID-12) or re-signing (labor_agreement, BR-WDR-31) starts; equals version for sdk_list and collect_list (D10-465).

requires_resign.description: Whether this version is marked as requiring a new signature (04 §6.2).

article_version.description: Version of the agreement article holding the text.

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the text.

url.description: Address of the full text of this version.

legal_confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the version for legal (OPS-14).

AdminAgreementVersionDetail.description: One published agreement version with the title and body of its article.

min_version.description: Where re-consent (privacy, agreement, BR-ID-12) or re-signing (labor_agreement, BR-WDR-31) starts; equals version for sdk_list and collect_list (D10-465).

requires_resign.description: Whether this version is marked as requiring a new signature (04 §6.2).

article_version.description: Version of the agreement article holding the text.

text_sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the text.

url.description: Address of the full text of this version.

legal_confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the version for legal (OPS-14).

body.description: tiptap JSON of the text, as a string.
tiptap JSON of the text, as a string; nodes and marks outside the agreement body whitelist are 20001 with data.fields=[body].

min_version.description: Where re-consent or re-signing starts; not below the current version's, not above the new version; for sdk_list and collect_list exactly the new version (D10-465).

requires_resign.description: Whether the new version requires a new signature; must agree with the publish rules for the type and min_version.

legal_confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the version for legal (OPS-14).

legal_confirmed_on.description: Date of the legal confirmation, written to the audit record (BR-ID-12).

expected_version.description: The type's newest version as the console showed it, 0 when none is published; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminPopupAssetUploadRequest.description: multipart/form-data body of a home popup asset upload; parts `kind` and `file`.

kind.description: lottie = Lottie JSON animation; image = popup picture or static fallback.

file.description: The file as uploaded (BR-TEXT-26 细则「素材与校验」).

AdminPopupAssetUrl.description:
Stored file on the media domain (set by deployment), named by its content SHA-256; the
same content always gets the same url.

AdminPopupAssetSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored file, the same digest as its file name.

AdminPopupAssetLottie.description: kind=lottie result, with the animation's size and duration.

duration_ms.description: (`op` − `ip`) ÷ `fr`, in milliseconds rounded to the nearest one.

sections.description: The whole page; section shape contracts/home-schema.json `$defs/section`.

expected_revision.description: The page's `revision` as the console showed it, 0 for a page not saved yet; a mismatch is 20902.

gray_percent.description: 100 = release fully; 1..99 = gray rollout to that share of devices.

publish_at.description:
Scheduled publish time, later than now and at most 30 days after now; absent = publish
now.

expected_revision.description: The page's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

gray_percent.description: New share of devices on the gray version; 100 = release the gray version fully.

expected_revision.description: The page's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: The current gray version or the current fully released version.

expected_revision.description: The page's `revision` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

version.description: Version to preview, in any status.

token.description: Preview token for GET /v1/pages/{page_key}/preview; the QR code carries only it and page_key.

AdminConfigKey.description:
A configuration or emergency-switch key (04 §10, §10.2): dotted segments, concrete per
platform or channel (`convert.enabled.taobao`); the server's registry decides which keys
exist.

AdminConfigValue.description:
Any JSON value of the key's `value_type` (an `enum` value is one of `options`); checked by
the server against the key's registered type and rule, a mismatch → 20001 with
data.fields=[value].

AdminConfigValueType.description:
Type of a configuration or switch value: boolean, enum (a string out of `options`), object
(a JSON object or array, such as a list of routes or hosts), number or string.

AdminConfigOptions.description: Allowed values when `value_type` is enum; null for every other type.

AdminConfigReason.description: Optional free-text reason, kept in the audit record and the history version.

AdminKillSwitch.description: A registered emergency switch (04 §10.2) and its current value.

value.description: Current value; null = never written, `default` applies.

permissions.description: Permission points of which any one may change the switch (04 §11.2).

admin_editable.description:
false = the console shows the switch read only and a change is 20001 [key]. For
`withdraw.auto_payout.enabled` true means it can only be turned off: the console offers
`false` only and a change to `true` is 20001 [value] (BR-WDR-30).

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who last changed it; null = never changed or set by the system.

expected_version.description: The switch's `version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminRiskRuleId.description:
A risk rule's business code (risk_rules.rule_id, unique per app; 04 §3.2), as the rule seed
registered it (B1-03, BR-ID-36), for example `DEVICE_REGISTER_LIMIT` or `inv_08_self`.

AdminRiskRuleStatus.description:
contracts/enums/admin.yaml `risk_rule_status` (04 §3.2, §6.6; BR-ID-36 细则「规则清单的启停」):
enabled = the rule takes part in judgements; disabled = it does not and writes no
risk_hits.

AdminRiskAction.description: contracts/enums/admin.yaml `risk_action` (BR-ID-36), what a hit of the rule does.

AdminRiskRule.description:
One row of the risk rule list (04 §6.6 risk-rules, §3.2 risk_rules). The condition JSON
is not returned; threshold values are configuration items (/admin/v1/config-items).

scene.description:
The scene code the rule seed registered (risk_rules.scene, for example `register`,
`login`, `withdrawal`); open text, no closed list in 04 or this contract.

name.description: Display name of the rule (risk_rules.name, from the rule seed).

threshold_keys.description:
Keys of the configuration items holding the rule's thresholds (registered under
`config.risk`), read and changed only through /admin/v1/config-items; an empty array
for a rule without a threshold.

version.description:
The rule's compare-and-set value: plus 1 on every enable or disable that changes
`status`, unchanged when the rule already had the target status. The
`expected_version` of POST /admin/v1/risk-rules/{rule_id}/enable and …/disable.

updated_at.description: When the row was last changed (+08:00).

items.description: Every rule of the console's app, by scene, then rule_id; not paged.

expected_version.description: The rule's `version` as GET /admin/v1/risk-rules listed it; a mismatch is 20902.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason, kept in the audit record.

AdminAppealTargetType.description:
contracts/enums/identity.yaml appeal_target_type, the full set (04 §3.2 appeals): the
console lists and registers blocked_request appeals too, unlike the user-side
AppealTargetType.

AdminAppealPrevRiskState.description: The penalty an account appeal is against (appeals.prev_risk_state; a subset of enum risk_state, BR-ID-36).

AdminBlockedRequestType.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml blocked_request_type (BR-ID-36 细则「被拦截请求申诉」).

AdminBlockedRequestCause.description:
contracts/enums/identity.yaml blocked_request_cause, the reason category of a blocked
request: blocklist (a BR-ID-31 blocklist entry; revoking removes it and needs
risk.blocklist) or rule (another block rule; revoking grants the one-time pass of
BR-ID-36).

AdminAppealRevokePermission.description:
The permission point revoking needs on top of risk.appeal (a subset of enum
admin_permission; 04 §11.2 risk.appeal, 编排裁定 D10-154); each also needs a totp step-up.

AdminAppealDecision.description: How an appeal is closed (a subset of enum appeal_status; BR-ID-36).

AdminAppealUser.description: The appellant as the console shows it; the phone number only masked (BR-ID-33).

AdminAppealListItem.description:
An appeal row of the console list (04 §3.2 appeals). Not the user-side Appeal. The display
number of an appeal is its appeal_id; there is no separate appeal number.

user.description: The appellant; null for a register-type blocked_request appeal (no account).

target_no.description:
The target's display number (对象编号): the sub-order number (orders.sub_order_id) for
order, the blocked request id for blocked_request, the UID for account.

request_type.description: The blocked request's type; null unless target_type is blocked_request.

prev_risk_state.description: The penalty appealed against; null unless target_type is account.

created_at.description: When the appeal was submitted or registered.

deadline_at.description: The internal time limit (BR-ID-36); past it a processing appeal is overdue.

handler_id.description: admin_id of the last claimer, the resolver once closed; null while never claimed.

handler_name.description: The handler's display name (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when handler_id is null or the account is gone.

AdminAppealCounts.description:
The four tab counts, counted with every filter of the request except status and overdue
(0 included).

overdue.description: Processing and past deadline_at (a part of processing).

blocklist_dimension.description: The blocklist dimension that was hit for cause blocklist; null for cause rule.

amount_fen.description: The amount asked for, in fen, for request type withdraw; null otherwise.

processing_appeal_id.description:
The appeal processing on this request (for the register type also one on the same
related phone number); null when none.

AdminAppealRiskHit.description:
One related risk_hits row (04 §3.2): time, rule, action and related object only; never
the dimension's value, its HMAC or the rule's conditions (BR-ID-36).

ref_id.description: Number of the related object (risk_hits.ref_id; for blocked_request the blocked request id).

AdminAppealDetail.description: One appeal as the detail page shows it (04 §6.6 appeals); the list row's fields plus the detail.

user.description: The appellant; null for a register-type blocked_request appeal (no account).

request_type.description: The blocked request's type; null unless target_type is blocked_request.

prev_risk_state.description: The penalty appealed against; null unless target_type is account.

risk_state.description: The appellant's risk state now (enum risk_state); null without an account.

registered_by.description: admin_id of the account that registered the appeal; null for source app.

registered_by_name.description: The registrant's display name; null when registered_by is null or the account is gone.

claimed_at.description: The last claim; null when never claimed, and cleared when the appeal is closed.

closed_at.description: When the appeal was closed; null while processing.

row_version.description: CAS value, plus 1 on every claim and on closing; the expected_row_version of claim and resolve.

revoke_permission.description:
The permission point revoking needs on top of risk.appeal, together with a totp
step-up; null when risk.appeal alone is enough.

blocked_request.description: The blocked request for target_type blocked_request; null otherwise.

risk_hits.description: Related risk_hits rows, newest first, at most 50.

content.description: The person's own statement (用户陈述).

reason.description: The registration note (登记原因说明); audit log only, 1–200 characters after trimming.

expected_row_version.description: The appeal's row_version as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

note.description: The internal note (结案内部说明); audit log only, 1–200 characters after trimming.

expected_row_version.description: The appeal's row_version as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminConfigItem.description: A registered configuration item (04 §10) and its current value.

value.description: Current value; null = never written, the server's built-in default applies.

permission.description: The config.* point that guards changing the item, and so its step-up tier.

admin_editable.description: false = the console shows the item read only and a change is 20001 [key].

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who last changed it; null = never changed or set by the system.

items.description: Registered configuration items in registry order.
Every item of the batch, in request order.

AdminConfigItemVersion.description: One stored version of a configuration item (config_item_versions).

updated_by.description: Username of the admin who wrote the version; null = written by the system.

expected_version.description: The item's `version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The item's `version` as the console showed it; any mismatch is 20902 for the whole batch.

items.description: Keys of one permission point, each at most once.

DictKeyClass.description:
Which permission point writes a dictionary key (BR-TEXT-12 细则, 04 §11.2): general →
config.general, fund_terms → content.fund_terms, agreement (table D, `privacy.` and
`perm.`; table C real-name consent sheet, `real_name.consent.`, D10-204) →
content.agreement.

DictKey.description: A key of contracts/texts.default.json or contracts/texts.admin.default.json.

DictVersion.description: A dictionary version (dict_version, an integer as a string; "0" before the first publish).

DictText.description: The override text; null = back to the bundled default.

AdminDictItem.description: One dictionary key with its bundled default and current override.

default_text.description: The key's text in contracts/texts.default.json or contracts/texts.admin.default.json.

version.description: Dictionary version of the key's current row; null = never written.

AdminDictLegalConfirmedBy.description: Who in legal confirmed the change; required when the keys are of class agreement (04 §11.2 content.agreement).

AdminNotifyTemplateCode.description: Template code of notify_templates (04 §3, 04 §2.5 notify_template.code), e.g. WD_FAILED, SMS_CODE, DATA_COPY_CODE.

AdminNotifyTemplateVariant.description: Variant of a template code (notify_templates.variant, 04 §3); default for a code with one variant.

AdminNotifyRowVersion.description: Version of a template code as a whole (channels and every variant's active and pending registration).

AdminSmsTemplateType.description: Provider template type (enum sms_template_type); verification code or notice, marketing SMS is P1.

AdminNotifySmsState.description: What SMS of the code does now (enum notify_sms_state).

AdminNotifySmsTestStatus.description: Latest test result of a pending SMS registration (enum notify_sms_test_status).

AdminNotifySmsActive.description: The SMS registration in use for one code × variant (04 §3 notify_templates SMS columns).

enabled_at.description: When this registration was enabled, or last edited in place (template type or preview text only).

AdminNotifySmsTest.description: Latest test send of a pending registration.

tested_at.description: When the test was sent, or (not_sent_no_verify_phone) when it was skipped.

AdminNotifySmsPending.description: The new SMS registration of one code × variant waiting to be enabled (「待测试」登记, D10-337 ①).

variables.description: Variable names the code defines for this variant (fixed in code); the preview text must use exactly these.

active.description: The registration in use; null = none.

pending.description: The registration waiting to be enabled; null = none.

AdminNotifyChannelItem.description: One template code in GET /admin/v1/notify-channels (BR-TEXT-20 细则「短信渠道登记与后台渠道开关」).

default_channels.description: The code's default channels (BR-TEXT-09 细则 template table).

push_switchable.description: Push may be turned on or off here.

sms_switchable.description: SMS may be turned on or off here.

sms_fixed.description: SMS is always on; only its registration may be replaced.

sms_billing_confirm.description: Turning SMS on needs confirm_sms_billing (a service code without SMS by default).

fund_terms.description: A fund code; saving its SMS registration and enabling a new one also need content.fund_terms.

sms_ready.description: Every variant has an active registration; SMS can be turned on only when true.

sms_deploy_fallback.description: SMS_CODE without an active registration, sent with the deployment configuration (values not returned).

sms_code_ttl_sec.description: SMS_CODE only, the BR-ID-05 code validity in seconds; null for other codes.

sms_registrations.description: One row per variant when the code may send SMS, otherwise empty.

AdminNotifyChannelSwitchRequest.description: Body of PATCH /admin/v1/notify-channels/{code}; at least one of push and sms.

push.description: Push on (true) or off (false); only when push_switchable.

sms.description: SMS on (true) or off (false); only when sms_switchable, and on only when sms_ready.

confirm_sms_billing.description: Must be true when turning SMS on for a code whose sms_billing_confirm is true; ignored otherwise.

row_version.description: The row_version of the item as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminNotifySmsSample.description: Sample values for the test send, by variable name; variables not given take the server's built-in sample.

preview_text.description: The approved template text as copied from the provider, placeholders written ${name}.

row_version.description: The row_version of the item as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The row_version of the item as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.
The row_version of the item as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

test_send_phone_masked.description: Masked verify phone the test SMS went to (BR-ID-33); null when nothing was sent.

changes.description: Keys of one class, each at most once.

keys.description: Keys of one class, each at most once.

to_version.description: The dictionary version to restore the keys to; lower than the current one, 0 = the bundled default.

keys.description: The keys written at that version, in request order.

AdminDict.description: The console dictionary (BR-TEXT-25); a key `admin_dict.<enum>.<code>` is items[enum][code], split at the last dot.

version.description: Dictionary version, equal to `version` of GET /v1/dict; "0" before the first publish.

items.description: Texts by enum (the key without `admin_dict.` up to its last dot), then by code (after the last dot); every key, overridden or default.

to_version.description: The stored version whose value becomes the new current value; must be older than the current one.

expected_version.description: The item's current `version` as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminUserRiskStateCode.description: Risk state of a user (enum risk_state; BR-ID-31, BR-ID-36).

AdminRiskReasonCategory.description:
User-visible reason category of a ban or freeze (enum risk_reason_category; BR-TEXT-23 细则
「原因类别」, user text from the dictionary risk_reason.<category>).

AdminUserLevel.description: Distribution level of the user (enum user_level; not shown to the user, OPS-20).

AdminUnionBindingStatus.description: Status of a union binding (enum union_binding_status; BR-ID-19, BR-ID-20).

AdminUnionBindingBlockedReason.description: Why a binding is blocked (enum union_binding_blocked_reason; BR-ID-20).

AdminRowVersion.description:
row_version of the row as read (users' risk state, a union binding, an admin account);
plus 1 on every change. The CAS value `expected_row_version` of the writes.

AdminUserReason.description: Required free-text reason, kept in the audit record.

AdminMaskedPhone.description: Phone number masked 3 + 4 (`138****5678`, BR-ID-33); null when no phone is bound.

AdminUserListItem.description: A user row of the list; non-sensitive fields only (04 §11.1 user.list).

AdminAuditLogId.description:
Opaque identifier of an audit record (04 §5, ids are strings). It is not the database
primary key (ADR-0001: internal auto-increment keys are never exposed); clients must not
parse it, compare it for order or derive anything from it. Generated by the server and
stable for the life of the record; how it is generated is up to the implementation.

AdminAuditValue.description:
A before or after value as the action stored it: any JSON, null when the action recorded
none. Sensitive fields are stored and shown masked.

AdminAuditActorKind.description: Who acted (enum audit_actor_kind). Only system rows carry it, as `system`; rows of an admin account leave it out.

AdminAuditSystemActor.description:
The system identity that acted (enum audit_system_actor, values of the form
system:<name>; more are appended later). Only system rows carry it; rows of an admin
account leave it out.

actor_id.description: The admin who acted; null on a system row (no account acted).

actor_name.description: Current name of the account that acted (admin_users.display_name, else the username), null when it cannot be read; on a system row the Chinese name of `system_actor` from enum audit_system_actor.

action.description: Action key as the writing module recorded it (such as user_pii_reveal).

target_type.description: Object type derived from the record (free text); null when it cannot be derived.

target_id.description: Object id derived from the record; null when it cannot be derived.

permission.description: Permission point derived from the action; null when it cannot be derived.

ip.description: Client IP of the request (IPv4 or IPv6); null when not recorded.

actor_id.description: The admin who acted; null on a system row (no account acted).

actor_name.description: Current name of the account that acted (admin_users.display_name, else the username), null when it cannot be read; on a system row the Chinese name of `system_actor` from enum audit_system_actor.

action.description: Action key as the writing module recorded it.

target_type.description: Object type derived from the record (free text); null when it cannot be derived.

target_id.description: Object id derived from the record; null when it cannot be derived.

permission.description: Permission point derived from the action; null when it cannot be derived.

ip.description: Client IP of the request (IPv4 or IPv6); null when not recorded.

AdminExportId.description:
Opaque identifier of an export task (04 §5, ids are strings). It is not the database
primary key (ADR-0001: internal auto-increment keys are never exposed); clients must not
parse it, compare it for order or derive anything from it. Generated by the server and
stable for the life of the task, retries included; how it is generated is up to the
implementation.

AdminExportStatus.description:
Status of an export task (enum export_status; BR-ID-34 细则「后台导出任务」; names from
BR-TEXT-25 admin_dict.export_status). pending → running → done or failed; done → expired
24 hours after the file was generated; pending or running → cancelled when the creator's
account is disabled; failed → pending by a retry.

AdminExportResource.description:
Source list of an export task (enum export_resource): users = GET /admin/v1/users
(needs user.list), audit_logs = GET /admin/v1/audit-logs (signed in is enough; own
records only without audit.view_all), tax_withdrawals = the quarterly tax export of
BR-WDR-21, which has no source list (see POST /admin/v1/exports).

AdminExportUserFilters.description: Filters of a users export, the query parameters of GET /admin/v1/users without paging.

quarter.description:
Natural quarter by paid_at at +08:00, as YYYY-Qn. The year is 2026..2100; another year
is 20001.

AdminExportCreateUsersRequest.description:
Export of the users list. unmasked true asks for the full phone numbers (pii.reveal_phone,
totp step-up and reason required); reason is only accepted together with unmasked true.

unmasked.description: true = full values instead of the masked ones; absent or false = masked.

AdminExportCreateAuditLogsRequest.description: Export of the audit log; always masked (audit values are stored masked), no reason.

unmasked.description: true = full values instead of the masked ones; absent or false = masked.

AdminExportCreateRequest.description:
One branch per source list (enum export_resource), told apart by `resource`; `filters`
follows that list's query parameters (`tax_withdrawals` has no list, only `quarter`).

AdminExportRetryRequest.description:
Empty for a masked task. For an unmasked task (masked false) reason is required, with a
new totp-tier X-Step-Up-Token; for a masked task reason is 20001.

AdminExport.description:
An export task (04 §6.6 exports; design/specs/admin-ledger.md 导出记录). Fields that only
apply to some statuses are null otherwise.

filters_summary.description: Readable summary of the filters, written by the server (Chinese, for display only).

masked.description: true = the file holds masked values (the default); false = full values (step-up at creation).

created_by_name.description: Current name of the creator (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when it cannot be read.

progress.description: Percentage generated while running; null in every other status.

failure_reason.description: Short reason written by the server when failed (such as the row limit); null otherwise.

file_name.description: Name of the CSV file when done or expired; null otherwise.

row_count.description: Data rows in the file when done or expired; null otherwise.

expires_at.description:
End of the download period (24 hours after the file was generated, BR-ID-30 ⑨) when
done or expired; null otherwise.

url.description: Signed link to the CSV file in the private bucket; valid until url_expires_at.

url_expires_at.description: min(5 minutes after signing, the task's expires_at).

AdminInviteRewardStatus.description:
Status of an invite reward record (enum invite_reward_status; meanings only in BR-INV-24
细则「资格记录与状态」): qualified → deferred → processed, with the end states voided and
expired (no qualifying own order within the locked eligibility days, BR-INV-24「有效期」).

AdminInviteRewardSkipReason.description:
Why a party is not paid (enum invite_reward_skip_reason; BR-INV-24 ③): same_device,
same_ip and deleted_phone_retained skip both parties, the others only the party hit.

AdminInviteRewardVoidReason.description: Why a record is voided (enum invite_reward_void_reason; BR-INV-24 ③ ⑥).

AdminInviteRewardBindSource.description: Bind channel the invitee qualified through (enum invite_reward_bind_source; BR-INV-24 ①; admin changes never qualify).

AdminInviteReward.description:
An invite reward record (04 §3.2 invite_rewards, BR-INV-24), one per invitee. Phone
numbers masked; no client IP or its HMAC and no voucher ids.

amount_fen.description: Amount each party gets, locked when the invitee qualified (BR-INV-24 ①).

eligibility_days.description: Eligibility days locked when the invitee qualified (BR-INV-24「有效期」; config growth.invite_reward.eligibility_days at that time).

qualified_at.description: When the invitee qualified (in the bind transaction).

trigger_order_id.description: Id of the order that triggered the reward (the invitee's first own purchase credited, BR-INV-24 ②); null before the trigger.

triggered_at.description: When the trigger happened; null before it.

inviter_result.description: The inviter's result; null until processed (and for a voided or expired record).

invitee_result.description: The invitee's result; null until processed (and for a voided or expired record).

inviter_skip_reason.description: Why the inviter is not paid; null unless inviter_result is skipped.

invitee_skip_reason.description: Why the invitee is not paid; null unless invitee_result is skipped.

void_reason.description: Why the record is voided; null unless status is voided.

granted_at.description: When the granted amounts were posted; null when no party was paid.

AdminInviteRewardBudget.description:
Invite reward budget used (BR-INV-24 ④), independent of the list's filters; the limits are
the config items growth.invite_reward.daily_budget_fen and total_budget_fen.

granted_fen.description: Amount granted on that day (what the daily budget counts).

reserved_fen.description: Amount reserved by qualified records not yet paid (both parties' amounts each).

granted_fen.description: Amount granted since the campaign started.

AdminUserRiskState.description:
The user's user_risk_state row as the console sees it (no rule details). A user without a
row reads as state normal, nulls and row_version null; a row always has an integer
row_version (0 for a first row).

reason.description: Internal reason of the last change (console only, never shown to the user).

frozen_until.description: End of a freeze; null for a freeze without end and for every other state.

changed_by.description: Admin username or `system` of the last change; null when there is no row.

row_version.description: null when the user has no risk-state row yet.

AdminUserUnionBinding.description:
A union binding row of the user (union_bindings; BR-ID-19, BR-ID-20), without relation_id or
other union identifiers.

blocked_reason.description: Set when status is blocked, null otherwise.

cooldown_until.description: End of the cooldown after a release (BR-ID-19); null unless released.

reason.description: Reason of the last console change (reset, disable, enable); null when none.

AdminUserDetail.description:
A user as the console sees it (04 §11.1): non-sensitive fields, the masked phone number,
the risk state, the union bindings and (CT-26k, D10-517) the real-name status with the
masked name and ID number and the masked current payout account (BR-ID-33). No full
identity number, payout account, real name or phone number: those only through POST
/admin/v1/users/{user_id}/reveal. realname_status, masked_name, masked_id_no,
payout_account and deletion_status (the latest deletion request, BR-ID-27 / BR-ID-28) are
optional until their implementation is merged (implementation in a separate
task); they then become required, with null as described on each.

inviter_user_id.description: user_id of the current inviter (users.parent_id); null when none is bound.

register_method.description: How the account was created (users.register_method), as stored.

registered_channel.description: Install channel at registration (users.registered_channel), as stored.

union_bindings.description: One entry per platform the user has a binding row on.

realname_status.description:
contracts/enums/identity.yaml realname_status (the user's realname row; none when the
user has none). Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is
merged.

masked_name.description:
Real name with only the last character kept (`**三`, BR-ID-33); null unless
realname_status is verified. The full name only through the audited reveal. Added by
CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is merged.

masked_id_no.description:
ID number with only the first and the last character kept, the rest `*`
(`1****************X`, BR-ID-33); null unless realname_status is verified. The full
number only through the audited reveal. Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until
its implementation is merged.

payout_account.description:
The user's current payout account (payout_accounts.is_current), masked exactly as GET
/v1/me/payout-account returns it (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」: masked_account,
masked_payee_name, bank_name for a bank card); null when none is bound. Only a
verified account is ever saved (BR-WDR-02), so there is no separate verification
state. The full account only through the audited reveal. Added by CT-26k (D10-517);
not returned until its implementation is merged.

deletion_status.description:
Status of the user's latest account-deletion request (BR-ID-27, BR-ID-28: cooling,
processing, done or cancelled); null when the user has never requested deletion.
Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is merged.

AdminUserProfileEditResult.description:
The answer of PATCH /admin/v1/users/{user_id}/profile: the user exactly as AdminUserDetail
(GET /admin/v1/users/{user_id}) describes it now, every property the same, plus
`changed_fields` (CT-26k, D10-517). Keep the properties in step with AdminUserDetail.

inviter_user_id.description: user_id of the current inviter (users.parent_id); null when none is bound.

register_method.description: How the account was created (users.register_method), as stored.

registered_channel.description: Install channel at registration (users.registered_channel), as stored.

union_bindings.description: One entry per platform the user has a binding row on.

realname_status.description:
contracts/enums/identity.yaml realname_status (the user's realname row; none when the
user has none). Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is
merged.

masked_name.description:
Real name with only the last character kept (`**三`, BR-ID-33); null unless
realname_status is verified. The full name only through the audited reveal. Added by
CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is merged.

masked_id_no.description:
ID number with only the first and the last character kept, the rest `*`
(`1****************X`, BR-ID-33); null unless realname_status is verified. The full
number only through the audited reveal. Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until
its implementation is merged.

payout_account.description:
The user's current payout account (payout_accounts.is_current), masked exactly as GET
/v1/me/payout-account returns it (BR-ID-33 细则「收款账号的脱敏格式」: masked_account,
masked_payee_name, bank_name for a bank card); null when none is bound. Only a
verified account is ever saved (BR-WDR-02), so there is no separate verification
state. The full account only through the audited reveal. Added by CT-26k (D10-517);
not returned until its implementation is merged.

deletion_status.description:
Status of the user's latest account-deletion request (BR-ID-27, BR-ID-28: cooling,
processing, done or cancelled); null when the user has never requested deletion.
Added by CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is merged.

changed_fields.description:
The fields this save actually changed, in the order phone, nickname: a field equal to
the current value (phone after normalisation, nickname after trimming) is not
listed; empty when nothing changed (a retry of a save that already took effect). The
same list as the changed fields of the user_profile_edit audit record. Added by
CT-26k (D10-517); not returned until its implementation is merged (then required).

AdminInviteeListItem.description:
A direct invitee of the user (04 §6.6 users/{id}/invitees); the fields of 04 only, no
member-tier fields (BR-INV-23) and no full phone number.

level.description: The new level; the current one or a disabled one is 20001.

inviter_user_id.description: user_id of the new inviter; null removes the inviter (BR-INV-10).

AdminUserDeviceReverified.description: The device's re-verified record (BR-WDR-01 细则「已加验设备」).

source.description: `self` (the user's own re-verification) or `admin` (recorded by the console).

AdminUserDevice.description: A device of the user that is not revoked (no device_hash, install secret or last_login_sid).

AdminReverifiedDeviceRequest.description: Body of POST /admin/v1/users/{user_id}/reverified-devices (BR-WDR-01 细则, 清除标记只走人工).

AdminReverifiedDevice.description: A device recorded as re-verified for the user (no device_hash).

source.description:
Who recorded the device: `self` (the user's own re-verification) or `admin` (this
console operation); a device already recorded keeps its first source.

created.description: false when the device was already recorded and nothing was written.

created_at.description: When the device was first recorded as re-verified.

AdminRealnameCorrectionRequest.description: Corrected real-name data submitted by customer service (BR-ID-25 细则「实名更正」).

name.description: Corrected real name as typed; normalised by the server. Never logged or audited in plaintext.

id_no.description:
Corrected 18-digit resident ID number as typed. No pattern here: length and check
digit are judged by the server (20001 data.fields=[id_no]) after the not-accepted
checks. Never logged or audited in plaintext.

AdminUserRealname.description: A user's real name, masked by the server (BR-ID-33).

realname_status.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml realname_status; always verified after a correction.

masked_name.description: Name with only the last character kept (`**三`, BR-ID-33).

masked_id_no.description: ID number with only the first and the last character kept (`1****************X`, BR-ID-33).

verified_at.description: Time of the vendor verification that the stored real name is based on.

PersonalDataCopyDelivery.description:
How a personal information copy is delivered (enum personal_data_copy_delivery,
BR-ID-40): in_app_sms (an in-app entry to the App page DataCopy plus the extraction code
by SMS) or wecom_session (the registrant sends the file and its password in the WeCom
conversation).

PersonalDataCopyStatus.description:
Status of a personal information copy request (enum personal_data_copy_status,
BR-ID-40); pending, running and ready are unfinished (at most one per user).

AdminUserDataExportCreateRequest.description:
Registration of a personal information copy request (04 §6.6 users/{id}/data-exports).
The two channel facts decide the delivery: both true → in_app_sms, both false →
wecom_session, only one true → not accepted (pending legal confirmation, BR-ID-40).

app_login_ok.description: The agent confirmed in the conversation that the user can sign in to the App.

phone_sms_ok.description: The agent confirmed in the conversation that the bound phone number can receive SMS.

AdminUserDataExport.description:
A personal information copy request (04 §3.2 personal_data_copies). Never carries a
link, an extraction code or a password. Fields that only apply to some statuses are null
otherwise.

requested_by_name.description: Current name of the registrant (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when it cannot be read.

due_at.description:
Deadline: the end of the 15th working day from the first registration (BR-ID-40 细则
「截止时刻」); a request with retry_of keeps the deadline of the one it replaces.

retry_of.description: The failed (or undelivered expired wecom_session) request this one replaces; null otherwise.

generated_at.description: Time the file was generated; null before.

delivered_at.description:
Time of delivery (in_app_sms: the extraction code SMS was sent; wecom_session: the
registrant's first download); null before.

expires_at.description: 24 hours after generation (BR-ID-30 ⑨); null before the file is generated.

failure_reason.description: Short reason written by the server when failed; null otherwise.

requested_by_name.description: Current name of the registrant; null when it cannot be read.

retry_of.description: The request this one replaces; null otherwise.

generated_at.description: Time the file was generated; null before.

failure_reason.description: Short reason when failed; null otherwise.

reused.description: true = the user's unfinished request was returned and nothing was created.

AdminUserDataExportDownloadRequest.description: Body of a wecom_session download; empty for an ordinary download.

regenerate.description:
true = re-encrypt a new file with a new password and void the previous file
(the password was lost); due_at and expires_at do not change.

url.description: Signed link to the encrypted file in the private bucket; valid until url_expires_at.

url_expires_at.description: min(5 minutes after signing, the request's expires_at).

password.description:
One-time password of the file, only when this call generated it (the first download,
or regenerate=true); null otherwise. Never stored; tell it to the user separately
from the file.

status.description: contracts/enums/identity.yaml personal_data_copy_status; always delivered after a download.

expires_at.description: End of the download period of the request (24 hours after generation).

AdminUserProfileEditRequest.description:
Body of PATCH /admin/v1/users/{user_id}/profile (BR-ID-06 细则「客服代办换号」, BR-ID-39
细则「后台改昵称」): `reason` and at least one of `phone` and `nickname`.

phone.description:
The new phone number, normalised by the server (BR-ID-05 细则「手机号规范化」); equal to
the current number after normalisation means not edited.

nickname.description:
The new nickname. The server trims leading and trailing white space and checks the
length as 1–16 extended grapheme clusters (BR-ID-39); no minLength / maxLength here
because JSON Schema counts code points. Equal to the current nickname after trimming
means not edited.

AdminOrderPlatformStatus.description: Union order status (contracts/enums/order.yaml platform_status; BR-FUND-01, BR-FUND-02).

AdminOrderHoldReason.description: Why the order is held (contracts/enums/order.yaml order_hold_reason; BR-FUND-06, BR-FUND-02).

AdminOrderFlag.description: A flag of an admin order row (enum admin_order_flag); the keys of AdminOrderFlags.

AdminOrderHistoryField.description: The status field a history row records (enum admin_order_history_field).

AdminOrderHistorySource.description: Where a status change came from (enum admin_order_history_source).

AdminOrderBuyType.description: Self purchase or share (contracts/enums/trade.yaml buy_type; BR-ATTR-08).

AdminOrderSceneBasis.description: What buy_type was decided from (contracts/enums/trade.yaml scene_basis; BR-ATTR-09).

AdminOrderUserBasis.description: Where the attributed user came from (contracts/enums/trade.yaml user_basis; BR-ATTR-09).

AdminOrderLinkEvent.description: Event of a link record (contracts/enums/trade.yaml link_event; BR-ATTR-14).

AdminOrderLinkScene.description: Scene of a link record (contracts/enums/trade.yaml scene).

AdminOrderBeneficiaryRole.description: Role of a beneficiary in the commission snapshot (contracts/enums/fund.yaml beneficiary_role).

AdminOrderForfeitReason.description: Why a beneficiary's share is forfeited (contracts/enums/fund.yaml forfeit_reason; BR-CALC-13).

AdminOrderUser.description: The attributed user of an order as the console shows it; the phone number only masked (BR-ID-33).

AdminOrderFlags.description:
The flags of an order (enum admin_order_flag). locked is orders.locked, the attribution
lock (BR-ATTR-20, 「归属已锁定」); status_locked is derived from rebate_status ∈ {VOID,
CREDITED, CLAWED_BACK}, not stored (BR-FUND-01 细则「订单锁定（展示标记）」, 「已锁定」);
rights_pending and hold are the columns of the same name (BR-FUND-06). Independent of each
other.

AdminOrderListItem.description:
A sub-order row of the admin order list (04 §3.2 orders). Not the user-side OrderSummary.
Amounts in fen.

sub_order_id.description: The sub-order number (orders.sub_order_id); unique together with platform.

parent_order_id.description: The parent order number (orders.parent_order_id); null when the union gave none.

title.description: Product title from the union order; null when the union gave none.

image_url.description: Product image from the union order; null when the union gave none.

user.description: The attributed user; null for an unattributed order.

paid_at.description: Payment time (orders.paid_at); null when not known yet.

hold_reason.description: Set while hold is true, else null.

AdminOrderStatusHistoryEntry.description: One row of order_status_history (04 §3.2, insert only).

from.description: The value before (a platform_status for field platform, a rebate_status for field rebate); null for the first value.

to.description: The value after, of the same kind as from.

event.description: The transition code as stored (order_status_history.event), such as R5 of BR-FUND-01.

AdminOrderBeneficiary.description: One beneficiary of the commission snapshot (commission_splits.beneficiaries).

ratio_bp.description: The beneficiary's ratio in basis points (1/10000).

forfeit_reason.description: Set when the share is forfeited (BR-CALC-13), else null.

AdminOrderCommissionSplit.description:
The commission snapshot of a sub-order (04 §3.2 commission_splits; BR-CALC-10: written
once). Amounts in fen, ratios in basis points (1/10000).

reserve_bp.description: Platform reserve ratio of the rule version (commission_rule_reserves), basis points.

AdminOrderLinkLog.description: A record of the order's link; its time, event and scene only, no product, shop, promotion, user or raw union data.

AdminOrderDetail.description:
A sub-order as the order detail page sees it: the list row's fields plus product,
attribution and time fields of 04 §3.2 orders, the status history, the commission snapshot
and the link records. Not the user-side OrderDetail. No raw union payload (no permission
point for it in 04 §11; pending).

sub_order_id.description: The sub-order number (orders.sub_order_id); unique together with platform.

parent_order_id.description: The parent order number; null when the union gave none.

user.description: The attributed user; null for an unattributed order.

hold_reason.description: Set while hold is true, else null.

product_key.description: The product key (BR-PROD-02); null until it is resolved.

display_status.description: What the user sees (BR-FUND-17, derived, not stored); null for an unattributed order (BR-FUND-17 row 0).

settled_at.description: When the union status became SETTLED (orders.settled_at).

settle_period.description: Settlement month YYYY-MM (orders.settle_period); null until written.

commission_rate_bp.description: Union commission rate in basis points; null when the union gave none.

row_version.description: CAS value of the order row (orders.row_version); the expected_row_version of hold and unhold.

unmapped_pending_open.description:
Derived, not stored (派生): true when hold_reason is UNMAPPED_STATUS (set by the system,
BR-FUND-02) and the pending record of BR-FUND-02 for it is still open; only status open
counts as not closed. While true, unhold answers 20902 and the console greys out
【恢复结算】 with the reason.

last_hold_by.description:
admin_id of the latest manual hold (人工 hold through POST
/admin/v1/orders/{order_id}/hold), taken from its audit record (审计), not a column of
orders; null when the order was never held by hand. A system hold (UNMAPPED_STATUS)
does not count.

last_hold_by_name.description: The display name of last_hold_by (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when last_hold_by is null or the account is deleted.

last_hold_note.description: The note of the latest manual hold, from its audit record; null when never held by hand.

last_hold_at.description: When the latest manual hold was made, from its audit record; null when never held by hand.

commission_split.description: The commission snapshot; null until it is generated.

link_logs.description: The 50 newest records of orders.link_id, newest first; empty when the order has no link.

AdminOrderStaffHoldReason.description:
The hold reason an operator may send to hold / unhold (subset of enum order_hold_reason):
RISK or CS. UNMAPPED_STATUS is set by the system alone (BR-FUND-02, BR-FUND-06 细则「后台
hold / unhold」).

AdminOrderHoldNote.description: The operator's note (说明), required, 1–200 characters; written into the audit record.

AdminOrderHoldRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/orders/{order_id}/hold. `reason_code` may be left out when it can be
derived from the operator's permission points (BR-FUND-06 细则「后台 hold / unhold」).

expected_user_id.description: The order's user_id as the operator saw it; only null (an unattributed order).

expected_locked.description: The order's flags.locked as the operator saw it.

reason.description: Why the order is assigned (5–200 characters, BR-ATTR-20 ③); written into the audit record.

AdminOrderSyncMode.description: How a manual sync names its orders (enum order_sync_mode).

AdminOrderSyncStatus.description: Status of a manual sync request (enum order_sync_status).

AdminOrderSyncStatusFilter.description:
The order status filter of the platform's order query (status_filter), only a value
registered for that platform in specs/union/<platform>.md; an unregistered value is 20001
with data.fields=[status_filter]. Not the status of the sync request.

AdminOrderSyncCreateRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/order-syncs; exactly one of the two forms. By time window:
`platform`, `from`, `to` and an optional `status_filter`; `from` must be before `to` and not
earlier than the platform's earliest_from (the look-back range of 02 §7.1; GET
/admin/v1/order-syncs/limits), checked by the handler (20001). By order numbers:
`platform` and `order_nos` (the 【同步此单】 of the order detail sends one). The fields are
