declared once here and the `oneOf` only picks the form, so a value out of range (such as
more than 50 order numbers) names just that field.

from.description: Window start, inclusive (ISO 8601 with offset); time window form only.

to.description: Window end, exclusive (ISO 8601 with offset); time window form only.

AdminOrderSyncCreated.description: The sync request; `reused=true` when an equal request was already queued or running and is returned instead.

from.description: Window start; null for mode order_nos.

to.description: Window end; null for mode order_nos.

status_filter.description: The platform order status filter of a window request; null when none was given or for mode order_nos.

order_nos.description: The sub-order numbers; null for mode window.

requested_by_name.description: The requesting admin's display name (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when the account is deleted.

fetched_count.description: Orders fetched from the union so far.

stored_count.description: Orders stored (inserted or updated) so far.

finished_at.description: When the request became done or failed; null before.

AdminOrderSyncPlatformLimit.description: The manual sync limits of one platform (02 §7.1, 01 F-ORD-10).

earliest_from.description: The earliest window start the platform's look-back range allows now; moves with the clock.

max_order_nos.description: The most sub-order numbers one request may carry; 0 means the platform does not support sync by order number.

AdminRightsImportKind.description: What an Excel import holds (enum rights_import_kind).

AdminRightsImportTimeBasis.description: Which time the import window filters rows by (enum rights_import_time_basis).

AdminRightsImportStatus.description: Status of an import task (enum rights_import_status).

AdminRightsImportFailureReason.description: Why one row failed (enum rights_import_failure_reason); a row reason, not an error code.

AdminRightsImportFile.description: The xlsx file, at most 10,000 rows.

AdminRightsImportByOrder.description:
multipart parts of a rights (维权单) or punish (违规单) import. A window (`from` or `to`)
needs both ends and `time_basis`; without a window no row is filtered and `time_basis`
is optional (sent alone it is accepted and ignored; 04 §6.6, BR-FUND-06 维权导入任务).

AdminRightsImportChannel.description: multipart parts of a channel (渠道单) import, by relation_id; no time window.

AdminRightsImportCreateRequest.description: multipart/form-data body of POST /admin/v1/rights-imports; one form per kind.

status.description: A new task is always queued.

AdminRightsImportCreatedByName.description: The importing admin's display name (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when the account is deleted.

AdminRightsImportSummary.description: One import task without its row failures (04 §3.2 rights_imports).

finished_at.description: When the task became done or failed; null before.

row_no.description: The row number in the file.

AdminRightsImportDetail.description: One import task with all its row failures (04 §3.2 rights_imports / rights_import_failures).

finished_at.description: When the task became done or failed; null before.

failures.description: Every row failure of the task, by row_no; empty while nothing failed.

AdminClaimEvidenceLevel.description: Evidence level of a claim or of one child order (contracts/enums/order.yaml claim_evidence_level; BR-ATTR-18).

AdminClaimMatchField.description: Field compared between what the user submitted and what the union reported (enum admin_claim_match_field).

AdminClaimEvidenceScene.description: Scene of a link record counted as evidence (contracts/enums/trade.yaml scene).

AdminClaimApplicant.description: The applicant of a claim as the console shows it; the phone number only masked (BR-ID-33).

AdminClaimListItem.description:
A claim row of the review list (04 §3.2 claims). Not the user-side OrderClaim. The display
number of a claim is its claim_id (展示编号即 claim_id); there is no separate claim number.

order_no.description: The order number as the user submitted it, spaces removed.

paid_date.description: Payment date as the user submitted it, YYYY-MM-DD in +08:00.

evidence_level.description: The claim's evidence level (its weakest child order); null while the claim is submitted and its evidence is not yet settled.

AdminClaimStatusCounts.description:
Number of claims per claim_status value, counted with every filter of the request except
status (0 included).

AdminClaimMatch.description: One field of the evidence view, the user's value against the union's.

user_value.description: What the user submitted, in the contract's format (a date as YYYY-MM-DD).

union_value.description: What the union reported for this child order, same format; null when the union gave none.

matched.description: The server's verdict whether the two agree (for order_no after the same normalisation as BR-ATTR-17).

AdminClaimEvidenceLink.description: A link record counted as evidence; its time and scene only, no product, shop, promotion or raw union data.

scene.description: The record's scene; null for a historical record that carries no channel (历史记录可能无渠道).

AdminClaimItem.description: One child order of a claim (04 §3.2 claim_items). Not the user-side OrderClaimItem.

evidence.description: This child order's evidence level; null while the claim is submitted and its evidence is not yet settled.

reject_reason.description: Set with a rejection only, else null.

decided_at.description: When the decision was made; null while pending.

decided_by.description: admin_id of the reviewer; null while pending or when the system decided.

decided_by_name.description: The reviewer's display name (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when decided_by is null or the account is gone.

row_version.description: CAS value; the expected_row_version of the approve and reject operations.

evidence_links.description: Newest first; empty for evidence none.

AdminClaimDetail.description:
A claim as the review page sees it: the list row's fields plus the latest note and the
child orders. The display number is the claim_id. Not the user-side OrderClaim.

order_no.description: The order number as the user submitted it, spaces removed.

evidence_level.description: As the list row's; null while the claim is submitted.

reason.description: Note of the latest approval or rejection (claims.reason); null before any.

AdminClaimReviewReason.description:
The review note, required for approval and rejection (BR-ATTR-20: at least 5
characters); at least 5 characters also after trimming surrounding whitespace, stored
trimmed in claims.reason and the audit log.

AdminClaimStaffRejectReason.description:
The reject reasons a reviewer may choose (enum claim_reject_reason, its first six codes;
BR-ATTR-18). NOT_IN_POOL and ORDER_INVALID are set by the system only.

expected_row_version.description: The child order's row_version as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902 (claim_item).
The child order's row_version as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902 (claim_item).

AdminSearchHitType.description:
Type of a search hit (enum admin_search_hit_type); each is returned only to accounts holding
its permission point: order order.view, user user.lookup, withdrawal fund.view.

AdminSearchItem.description: One hit of the top-bar search.

summary.description:
Masked one-line summary for the candidate list (phone masked 3 + 4, BR-ID-33); never a
full phone, identity or payout account number. Display only, not parsed by clients.

items.description: Hits the account may see, at most 10; an order or withdrawal is followed by its owner.

truncated.description: True when there were more than 10 hits and only the first 10 are returned.

AdminUserRevealField.description:
The sensitive field to show in full. Only phone (permission point pii.reveal_phone) for
now; the identity number and payout account (pii.reveal_identity) come later.

value.description: The full value (for phone, the normalised 11-digit number).

AdminUserRiskStateAction.description:
ban and unban (permission point risk.ban), freeze and unfreeze (risk.freeze); 04 §11.2,
BR-ID-31, BR-ID-36.

reason_category.description: Required for ban and freeze; not accepted for unban and unfreeze (20001).

frozen_until.description:
Only for freeze: end of the freeze, later than the server's current time; null or
absent = without end (BR-ID-36). Given with another action → 20001.

expected_row_version.description:
risk.row_version as the console showed it; null = no row seen, only accepted while the
user still has no row. Any mismatch (null against an existing row, an integer against
no row or another version) is 20902.
The binding's row_version as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AgentSession.description: An Agent conversation (agent_sessions; owner and expiry per BR-AI-20).

last_active_at.description: Time of the last accepted message; expiry counts from it (BR-AI-20).

client_msg_id.description: Generated by the client, unique in the session; a repeat returns the original run (BR-AI-23 ⑥).

text.description:
The message. Its length limit is step ⑤ of BR-AI-23 (20001, data.fields=[text]), checked
after ①–④, so the schema sets no maxLength.

AgentMessageContext.description: Entry context of 01 §4 情境入口, exactly one of product_key, order_id or text.

AgentFinishReason.description: finish_reason of the done frame (contracts/enums agent_finish_reason, 04 §8.2).

AgentHistoryCard.description:
A card frame as it was sent, without seq (04 §6.5). data follows
contracts/agent-stream.schema.json card_<type> (earnings_summary: earnings_summary_history
only); an unknown type is shown as fallback_text (03 §7.4).

card_id.description: Card id inside the session (c1, c2…, BR-AI-05).

type.description: Card type (contracts/enums agent_card_type); a newer type stays valid for an older client.

data.description: Shape per type in contracts/agent-stream.schema.json (contracts/README.md 书写规则第 12 条).

AgentHistoryMessage.description: One agent_messages row (04 §6.5 会话历史响应的形状).

text.description: user, the text as sent; assistant, the text after OutputGuard ('' while nothing has been written).

finish_reason.description: assistant once the run has ended; null for user and for a run still going.

next_cursor.description: Cursor of the earlier page; null when there are no earlier messages.

expired.description: true when the session has expired; the history is then read-only (BR-AI-20).

reason.description: Free text kept in agent_messages.report_reason; 08 has no reason set yet, so no enum.

AdminUnionAuthStatus.description:
Station-owner authorization status (enum union_auth_status; 04 §3.2
union_accounts.auth_status, BR-ID-24).

AdminUnionReauthMode.description:
How the station-owner credential of the account is renewed (enum union_reauth_mode;
BR-ID-24 细则「后台告警手机号与重新授权会话」, orchestrator ruling D10-159 and its supplement).

AdminUnionAuthSessionStatus.description: Status of a console re-authorization session (enum admin_union_auth_session_status; 04 §3.2).

AdminUnionPidStatus.description: PID status (enum union_pid_status; BR-ATTR-02); pending → active → retired only.

AdminUnionOptionalReason.description: Optional free-text reason, kept in the audit record (BR-ID-24 细则, BR-ATTR-02 细则).

AdminUnionAccountName.description: Display name of a station-owner union account (union_accounts.account_name).

AdminUnionAccount.description:
A station-owner union account (04 §3.2 union_accounts, §6.6 union-accounts). Never
carries alert_stage or any credential.

status.description: union_accounts.status as stored; values registered with B1-22 (not an enum yet).

sync_start_at.description: Creation time of the app's first PID under this account (BR-ATTR-02); null before any.

auth_expires_at.description: When the current station-owner authorization expires; null when unknown.

auth_expires_estimated.description: True when the expiry is estimated (oauth — authorization time + 90 days; manual — entry time + the platform's Key validity from the platform registry; BR-ID-24 细则).

auth_renewed_by.description: The admin who renewed last; null for an automatic refresh or before any renewal.

last_probe_error.description: Cause recorded by the last failed probe (never a token); null when ok or never probed.

alert_phones_configured.description: False when union.auth_alert_phones is empty (BR-ID-24 ②「未配置告警手机号」).

AdminUnionAccountOption.description:
One choice of the union account dropdown of the PID registration form (GET
/admin/v1/union/account-options, D10-243): only the identifier, the platform and the
display name of a union_accounts row; no status, authorization, probe, alert or
credential field.

AdminUnionReauthorizeRequest.description: Body of POST /admin/v1/union-accounts/{union_account_id}/reauthorize; may be empty.

AdminUnionReauthSession.description: A new console re-authorization session (04 §3.2 admin_union_auth_sessions).

auth_url.description: The union's authorization address, valid until expires_at; carries the state once.

AdminUnionReauthResult.description: A re-authorization session as it is now; never the state, code or credential.

error.description: Failure cause recorded by the server when failed; null otherwise (values registered with B1-22).

credential.description: The new station-owner credential in plaintext; only encrypted, never returned or logged.

expires_at.description: Expiry shown by the union, later than now; absent → now + the platform's Key validity from the platform registry (not fixed), marked estimated.

AdminUnionAlertPhoneId.description: Identifier of one alert phone, the HMAC of the normalized number as the server encodes it; opaque to the console.

phone_masked.description: The number masked 3 + 4 (`138****5678`, BR-ID-33); the full number is never returned.

phone.description: The number as entered; normalized by BR-ID-05 细则 before checking.

expected_version.description: The `version` of the list as the console showed it; a mismatch is 20902.

AdminUnionPidCode.description: A union-side identifier (pid / adzone / positionId, or the taobao site_id) as the union shows it.

site_id.description: Taobao site id; null on every other platform.

hjy_ignore_confirmed_at.description: When the 花卷云 ignore was confirmed (BR-ATTR-28); null while pending.

hjy_ignore_evidence_path.description: Private OSS object path of the 花卷云 ignore screenshot; null while pending.

AdminUnionPidCreateRequest.description: Body of POST /admin/v1/union-pids; the new row is always pending.

site_id.description: Required for taobao; absent or null on every other platform.

AdminUnionPidUpdateRequest.description:
Body of PATCH /admin/v1/union-pids/{pid_id} (pending rows only): `expected_row_version`
plus at least one more field; a body that names none of the five fields (only
`expected_row_version` and `reason`) is 20001 with `data.fields=[body]`.

site_id.description: The taobao site id; null clears it when the row moves to another platform.

hjy_ignore_confirmed_at.description: When the 花卷云 ignore was confirmed; not later than now.

hjy_ignore_evidence.description: The screenshot, PNG or JPEG, at most 5 MB (BR-ATTR-02 细则).

AdminUnionOAuthCallbackRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/union-accounts/oauth/callback: what the console callback page
received from the union, unchanged: `state` and exactly one of `code` or `error`
(neither or both → 20001 with `data.fields=[code]`).

state.description: The state the union echoed back; looked up by its hash.

code.description: The authorization code from the union; exchanged once, never logged or returned.

error.description: The error the union sent instead of a code; kept as the session's failure cause.

AdminPayChannel.description: Pay channel (contracts/enums/pay.yaml pay_channel; BR-PAY-01); not the payout channel.

AdminPayOrderStatus.description: Pay order status (contracts/enums/pay.yaml pay_order_status; BR-PAY-02); PAID and CLOSED are final.

AdminPayRefundTargetType.description: What a refund pays back (contracts/enums/pay.yaml pay_refund_target_type; BR-PAY-06 ①).

AdminPayRefundReason.description: Refund reason code (contracts/enums/pay.yaml pay_refund_reason; BR-PAY-06); names from admin_dict.pay_refund_reason.

AdminPayQueryAttemptKind.description: Kind of a channel request record (contracts/enums/pay.yaml pay_query_attempt_kind).

AdminPayReconDiffType.description: The R4 types of contracts/enums/fund.yaml recon_diff_type (BR-PAY-07); the other types belong to R1–R3.

AdminPayOrder.description:
One pay order (04 §3.2 pay_orders) as the console shows it. `refunded_fen` is the total of
its successful refunds (BR-PAY-06 ③); `closing` is true while the close flow runs and
`needs_manual` while it waits for POST /admin/v1/pay-orders/{pay_order_id}/resolve
(BR-PAY-05). `user_id` is our user; no channel-side user identifier is included.

biz_type.description: The business type that registered the pay order.

biz_ref.description: The business object of that type the pay order pays for.

out_trade_no.description: Our merchant order number, unique and never changed.

channel_trade_no.description: The channel's transaction number; null until the channel reports one.

AdminPayQueryAttempt.description: Summary of one channel request record (pay_query_attempts); the request and response bodies are never returned.

result.description: The outcome the server recorded for the request (pay_query_attempts.result), such as ok or unknown.

refunds.description: The pay order's refunds, newest first.

query_attempts.description: The 20 newest channel requests of the pay order and its refunds, newest first.

AdminPayOrderResolveRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/pay-orders/{pay_order_id}/resolve: fixed values only. The server
queries the channel itself; the console sends no status, channel result or evidence.

expected_status.description: CAS on the pay order status; only PENDING (subset of pay_order_status).

action.description: Query the channel now and settle by its answer (BR-PAY-05 ③).

AdminPayChannelResult.description:
Summary of the query the server made for the settlement (its evidence, BR-PAY-05 ③; the
recorded response itself is not returned). `state` is how the server read the answer:
paid (→ PAID), closed (→ CLOSED), not_exist (CLOSED only under the BR-PAY-05 ② condition,
otherwise unchanged) or unknown (unchanged). `channel_state` is the channel's own status
code as received (null when the query gave none); no channel-side user identifier.

AdminPayRefundCreateRequest.description:
Body of the two original-route refund operations. The target comes from the path; the
channel, refund number, operator and status are set by the server.

amount_fen.description: Positive integer fen; with the successful and processing refunds at most the refundable amount (else 20001).

note.description: Optional free text kept with the refund and in the audit record.

AdminPayRefund.description: One refund (04 §3.2 pay_refunds); `out_refund_no` is generated at creation, unique and never changed.

channel_refund_no.description: The channel's refund number; null until the channel reports one.

pay_order_id.description: Our pay order when the merchant order number names one (a CLOSED pay order), else null.

status.description: pay_anomalies.status as stored; 04 §3.2 names the column but fixes no value set yet, so it is not an enum here.

AdminPayReconDiff.description: One reconciliation difference of source R4 (04 §3.2 recon_diffs; BR-PAY-07). `diff_fen` = `expected_fen` − `actual_fen`.

ref_type.description: What the difference refers to, such as pay_order, pay_refund or pay_anomaly.

AdminReconDiffType.description: The R1–R3 types of contracts/enums/fund.yaml recon_diff_type (BR-FUND-01, BR-FUND-04, BR-FUND-19, BR-FUND-22, BR-FUND-23); the R4 types pay_mismatch and pay_anomaly are AdminPayReconDiffType.

AdminReconDiffSource.description: Source of a difference listed under /admin/v1/recon-diffs (recon_diffs.source without R4) — R1 联盟对账, R2 通道对账, R3 内部日终与月末核对.

AdminReconDiffPeriod.description: A reconciliation period, a month (YYYY-MM) or a day (YYYY-MM-DD), as recon_diffs.period.

AdminReconDiff.description: One reconciliation difference of source R1, R2 or R3 (04 §3.2 recon_diffs). `diff_fen` = `expected_fen` − `actual_fen`.

ref_type.description: What the difference refers to, such as order, account or settlement.

AdminReconDiffDetail.description:
One reconciliation difference of source R1, R2 or R3 with its handling summary: the fields
of AdminReconDiff plus `handler_id` (admin_users.id of who handled it; null until handled),
`updated_at` and `resolution` (recon_diffs.resolution; null while unhandled). The keys of
`resolution` are not fixed by this contract; it is for display only.

ref_type.description: What the difference refers to, such as order, account or settlement.

handler_id.description: admin_users.id of the admin who handled the difference; null until handled.

resolution.description: The handling summary as stored (recon_diffs.resolution), for display only; its keys are not fixed by this contract. Null while unhandled.

reason.description: Why the difference is closed without further handling; 1–200 characters after trimming, else 20001 with data.fields=[reason]. Stored as resolution.reason.

outcome.description: Optional structured conclusion, for type=settle_amount_mismatch (source R1) only; any other type or source → 20001 with data.fields=[outcome] from B2-09h on. Stored as resolution.outcome from B2-09h on; do not send it before then.

AdminReconDiffOutcome.description:
contracts/enums/admin.yaml admin_recon_diff_outcome: the structured conclusion of a
settle_amount_mismatch difference of source R1 (D10-447 ②, D10-506; BR-FUND-04 ④, 校验结果
table, 例 2), optional in the close request and stored as resolution.outcome (written from
B2-09h on). union = 以联盟为准: counts as matched in the monthly check, and the order goes
on to a supplement batch, only while the current base_fen and B_settle both equal the
difference's expected_fen and actual_fen; otherwise the amounts are compared as usual, a
mismatch opens a new settle_amount_mismatch difference with ref_id
{order_key}#AMT#{base_fen}:{b_settle_fen} and the order stays WAITING. ours =
以我方为准: does not count as matched. Sent for any other type or source → 20001 with
data.fields=[outcome] (from B2-09h on; see closeAdminReconDiff for the window before it).

released_hold_count.description: Withdrawal holds whose source is this difference that this call released (holds released earlier are not counted).

AdminReconDiffWriteOffRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/recon-diffs/{recon_diff_id}/write-off. The console confirms the
withdrawal status it showed and may leave a note; the evidence is the bill line stored with
the difference, never sent by the console.

expected_withdrawal_status.description: Compare-and-set on the withdrawal status; only APPROVED (subset of withdrawal_status), else 20902 with data.resource=withdrawal.

note.description: Optional operator note, 1–200 characters after trimming (else 20001 with data.fields=[note]); recorded under resolution.note.

AdminReconDiffWriteOffWithdrawal.description: The withdrawal after W11, as GET /admin/v1/withdrawals/{withdrawal_id} shows these fields.

paid_at.description: The bill line's time when it carries one, else 00:00 +08:00 of the bill day (D10-431); never the time of the write-off.

channel_order_id.description: The channel's order id from the bill line; null when the line has none.

released_hold_count.description: Withdrawal holds whose source is this difference that this call released (holds released earlier are not counted).

AdminReconDiffRestoreRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/recon-diffs/{recon_diff_id}/restore. The console sends no amount:
the amount is calculated by the server (BR-FUND-22 ③); `expected_fen` is for display only.

note.description: Optional operator note, 1–200 characters after trimming (else 20001 with data.fields=[note]); recorded under resolution.note.

restored_fen.description: Total this call paid to the member over all roles; 0 when nothing was posted (D10-469 ③, D10-482). Never `expected_fen` taken as is.

AdminAdjustmentStatus.description:
Status of a manual adjustment form (contracts/enums/fund.yaml admin_adjustment_status).
Forms a person submits are born APPROVED; only system-prefilled forms are PENDING. 已红冲
is not a status (BR-TEXT-25).

AdminAdjustmentDirection.description: Direction on the member's available balance (contracts/enums/fund.yaml admin_adjustment_direction).

AdminAdjustmentReasonCode.description: The reason code, equal to the ADMIN_ADJUST sub_type (contracts/enums/fund.yaml admin_adjust_sub_type; BR-FUND-24 ②).

AdminAdjustmentRefType.description:
Type of a linked document (contracts/enums/fund.yaml admin_adjustment_ref_type;
BR-FUND-24 ③): `recon_diff` (`ref_id` = recon_diffs.id, not of source R4), `withdrawal`
(withdrawals.id), `order` (the sub-order's order_key), `account_deletion`
(deletion_requests.id).

AdminAdjustmentRef.description: One linked document of an adjustment form (BR-FUND-24 ③).

ref_id.description: The document's id, or the order_key for ref_type `order`.

AdminAdjustmentContraSubject.description:
The ledger subject opposite USER_BALANCE.available (contracts/enums/fund.yaml
admin_adjustment_contra_subject; BR-FUND-24 ⑥, specs/ledger-rules.md §6, pending the
finance confirmation).

AdminAdjustment.description:
One manual adjustment form (04 §3.2 admin_adjustments). `amount_fen` is null on an
ACCOUNT_CLOSED form until it is approved (BR-FUND-24 ⑧), so also on a rejected one.
`created_by` is null on a form the system prefilled. `refs` is empty on a reversal, whose
link is `reverses_adjust_id`, and on an OTHER form whose `note` stands in for a document.
`reversed_by_adjust_id` is the reversal of this form, null when it has none: the console
shows 已红冲 from it and links to that form. `contra_platform` is set only for
UNION_RECEIVABLE. `voucher_id` (the voucher, also the link to the balance history) is
null until the form is executed.

note.description: Internal explanation, shown in the console only (BR-FUND-24 ⑦).

AdminAdjustmentBalancePreview.description:
What executing the form now would do to `available` (BR-FUND-24 ④), read when the detail
is read: the form itself for a PENDING form, its reversal for an APPROVED one.

AdminAdjustmentDetail.description: One adjustment form with `balance_preview` (null unless the form can still be executed or reversed, so null on an APPROVED form once its member is deleted).

AdminAdjustmentCreateNew.description: A new adjustment. Which `refs`, `note`, `contra_subject` and `contra_platform` a reason code needs is in POST /admin/v1/adjustments.

amount_fen.description: Integer fen above 0, no upper limit (BR-FUND-24 ④).

reason_code.description: Only these three can be chosen; RESTORE and ACCOUNT_CLOSED → 20001 at the schema (see AdminAdjustmentCreateRequest).

note.description: Internal explanation, at most 500 characters, not blank after trimming; required for OTHER.

contra_subject.description: RECON_FIX and OTHER only, required for them (BR-FUND-24 ⑥).

AdminAdjustmentCreateReversal.description: A whole-form reversal; everything else comes from the original (BR-FUND-24 细则「红冲只按原单整笔」).

note.description: The reason for the reversal, at most 500 characters, not blank after trimming.

AdminAdjustmentCreateRequest.description: Body of POST /admin/v1/adjustments, a new adjustment or a reversal. Each branch is a closed object; a body that fits neither is 20001 with data.fields listing what fails in both branches plus `body`.

AdminAdjustmentExecuted.description: The form in effect, with `available` before and after, as read in the transaction that wrote the voucher.

AdminEmptyActionRequest.description: The body of an action that takes no input; the amount is read by the server, never sent by the console.

AdminBadDebtWriteoffStatus.description: Status of a write-off candidate (contracts/enums/fund.yaml bad_debt_writeoff_status).

One write-off candidate (04 §3.2 bad_debt_writeoffs; BR-FUND-12). `candidate_fen` is the
amount when it was generated, for reference only. `available_fen`, `frozen_fen` and

contracts/enums/admin.yaml admin_withdrawal_display_status: the console's display status

withdrawals.auto_decision (04 §3.2; BR-WDR-30 细则「可追溯」): `result`, every unmet
condition code (`failed_conditions`, the 转人工原因, in the order ①–⑬; risk flags as

AdminSettleBillId.description: A bill month (settle_bills.bill_id, YYYY-MM; BR-FUND-04 ③).

AdminSettleBillStatus.description:
contracts/enums/admin.yaml admin_settle_bill_status: the console status of a monthly
settlement bill (BR-FUND-04 细则「月结账单状态」), derived by the server at read time and
not stored (settle_bills has no status column). It is derived from the batches of the
bill's latest round, read from settle_batches: the first round is every batch of the bill
with kind main (generated by the bill-day task); each supplement launch is one round, the
batches with kind supplement sharing the same (platform, created_at) (one launch inserts
all its batches in one transaction, so they share the column-default created_at). A
round's time is the largest created_at of its batches; the latest round is the one with
the largest round time (on a tie, the round holding the largest batch_id). Batches
rejected (CANCELLED) do not take part. In this order, the first rule that holds wins
(now = the server clock):
generating = generated_at is null (the bill-day task is still checking and generating);
issued = the round has no batch left that is not CANCELLED (no candidate, a platform
with credit.enabled off keeping only its check results, or every batch of the round
rejected), or any batch of the round is DRAFT;
settled = every batch of the round is DONE;
settling = some batch of the round is EXECUTING or PARTIAL, or CONFIRMED with settle_mode
IMMEDIATE or with scheduled_at not later than now (due, not started yet);
scheduled = otherwise (the batches not yet DONE are all CONFIRMED with scheduled_at later
than now). Chinese names from BR-TEXT-25 admin_dict.
Only the latest round counts, so a batch that is DRAFT outside it (a schedule cancelled
after a later supplement launch) does not make the bill issued: the status can be, for
example, settled while that batch waits for confirmation (编排裁定 D10-444). Which batches
wait for confirmation is read from the batches with status DRAFT, not from this status.

AdminSettleBillPlatformCounts.description: Count per platform (settle_bills.platform_order_counts); a platform without sub-orders in the bill is absent.

AdminSettleBillPlatformTotals.description: Amount in fen per platform (settle_bills.platform_settle_commission_totals); a platform without sub-orders in the bill is absent.

AdminSettleBatchKind.description: settle_batches.kind (04 §3.2; BR-FUND-04 ⑤ ⑨) — main = generated by the bill-day task, supplement = generated by a supplement launch. Values as the table's check constraint; contracts/enums has no entry for it yet.

AdminSettleBatchItemType.description: contracts/enums/fund.yaml settle_batch_item_type — order = sub-order row, beneficiary = beneficiary make-up item (BR-FUND-04 ⑫).

AdminSettleBatchItemResultFilterValue.description: The `result` filter of the batch items — a settle_batch_item_result value, or pending = not executed yet (result null). pending is a filter value only, never a result.

AdminSettleBill.description:
One monthly settlement bill of the console's list (04 §3.2 settle_bills) with its derived
status and batch summary. The totals and error_count / held_count reflect the bill-day
task only — supplement batches do not write them back (编排裁定 D10-280 ③) — and are for
display only: amount judgements and reconciliation go by the batch items.

generation_started_at.description: When the bill-day task started generating this bill (BR-FUND-04 ③).

generated_at.description: When the check and every batch of the bill-day task were generated; null while generating.

platform_order_counts.description: Sub-orders in the bill per platform (bill-day task only); null while generating.

platform_settle_commission_totals.description: Union settlement commission per platform in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

beneficiary_total_fen.description: Total of the beneficiary shares in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

platform_retained_fen.description: Total retained by the platform in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

error_count.description: Differences (差错单) opened by the bill-day task; null while generating. The rows are in GET /admin/v1/recon-diffs.

held_count.description: Sub-orders put aside (暂缓, hold or rights pending) by the bill-day task; null while generating.

batch_count.description: Batches of the bill, main and supplement, CANCELLED included (counted at read time).

draft_batch_count.description: Batches of the bill in DRAFT, waiting for confirmation (counted at read time).

AdminSettleBatchItemCounts.description: Items of a batch by item_type × result, summed at read time (not stored); pending = result null (not executed yet).

AdminSettleBatchRowVersion.description: settle_batches.row_version, the compare-and-set version of a batch; each batch command adds one.

AdminSettleBatch.description: One settle_batches row of a bill (04 §3.2) with whether it is in the bill's latest round and its item counts.

scheduled_at.description: The scheduled execution time; null unless settle_mode is SCHEDULED.

confirmed_by.description: The admin who confirmed the batch; null until confirmed (and again after a schedule is cancelled).

cancelled_reason.description: The rejection reason; set exactly when status is CANCELLED.

paused_by_switch_at.description: When execution stopped because a switch was off (BR-FUND-04 SB10); null otherwise.

row_version.description: The version the batch commands take as expected_row_version (POST /admin/v1/settle-bills/{bill_id}/confirm, POST /admin/v1/settle-batches/{batch_id}/cancel-schedule, /reject, /resume).

in_current_round.description: Whether the batch belongs to the bill's latest round as defined in AdminSettleBillStatus (main round = all kind main batches; supplement round = kind supplement batches sharing (platform, created_at); latest = largest round time, a tie going to the round holding the largest batch_id); a CANCELLED batch of that round is true but takes no part. It only says which batches the derived status comes from; a DRAFT batch can be false (a schedule cancelled after a later supplement launch) and POST /admin/v1/settle-bills/{bill_id}/confirm still covers it (编排裁定 D10-444).

AdminSettleExpectedBatch.description: One DRAFT batch of the bill as the console read it.

AdminSettleBillConfirmRequest.description:
Body of POST /admin/v1/settle-bills/{bill_id}/confirm. `expected_batches` must match all
the DRAFT batches of the bill one to one, whatever their round and platform (BR-FUND-04 ⑥,
编排裁定 D10-444), never a choice among them; any other set is 20902 with
data.resource=settle_batch.

scheduled_at.description: Required with SCHEDULED, not allowed with IMMEDIATE; later than the moment of confirmation and outside the nominal asset snapshot window (BR-FUND-04 ⑥, BR-FUND-18), else 20001 with data.fields=[scheduled_at].

reason.description: Why the batch is rejected; 1–200 characters after trimming, else 20001 with data.fields=[reason]. Stored as cancelled_reason.

AdminSettleSupplementOutcome.description: contracts/enums/admin.yaml admin_settle_supplement_outcome — generated = the check ran (batch_ids may be empty); duplicate = already claimed for the same nominal moment, nothing generated.

batch_ids.description: The batches this launch generated; empty when there was nothing to include (no empty batch is generated) and on outcome duplicate.

AdminSettleBillDetail.description:
One monthly settlement bill with the fields of AdminSettleBill plus every batch of the
bill. Totals and counts of settle_bills reflect the bill-day task only and are for
display only (编排裁定 D10-280 ③).

generation_started_at.description: When the bill-day task started generating this bill (BR-FUND-04 ③).

generated_at.description: When the check and every batch of the bill-day task were generated; null while generating.

platform_order_counts.description: Sub-orders in the bill per platform (bill-day task only); null while generating.

platform_settle_commission_totals.description: Union settlement commission per platform in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

beneficiary_total_fen.description: Total of the beneficiary shares in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

platform_retained_fen.description: Total retained by the platform in fen (bill-day task only); null while generating.

error_count.description: Differences (差错单) opened by the bill-day task; null while generating. The rows are in GET /admin/v1/recon-diffs.

held_count.description: Sub-orders put aside (暂缓, hold or rights pending) by the bill-day task; null while generating.

batch_count.description: Batches of the bill, main and supplement, CANCELLED included (counted at read time).

draft_batch_count.description: Batches of the bill in DRAFT, waiting for confirmation (counted at read time).

batches.description: Every batch of the bill, main and supplement, CANCELLED included, ordered by created_at then batch_id; [] when none.

AdminSettleBatchItem.description: One settle_batch_items row (04 §3.2; BR-FUND-04 ⑦ ⑫); user_id only, never a phone number.

user_id.description: The beneficiary (beneficiary items only); null on order rows.

role.description: The beneficiary role (beneficiary items only); null on order rows.

beneficiary_credit_id.description: The make-up obligation (beneficiary items only); null on order rows.

settle_seq.description: order_settlements.seq at check time; execution skips the item when it no longer matches (BR-FUND-04 ⑦).

b_settle_fen.description: B_settle in fen (order rows always; beneficiary items when recorded).

amount_fen.description: The amount credited in fen, recomputed at execution (beneficiary items); null on order rows and before execution.

result.description: Null while the item is not executed yet.

skip_reason.description: Why the item was skipped; null otherwise.

AdminAssetSnapshotReceivable.description: One asset_snapshot_receivables row of the snapshot (04 §3.2; BR-FUND-18, BR-FUND-20).

union_receivable_fen.description: Balance in fen of the platform's union receivable account (UNION_RECEIVABLE:{platform}) over the entries with accounting_date ≤ D, as the snapshot wrote it.

AdminAssetSnapshot.description:
One daily asset snapshot (04 §3.2 asset_snapshots) of accounting day D, written at D+1
00:01:00 +08:00 (BR-FUND-18). Amounts are integer fen exactly as the snapshot wrote them,
never recomputed. The balance totals cover the entries with accounting_date ≤ D; the
waiting and estimated totals are the order states at the time the snapshot ran.

snapshot_date.description: The accounting day D (YYYY-MM-DD, +08:00); unique per app, the row key.

total_available_positive_fen.description: Sum of the positive available balances in fen (withdrawable side, BR-FUND-18).

total_negative_fen.description: Sum of the magnitudes of the negative available balances in fen (BR-FUND-18 negative_fen side).

total_frozen_fen.description: Sum of the frozen balances in fen.

total_waiting_fen.description: Shares in fen of the orders with rebate_status WAITING (已收货预估) when the snapshot ran.

total_estimated_fen.description: Estimated total in fen (rebate_status ESTIMATED or WAITING, 预估合计) when the snapshot ran.

waiting_comparable.description:
Whether the snapshot completed in time (BR-FUND-18): true only when it was confirmed
before D+1 00:30 +08:00, the latest the settlement batches wait for it. false when it
timed out (an alert is raised and batches could run meanwhile) or was not yet
confirmed; settlement batches may then have run before the snapshot read the orders,
so `total_waiting_fen` / `total_estimated_fen` of that day are not comparable with
other days. The balance totals do not depend on it (they go by accounting_date).

receivables.description: The union receivable per platform of the snapshot (asset_snapshot_receivables), ordered by platform code; only platforms with at least one receivable entry dated ≤ D; empty when none.

created_at.description: When the snapshot row was written.

updated_at.description: When the row last changed (the confirmation that sets waiting_comparable).

AdminUnionReceiptMethod.description: How a union collection was registered (contracts/enums/fund.yaml union_receipt_method; BR-FUND-20).

AdminUnionReceiptCashAccount.description: The subject a union collection debits (contracts/enums/fund.yaml union_receipt_cash_account; BR-FUND-20 细则).

AdminFundWaterLevel.description: The conclusion from W and P (contracts/enums/fund.yaml admin_fund_water_level; BR-WDR-18).

AdminUnionReceiptCreateRequest.description: One union collection to enter; see POST /admin/v1/union-receipts.

receipt_date.description: The day the money arrived (YYYY-MM-DD), not later than the current accounting day.

amount_fen.description: Integer fen above 0, the amount of BR-FUND-20.

note.description: Optional, at most 500 characters, not blank after trimming.

reason.description: Why the record is reversed; 1–200 characters after trimming, else 20001 with data.fields=[reason]. Kept in the audit record.

AdminUnionReceipt.description: One union collection record (BR-FUND-20 细则「联盟回款凭证」; 04 §3.2 union_receipts, written by settlement).

amount_fen.description: Integer fen, the amount of BR-FUND-20. It stays as entered after a reversal.

created_by.description: The admin who entered the record; null for a record confirmed by R1 without an operator.

created_by_name.description: Current name of the creator (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when there is none or it cannot be read.

reversed_at.description: When the record was reversed; null until then.

reversed_by.description: The admin who reversed the record; null until then.

reversed_by_name.description: Current name of the reverser (admin_users.display_name, else the username), derived when read; null until the record is reversed, or when it cannot be read.

reversal_voucher_id.description: The reversal voucher (BR-FUND-16, BR-FUND-20 细则); null until the record is reversed.

AdminFundLedgerReceivable.description: The 已入账未回款 of one platform at the moment of reading (BR-FUND-20).

union_receivable_fen.description: Balance in fen of UNION_RECEIVABLE:{platform} over all the entries posted so far; below 0 after a collection above the receivable.

AdminPayoutWatermarkChannel.description: The channels whose W can be entered (D10-592); bank_card opens with its channel.

AdminPayoutWatermarkCreateRequest.description: One reading of a channel's balance; see POST /admin/v1/payout-watermarks.

available_fen.description: Integer fen, 0 or above, the balance read off the account (BR-WDR-18 W).

measured_at.description: When W was read off the account (t_W), checked against the injected Clock.

note.description: Optional, at most 500 characters, not blank after trimming; kept in the audit record.

entered_by_name.description: Current name of that admin (admin_users.display_name, else the username).

AdminPayoutBatchCreateRequest.description: The withdrawals to execute; see POST /admin/v1/payout-batches.

AdminPayoutBatchResult.description: Whether the batch ran. On `rejected` nothing moved; see POST /admin/v1/payout-batches.

channel.description: The failing channel of a watermark reason, else null.

watermark.description: The channel's latest W; null until one exists, never a default.

AdminPayoutOverview.description: The payout status cards, computed when read; see GET /admin/v1/payout-overview.

AdminFundLedgerWatermark.description: The latest W of the enterprise Alipay channel (BR-WDR-18; 04 §3.2 payout_watermarks). Entered on the payout console, not here.

measured_at.description: When W was read off the account (t_W).

entered_by.description: The admin who entered W; null when no admin did.

entered_by_name.description: Current name of that admin (admin_users.display_name, else the username); null when there is none or it cannot be read.

AdminFundLedger.description: The fund ledger overview, computed when read; see GET /admin/v1/fund-ledger.

receivables.description: The 已入账未回款 per platform, ordered by platform code; only platforms with at least one entry; empty when none.

negative_total_fen.description: Sum of the magnitudes of the negative available balances in fen (BR-FUND-18 negative_fen side).

negative_user_count.description: Number of accounts with a negative available balance.

watermark.description: The latest W; null until one exists, never a default.

forecast_withdrawal_fen.description: P of BR-WDR-18 in fen; null while it is not available, never a default.

water_level.description: The conclusion from W and P; null when W or P is null or W is stale.
